mission.properties|b.king_of_ashes:
Within the ever-burning depths of the Firestorm Citadel, Lord Vanaduke lies in wait for any living being to pass into his accursed kingdom.  Any squad that has ever attempted to infiltrate the citadel has perished or was simply lost, like the countless lost souls bound to this terrible realm. 

Lord Vanaduke is ready for war, believing in his twisted mind that any who dare enter the citadel to be an invading force bent on overtaking his kingdom.  He stands as the last obstacle before gaining access to the Core and the Spiral Knights having any chance of restoring the Skylark and returning home. 

As a Champion of the Spiral Knights, you alone have what it takes to lead a team into the very heart of this inferno and face the titanic might of Lord Vanaduke.

guildhelp.properties|m.guild_hall_info:
The Guild Hall is the nerve center for any Spiral Knights guild. Here, guild members can relax, plan future missions, and take advantage of the various Guild Hall amenities at their disposal. The Guild Hall is extremely customizable, and can be expanded to fit guilds of all sizes. It can also contain a wide variety of unique furniture and room types, so coordinate with your friends to make your Guild Hall a true reflection of your guild\!
 When a Guild Hall is first opened, it consists of two rooms\: a lobby, and the Command Console room. Guilds wishing for more space to customize can purchase expansions to increase the base size of their guild hall. These are available from the Command Console while in Design Mode.
 Guilds that have expanded the usable space in their Hall can fill that space with a variety of different rooms, available for purchase from the Birdsong Emporium. These rooms can be as simple as an empty room for placing furniture, or they can contain one of a number of different guild amenities, such as alchemy terminals, shops and more\!
 Guild Halls require a large amount of resources to maintain, which is represented by a weekly upkeep cost in Crowns. As a Guild Hall gains more expansions, this cost increases, so make sure there's enough Crowns in your Guild Treasury to pay for everything\!

mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_danger:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

On behalf of Impostoclaus, Spiral HQ has located the base of operations of the nefarious Grinchlins. It's time to take the fight to them and end their Winterfest terrorism once and for all. But it won't be an easy task. 

Those who accept this mission must climb Mount Krampus, a perilous trek filled with Grinchlin ambushes and icy deathtraps. Along the way you will find shelters that allow you to collect Grinchlin treasures and escape the mountain, or press on toward the summit for even greater rewards\! Just be warned\: Grinchlins and their allies are a stingy lot and will not drop ANY loot. All the treasures to be found on Mount Krampus are at the shelters. And should you pass on them for greater rewards ahead, you risk losing everything if you fail\! 

Some say that on the very summit of Mount Krampus lies a stash of Grinchlin loot that may contain treasures none have ever seen before...

uplink.properties|m.firestorm_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, at your current depth establishing communications is difficult- I hope you receive this message.  You currently stand in the Firestorm Citadel, some kind of ancient fortress that this planet apparently like to collect.  It is an incredibly hostile region of the Clockworks, you will not last long without the right gear and a talented squad. 

We have detected a faint signal that indicates some kind of artifact of the Alpha Squad's expedition is located within the throne room of this citadel.  We need you to recover this artifact- it could be a valuable clue for discovering their current whereabouts. 

I won't lie to you, no squad that has taken this mission has managed to return from the citadel.  As you have no doubt seen, the place burns with an unnatural fire and a legion of similarly unnatural horrors roam every hall.  Now may be a good time to turn back and craft some fire-resistant gear.  A trial by fire will only get you burned. 

Good luck\!

Unlike other monsters, constructs don't seem capable of reproducing on their own, meaning that any time one is deconstructed, it's a permanent dent in their numbers. It will be a worthwhile task regardless of Crimson Order influence or not. 

Spiral HQ is requesting that you enter these levels, investigate the possible hideout, and eliminate the construct threat. 

It is highly recommended that you equip yourself with elemental resistant gear with elemental and shadow damage weapons\!

mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.

mission.properties|o.mission_sprite_2: Secure a cache of battle sprites and return them to the Lab
item.properties|f.arctic_acolyte_hood: A hood said to be worn by wandering arctic acolytes. 'we saw them heading straight towards the mountains, off into the interior of the vast frozen continent, but why?'
helptips.properties|m.party_nosplit_warn: WARNING\! You may not split your party during this mission.
item.properties|f.clockworks_armor: Forged from girders, gears, scrap, and pipes found in the Clockworks. Walk the catwalk... wearing the catwalk\!
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Hail, Vanguard. It will be a rough road ahead of us but I am confident that we are up to the challenge.
item.properties|f.freeze_raider_helm: A fur lined helmet, sure to keep you warm on a winter raid.
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_1: This is Wegner, Chief Geo Knight of the Skylark. I'm picking up a high concentration of mineral deposits in your area.
item.properties|f.warmaster_helm_3: A remake of a mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus of the Crimson Order.  This perfect recreation bears the terrible likeness of Seerus himself, serving as a dark memento of Operation Crimson Hammer.
item.properties|f.prize_box_dangerous: Contains various unique items used by Desna's elite Recon Rangers. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.everfrost: A small patch of ice crystals that never seem to melt, even when exposed to direct heat.
projectx.properties|m.confirm_clear: Are you sure you want to clear ALL your saved game options? \nThis includes video options and all keyboard and control mappings.
mission.properties|m.great_escape_1a: Surprise\! Looks like you took the bait. That's good, because I needed test subjects for my latest invention.
item.properties|f.prize_box_stranger: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Stranger style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.ticket_unbind_0: Use this ticket at the Unbinding Forge to unbind a 0 star item.
mission.properties|m.elig_ok_replay: You are eligible to replay this mission.
chat.properties|m.usage_broadcast: Usage\: /{0} message\nBroadcasts message to everyone online.
help.properties|m.monster_gremlin: Deal ELEMENTAL - Weak to SHADOW - Strong against ELEMENTAL
mission.properties|r.best_of_beast_3a: Roger that Hahn, talk to you soon.
item.properties|f.shadow_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who gain their powers using forbidden, dark arts.
social.properties|m.empty_feed: No recent event activity. Check back later.
uplink.properties|m.bid_outbid: Visit the Auction House for another chance at this item\!
projectx.properties|m.save_offer: In order to save the knight that you have created, you must create an account to use when logging into the game.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_4a: The Apocrea bend reality, twisting the environment they invade into a trap. In these traps they stalk any life, harvesting their souls for some unimaginable purpose.
mission.properties|b.whipping_mishandlin: After Recon Knights discovered a fiendish city known as Sol' Fork, Spiral HQ deployed a research team to station itself in the heart of the city and study the devilites within.  Their findings have become the basis for our understanding of devilite culture and their motives for working with gremlins. \n\nThis research team is in desperate need of supplies in order to maintain working on-site.  It would be of great help to Spiral HQ's continued research to have a squad enter the city and deliver the necessary supplies.
item.properties|m.insufficient_crystals: Insufficient crystals to forge this item.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_slime: Deliver a shipment of rock salt to the research team stationed in the lichenous lair\!
uplink.properties|m.subject: SUBJECT
mission.properties|r.darkest_depths_1a: Thank you Kora, I'm just as glad as anyone to have Haven safe once more.
item.properties|f.vile_striker: A sneaky saber that stores a payload of poison. Its serrated edge is not meant for cutting bread\!
item.properties|f.perplexing_element: A rare metal recovered from a shattered mountain deep within the realm of the Apocrea. Under a microscope it reveals to have a kind of impossible geometry. Perhaps more dedicated study, free from the distractions of the world would reveal its secrets.
conversation.properties|r.emberlight_vis: Why is King Tinkinzar trying to destroy Haven?
mission.properties|o.shopping_again_b: Follow Bechamel on a tour of the Bazaar's more advanced offerings
item.properties|f.proto_duelist: A six-shot firearm preferred by the marksmen of Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.fusion_blaster: An enhanced elemental blaster designed to banish creatures that lurk in the shadows.
chat.properties|m.usage_lbroadcast: Usage\: /{0} (en fr it de es) message\nBroadcasts message to everyone using the specified language.
mission.properties|m.razwog_defeated: There is a strange crimson symbol on Razwog's clothing.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_ghost: Ghost blocks will destroy any blocks connected to them, even unbreakable blocks\!
item.properties|f.plasma_cell: A high-tech plasma source that could positively blind someone with science.
item.properties|f.sacred_guerrilla_armor: A sturdy suit of armor for those who want to bring down some beasts.
item.properties|f.spiraltail_mask: A simple simian mask made to celebrate the new year. Your sly shenanigans are sure to become a spectacle.
item.properties|f.brute_jelly_helm: A hardy helm crafted from overly oppressive ooze.
item.properties|f.fireburst_brandish: An upgraded Brandish infused with the elemental essence of fire.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_1a: You made it, {0}\!  I'm happy to see you arrive here in Haven safe and sound.  I'll confirm with Spiral HQ that you will now be undertaking missions in Haven.  To start, I've issued you a few missions that will help get you acclimated with all that Haven has to offer.  Be sure to say hello to the Strangers as you begin exploring.
mission.properties|m.toxic_plant_2b: All traces of Compound 42 should be eliminated, along with the facility and any engineers not part of the inner fold. Remind the scorchers who find these orders uncomfortable that those who disobey shall soon hear my whisper in their ears. \n\nSeal the doors and burn everything to the ground.
mission.properties|m.tortodrone_1a:
[All] Important Employee Reminder\: 

An ID Card is required to access the staging area. Properly presenting the ID Card will consume it to power the Grim Gate. Remember\: "When you Use it, you Lose it." 

ID Cards not used in this manner ("lost, broken, or misplaced") will need to be reissued by HR. The cost for a card replacement will be deducted from your next paycheck and a black mark will be added to your employee file. Don't let this happen to you. Don't lose your ID Card. 

Cheers, 
Morgral'm 
Assistant Supervisor of Resource Allocations, Undercorp
conversation.properties|m.energy_info_3b: Energy is used for all sorts of things\! It's the primary currency for buying goods from the Supply Depot, it allows you to purchase upgrades for yourself, revive yourself in the Clockworks when you run out of Sparks of Life, and it's required to form a guild. \n\nYou'll also find all sorts of devices in the world that are powered up by using energy. Just look for the blue energy symbol on the device.
item.properties|f.clockblocker: A mechanical shield with machined wheels, pinions, and gears that mesh with exacting tolerances, making it a precision timekeeping instrument.
item.properties|f.armor_front: An accessory that can be attached to the front of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
item.properties|f.graviton_vortex: A Graviton Bomb fortified with potentially dangerous amounts of shadow steel. Its blast should draw your foes toward it... if it doesn't rip the entire universe in two, that is.
chat.properties|m.user_disconnected: That user has been disconnected for {0}.
item.properties|f.rock_salt: A small amount of Clockworks mineral that's been infused with absolutely nothing. It hungrily draws at nearby essences and flavors, making it a staple in cooking, and the bane of jellies everywhere.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_5: A sprite's appetite will increase naturally over time, though slowly. To increase appetite quickly, take it for a run in the Clockworks. Absorbing heat from monsters is a great way to burn calories\!
item.properties|f.blue_shard: A shard of Moonstone that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
mission.properties|o.built_to_destroy: Dismantle the Roarmulus Twins in the heart of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory
item.properties|f.confetti_bubbles: Use this item to blow a cloud of bubbles into the air. See how long they last before they pop\!
item.properties|f.veteran_door: Installs a force barrier at the entrance of the room that can only be passed by guild members of Veteran rank and up.
mission.properties|m.occurance_at_owlite:
...This world has seen few greater tragedies than the fall of the great Kingdom of Almire.  Once a vibrant, beautiful realm of lush forests and sweeping plains... 

...neighboring kingdoms declared war... 

...seeking the power needed to turn the tide, Lord Vanaduke of Almire fled into the mountains...
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_danger: The Grinchlins have sabotaged Winterfest for the last time. Take the fight to them\!
item.properties|f.pathfinder_armor: A handy set of armor for blazing trails and protecting against the bites of hungry monsters in the wild.
guild.properties|i.guild_shop: Purchase guild furnishings and upgrades using funds from the Guild Treasury.
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_short_gr: A short, elegant street lamp that emits a green glow with a gentle hiss.
item.properties|f.exp_west_1f: An expansion that adds two rooms to the western side of the Guild Hall.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_d: I have to keep these new recruits out of trouble.
item.properties|f.metal_sonic_suit: A meticulously engineered suit of armor that is said to be equipped with a an ultra-powerful V. Max Overdrive Unit.
item.properties|f.vial_shock_super: An ornate glass vial containing hyper-charged electric fluids. It can be used to inflict enemies with Shock.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and give your foes a real ZAP\!
item.properties|f.shard_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in depleted Crimsonite. Depleted or not, this sucker can sling some serious shrapnel.
conversation.properties|r.core_tech_1: I'd like to know how I can help.
item.properties|f.iron_dragon_armor: Armor once worn by a member of the 'Iron Dragons,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
mission.properties|o.plan_of_attack: Recover the gremlin schematics in the secret test lab
item.properties|f.almire_bench: A balanced bench built for Almirian officials.
item.properties|f.phial_phear: A glass tube containing a small dose of phearium, a strange chemical said to induce panic into anyone who even gets so much as a whiff of the stuff.
item.properties|f.punkin_cinnamug: A frothy blend of punkins and cinnamon that is sure to burn those that don't wait for this mug to cool.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Battlepod \nThese immobile automatons hide a small arsenal beneath their double plated armor. Each Battlepod has a unique combination of attacks and defenses sure to keep you guessing.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.
exchange.properties|m.mobile_tooltip: Opens a page in your browser where you can buy Energy with your mobile phone.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_battlesta: A magnificent display commemorating a knight's ascension to the highest echelon of the Spiral Order.
item.properties|f.kat_tribe_fetish: A tattered fetish from the now-extinct Kat Tribe, the ferocious feline warriors responsible for the destruction of the Owlites and their prestigious High Academy of Magicks. The fetishes were carried into battle by Kat warriors and are said to bring good luck despite the ill fate of the Kat Tribe itself.
item.properties|f.raider_helm: A pristine raider helmet, save for a few dings.
mission.properties|r.eye_of_needle_5a: Roger that.  So you've got some missions lined up for me?
conversation.properties|r.atg_greeter_2a: Thanks\! I'm off to explore now.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_construct: Destroy the operational war machines within the ruined factory\!
conversation.properties|m.casino_jelly_b: I just got back from debarber, can you tell?
item.properties|f.advanced_cautery_sword: A Cautery Sword with an additional saw function adapted to cutting through the bony spines of larger Lichen Colonies.
item.properties|f.prize_box_autumn: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in an Autumn style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|o.operation_crimson_h: Join Lieutenant Feron in a siege of the Grand Arsenal of Warmaster Seerus.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: The Swarm keeps growing stronger while The Sleeper grows weaker. Without us, all of us, The Swarm will win. Once, the gremlins were in charge of maintaining Cradle's defenses. But they had their own plans. We need to be Cradle's champions now. \n\nIt's our sacrifice.
sprites.properties|d.concussive_firebolt: Adds a chance for a powerful stun to the firebolt.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeresea: It's even more beautiful down here\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogmas: Trespassers within my Arsenal?  I'll see to it you go... quietly.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roya: A jolly piece of jewelry formerly borne by the Royal Jelly himself. It is jauntily perched on a gelatinous pillow.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_r3: Meet with Biscotti in her kitchen and provide 'baking assistance.'
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: Shh, don't tell anyone I'm here.
helptips.properties|m.tut_lever: Doors can often be opened by finding the right switch. Try hitting this switch with your handgun\!
conversation.properties|r.hunter_2a: Ah, so it's a team effort?
exchange.properties|m.cvc_info: Your credit card security code is the last 3 or 4 digits found on the back of your credit card in the signature box.
item.properties|f.irontech_bomb: A heavy bomb wrapped in thick iron plates. Though it is slower than most bombs, it packs a powerful punch.
item.properties|f.ionized_salt_bomb: A solid chunk of rock salt with an explosive surprise inside. Jellies hate surprises.
monster.properties|m.punkin_intro_2: What does the Punkin King have for thee...?
item.properties|f.gold_wolf_hood: A helm once worn by a member of the 'Gold Wolves,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
conversation.properties|r.dark_harvest_e: Sounds like fun\!  I'm off to find the Punkin King\!
item.properties|f.silver_key: A special key that can open any lockbox.  Once used, the key is destroyed.
item.properties|f.token_winter_wishlist: This Winterfest wishlist was lost long ago. It lists warm linens that protect from the snow. Randolph will reward those knights with a stack. So bring them to him and earn a present back.
auction.properties|m.start_recipe: Select a learned recipe to search for the ingredients.
mission.properties|b.faith_armor:
An apprentice named Wilks who had just arrived from a Rescue Camp has found himself in what Spiral HQ calls a 'Trap Chamber.'  These levels of most likely gremlin design seem to be specifically built to trap and ultimately eliminate those attempting to explore the Clockworks. 

Wilks probably didn't know what he had got himself into until it was too late.  Now he's stuck somewhere in the chamber and needs your help. 

Some traps can be avoided and sometimes you may find that you just have to take the hit. In saving Wilks, you will no doubt learn the true value of strong armor.
item.properties|f.wild_dust: A portion of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
item.properties|f.sinister_skelly_shield: A kite shield haunted by a benevolent ghost. It should help you put up a spirited defense against shadow.
item.properties|f.ignition_helm: A lightweight helmet augmented to keep a knight's head cool under pressure.
item.properties|f.rugged_robo_wrecker: An upgraded robo wrecker that has assisted a great many constructs in becoming smoldering, scrap metal heaps.
item.properties|m.item_lockable: This item will bind to you when equipped.\n
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_3a: I'm glad you asked, they certainly do\!  Let's head over to Vatel.
conversation.properties|m.hav_clock_3a: It is hard to know exactly as so much of what is within seems to hold their origin from different worlds. Some appear to be from realms of great antiquity, no doubt once home to innumerable old gods and creatures.\n\nThis world is an unnatural one. What you see within it was never meant to be here. The great histories of so many worlds endlessly churning through the cogs of this great machine... I find it quite sad.
item.properties|f.capsule_health_super: A capsule that restores a large amount of health. An adventurer's best friend\!
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_8: Yes indeed\!  That's because every time you transmute an item through alchemy, there is a chance you can get one of several Unique Variants that makes your item much more powerful\!
chat.properties|m.usage_sprite_power: Usage\: /{0} skill power value\nUpdates a sprite skill's power value.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: B-beware...they...they are everywhere...in the shadows...\!
guild.properties|i.buy_environments: Change the environment for the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_housepla: A jolly green plant inside a cheerful pot.
helptips.properties|m.zone: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to exit current zone.
item.properties|f.phantamos: A powerful handgun brimming with dark energy. The Phantamos represents one of the most recent additions to the Spiral Knight's arsenal, as containing shadow energy of this degree took a great deal of research.
item.properties|f.gorgomega: A terrifying shield that combines the dual-crushing power of a gorgo and the mythical tortomega. Crushing enemies has never been more fiendishly fun.
item.properties|m.pvp_token_upgrade.n: Gives {0} extra Krogmo Coins in PvP.
item.properties|m.trinket_tip_locked: Trinket Slot (Buy Trinket Slot Upgrade to Unlock)
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_3_11: I'll put an end to their scheme.
conversation.properties|m.rc_instruct_1a: Greetings, recruit.  Always good to see another knight make it to the Rescue Camp.  I imagine you're looking to prepare for your journey to Haven.  A good place to start is the gate here into the Clockworks.  Simply approach the control panel at the north end of the lift and press the action button ([[?ACTION]]).\n\nAny questions?
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_9a: Why yes, given their outward appearance I think 'maskeraith' suits them nicely\!
mission.properties|m.shadowplay_1a: Too late again\! I have already collected the power I need to use the Artifact and nothing you can do now will stop what I have set in motion.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_0_1a: Well met, {0}. This is the Hall of Heroes, where veteran knights come to offer their services to members of our order who have attained the rank of Soldier or higher. \n\nBy undertaking more missions, I am confident that you will one day stand among us.
mission.properties|b.frostifur_fandango: Spiral HQ is receiving numerous reports of squads being wiped out by a pack of wolvers known as 'the Snowclaw Pack' near depth 10.  These ferocious frostifurs have an icy bite and are very territorial. Due to their relentless attacks, Spiral HQ is requesting an experienced squad infiltrate their den and destroy them to prevent any further casualties. \n\nIt is advised that you prepare yourself with piercing damage and freeze resistant gear before deploying.
conversation.properties|r.hunter_1a: I've seen my share of danger, and I like it.
pvp.properties|m.upload_wait: A file picking window is trying to show...
dungeon.properties|m.training_1_desc: Explore this derelict portion of the Clockworks and learn the basics required for survival.
item.properties|f.polar_night_warden_hoo: An insulated hood that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The full coverage mask makes it ideal for hours of nighttime watch duty.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: {0}, this is almost certainly a trap and I can't ask you to come with me, but I'm going in there. If there's even a chance that Rulen and the other Alpha Squad members are alive I need to try and find them.
item.properties|f.honor_shield_2: A ceremonial shield issued to seasoned Spiral Knights. Though intended for formal occasions, its solid construction makes it suitable for combat use.
item.properties|f.khorovod: A low-tech, but nonetheless well-made sword whose brutal strikes can stun unsuspecting enemies. Wielding it makes you feel like dancing.
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_1a: Come in, {0}\! I can't believe it\! I lost your signal completely when you entered the Core Terminal. What happened down there?
chat.properties|m.usage_party: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message to all party members.
conversation.properties|m.npc_mineraltec: I'm a field researcher working under Chief Geo Knight Wegner.
chat.properties|m.usage_fallback: Usage\: /{0}\nTell your comrades to fall back.
item.properties|f.cursed_idol: A small, stone statue carved into the form of one of the thousands of arch fiends of the Underworld. The shadowy surface color seems to move and shift like smoke.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2b: As a sprite levels up, they will learn new combat skills as well as gain skill points.
item.properties|f.dark_briar_barrage: A mythical object that can explode with the fury of the Snarbolax itself. The unearthly howl it produces is said to be more crippling than its blast.
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight2_1a: Emanations from this world's core have had strange effects on our battle sprites.
helptips.properties|m.loading14: Do not share your account information. Game Masters will never ask you for your password.
conversation.properties|m.sl_guard_1: Well met, knight.  Before you lies elevators leading to what Spiral HQ are calling 'Shadow Lairs.'  Shadow Lairs contain some of the most powerful monsters in the Clockworks, so be sure that you are fully Tier 3 equipped before going any further.
item.properties|f.silver_solstice_ring: An enchanted ring that embodies the spirit of the solstice. Its sparkling silver luster shines brightest during the winter months.
mission.properties|m.shadow_knows_2a: Spiral HQ has informed me that you are ready to learn about monsters that inflict shadow damage correct?
conversation.properties|r.tut_intro2_2a: Roger that, Rhendon.  I'm heading your way\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We saw the Gremlins hiding mines out there, watch your step\!
mission.properties|r.another_trace_3a: You can count on me, Kora.
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r9: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
mission.properties|b.rescues_and_recycli: A 'Deconstruction Zone' is a gremlin work site where gremlins seem to tear apart existing levels and use the components to build new levels. Their ability to rapidly engineer levels and machines is incredible, surpassed only by their hostility to anyone who crosses their path. \n\nRecon Knights have discovered that a squad may have observed their engineering marvels a little too closely as they are now being held captive in one of the deconstruction sites near depth 10.  It is unclear what the gremlins have in store for these knights or if they simply plan on letting them perish along with the rest of the level they are dismantling.
item.properties|f.proto_shield: A small shield issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.haze_burst: A powerful alchemical bomb that produces a dense cloud of intensely disorienting material.
item.properties|f.coin_bonus_upgrade_1: Once used, this upgrade will increase Coins earned in Coliseum games by 1 for 24 hours.  You may have up to 6 Krogmo Coin Boosters active at any time.
uplink.properties|m.items_expired: You have items that have expired. Items can be repurchased from the Supply Depot.
item.properties|f.moonstone_deposit_2: A good-sized mineral deposit that will generate several units of moonstone.
mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_2: Mount Krampus is the home of the Grinchlin faction and their allies. They are a very stingy lot and won't drop any loot themselves. All their treasures are stored in the shelters you'll find up the mountain.
mission.properties|b.operation_crimson_h:
Warmaster Seerus is the evil master of munitions within the gremlin's all-powerful Crimson Order  Thought to be the true mastermind behind the Roarmulus Twins and countless other gremlin weapons, he is the Crimson Order's creator and supplier for their diabolical engines of war. 

Recon Knights under the command of Lieutenant Feron recently discovered Seerus's 'Grand Arsenal,' his development center and storage facility for all his weaponry.  Now, Feron himself is leading several squads of knights directly into the Grand Arsenal, with the intention of weeding out Seerus and destroying his war machines. 

Met with heavy resistance, Feron's squads require reinforcements and Spiral HQ is sending you in to assist.
item.properties|f.frenzy_warrior_helm: A helm worn by a fabled sword master so fast, his frenzy alone could fell armies before they rose against him.
item.properties|f.valestone: A fabled mineral of a vibrant, green color said to contain the essence of all natural life.
uplink.properties|m.returned: Your attachment was never accepted\n\nOriginal mail\: {0}
dungeon.properties|m.scarlet_fortress_de: Named for its vibrant tapestries, the Scarlet Fortress is a deconstructed mass of a forgotten castle, drifting endlessly in the void of the Clockworks. Strange bestial ghosts haunt its long corridors, tirelessly pursuing those that enter their domain.
dungeon.properties|m.dark_city_desc: This once bustling city from an advanced world is now home to innumerable fiends from the Underworld. Under the light of the moon they burn their dark sigils into the ground, summoning more of their cohorts for reasons yet unknown.
item.properties|f.mighty_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it, you can feel the berserk energies within just waiting to be unleashed.
projectx.properties|m.reboot_warning: The server will be rebooted in {0} minutes. {1}
item.properties|m.accessory_multi: This accessory occupies two locations\: {0} and {1}.
item.properties|f.grand_tortoise: A shield empowered by the limitless fury of a tortodrone. The very plates of this colossal carapace shake as the unstable energy within waits to be unleashed.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Good luck in there, we know you can do it\!
conversation.properties|m.casino_bouncer: Only C.U.B.E. Club members may access the High Wobbler Lounge.
mission.properties|o.securing_camp_b: Help Rhendon destroy the monsters that invaded the Rescue Camp\!
item.properties|f.gigawatt_pulsar: A powerfully enhanced handgun that hits foes with the force of a lightning bolt. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
item.properties|f.great_defender: A sturdy Defender upgraded with its own internal energy source for more effective protection.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_wandering_ro: A festive new years snipe that will explore its surroundings.
item.properties|f.holiday_hat: A festive cap that carries with it the warm spirit of the holidays. It smells faintly of gingerbread.
mission.properties|b.go_shopping: The Haven Bazaar is a place where all manners of item-related goods and services can be found.  Whether you're in the market for a more powerful sword or just want to make your armor stand out in a crowd, it's got what you need\!
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_3a: A battle sprite is an AI-driven construct capable of reconnaissance and light combat support.  Battle sprites are highly adaptable.  Their AI allows them to acutely observe their surroundings and aid their knight in the most optimal way.
mission.properties|m.target_acquired_4a: There's one last thing- it seems you won't be the first knight to have entered the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.  We've detected another Alpha Squad recon module somewhere within the factory.  Please attempt to recover it.  I hope that analysis proves that Euclid's squad made it out of there alive...

mission.properties|m.go_shopping_6a: Here we have an alchemy station that you'll no doubt become very familiar with as you upgrade your arsenal. conversation.properties|m.rc_soil_1a: I'm collecting geological samples for Spiral HQ. So far my tests are identifying hundreds of unique soil samples within every inch of the ground below our feet. This can't be possible, I must have miscalculated...
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_1_2: Our advance has ground to a halt because of that artillery on the walls pinning us down.  Earlier, we staged a diversion to allow a small squad of knights to break through the front to silence that artillery...but they seem to have failed.  Now they're trapped in there, and we're stuck out here\! \n\nI need you to break through the front lines, get inside the artillery control center, and find a way to take out those cannons for good\!  Meanwhile, I'll get the troops reorganized so we can follow up your assault.  Good luck in there, soldier\!

mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.

mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!

mission.properties|m.ending_in_fire_3a: We thought things were getting pretty predictable, even at the depths you've been exploring.  The Core was in sight.  But now some kind of massive negative energy anomaly has surfaced above the Core, blocking access to it.  Recon Knights have said that all they see near it is fire, endless fire. \n\nWe don't know what it is just yet, but squads near that depth have already gone missing.  This is bad news.

conversation.properties|m.fc_court_2: I am a sprite, a force of nature summoned to this realm to extinguish the unnatural fire that is consuming it. But Vanaduke discovered and imprisoned us. I managed to escape, but the other sprites remain in his custody.\n\nNow none may proceed beyond the court as columns of shadow fire block all exits. Shadow fire can only be extinguished with the water that flows from these spirit wells. The water is the purest found in all of nature, flowing directly from the springs within the realm of the Spirit Mother herself.

mission.properties|b.p_r6_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!

mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
helptips.properties|m.bramble: Some areas are overgrown with bramble that will hurt you if you run through it\!
mission.properties|b.choose_your_sprite: Morlin has prepared three of the battle sprites you rescued for you to evaluate. guildhelp.properties|m.emporium_info:
The Birdsong Emporium allows high-ranking guild members to purchase items for the guild using funds from the Guild Treasury. These items include various Guild Hall furniture items and upgrades. Purchased items go directly into the Guild Treasury, and thus cannot ever be removed from the guild.
 Furniture comes in a variety of types and sizes and is used to decorate your Guild Hall's rooms and halls to make them feel more like home. Some furniture even has special effects when activated\! Any furniture currently in your Guild Treasury can be placed into the Guild Hall using Design Mode.

Wow, this thing is a massive tower of everfrost.  I've only ever seen little handfuls of the stuff, nothing close to what we're seeing here. 

The intel we've collected so far suggests that fiends utilize large deposits of the stuff to trap the souls of the lost within it, like some kind of icy prison.

uplink.properties|m.ironclaw_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, we have intercepted gremlin transmissions from this facility that indicate they are building some kind of weapon to destroy Haven\!  It is your mission to infiltrate the facility, destroy this weapon and save Haven from destruction\! 

Known only as 'Project Roarmulus,' it is said to be impenetrable from standard attacks.  You will have to find a way to break whatever armor it is using.  Intel suggests this weapon is located deep within the facility. 

But getting to it won't be easy.  You will find that gremlins have little care for a safe work environment as live rockets seem to be fired every which way at all times.  However you should be able to utilize the 'polarity walls' you will find in testing environments to block the oncoming rockets.  Look for a purple and gold switch to toggle them. 

We've also detected another Recon Module of the Alpha Squad somewhere in this factory.  Retrieve it if you can\! 

Good luck\!

support.properties|m.subheader_step209:
Sometimes we make a mistake when trading with players. This happens to all of us.

But Game Masters can't know what the agreement with the trade was. One player could claim this wasn't what was agreed on, while the other could claim it was. And we can't just blindly pick a side. So we have to rely on players double checking what they're trading before they click to confirm.

So if you just made a trade you didn't really mean to, then I'm afraid Game Masters won't be able to assist you. Instead you'll want to talk to the other player and see if the player is nice enough to reverse the trade.

Also remember never to trade anything away "as a loan" unless you are OK with this player not returning the item. Game Masters won't be able to recover it for you.

Ok, back to business then. 

Punch can add Unique Variants, a kind of special bonus to your weapons and gear for a price. But his methods are, er... chaotic.  You never really know what you're going to get. 

Vise is a little more precise.  He can unbind your weapons and gear for a price, allowing you to sell or gift the item again\!
item.properties|f.super_shard_bomb: A shard bomb stuffed with even more depleted Crimsonite. The choicest cure for a combative creature is clearly a crystal to the cranium.
mission.properties|r.darkest_forces_2a: They weren't exactly easy going to begin with...
item.properties|f.super_blast_bomb: An upgraded Blast Bomb that combines an unstable heat source with untested explosive material to make one seriously unsafe package.
item.properties|f.cosmic_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
support.properties|m.subheader_step205: You should not be sending a complaint against someone just because they sent a complaint against you.\n\nGame Masters will read through all complaints, and if you didn't break any rules in the complaint that was filed against you, then you don't need to worry.
item.properties|f.owlite_robe: A costume recreation of the fine robes worn by Owlites, based on the most recent archaeological findings.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.
social.properties|m.befriend_message: Enter an optional message to include with your friend request\:
chat.properties|m.usage_invite: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nInvites a player into your current party.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_b_: Great, thanks for being a good ambassador\! \n\nI'll contact you again soon, good luck {0}\!
steam.properties|m.invite_friends:
Invite your friends to join your adventure\! 

For each friend you invite that plays you will receive a free Spark of Life\! 

Invite 5 friends and get an exclusive costume helm, The Steam Knight Helm\! 
This fancy steampunk-inspired knight helm is only obtainable as an invitation reward.
item.properties|f.prize_box_frenzy: Contains various unique costumes and accessories crafted from thunder and lightning. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
chat.properties|m.usage_set_rank: Usage\: /{0} rank subrank\nSet your rank and subrank.
item.properties|f.chroma_mask: A mask crafted from the hide of a chromalisk, offering the wearer its distinguished look.
conversation.properties|m.npc_lostknight: It's good to know Spiral HQ hasn't forgotten about me.
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_3b: All gremlins belonging to the colony serve King Tinkinzar. Tinkinzar is said to be a great ruler and mechanical genius, responsible for the vision of the whole of the Clockworks. It is our understanding however that the king is never seen by common gremlins, but instead his orders are delivered and carried out by his Crimson Order, a fearful and zealous band of gremlins who alone share audience with the great king.
chat.properties|m.usage_depth: Usage\: /{0} [depth]\nSets the depth of the current level (and subsequent levels).
social.properties|m.friend_party_booted: You have been banned from {0}'s party.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_torin: A fading inscription reads\: Here lies Torin, knight of Almire.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We've broken through their defenses.  Now they're cornered\!
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_4a: Accept my mission and let's get to work blowing some stuff up\!
item.properties|f.dangerous_diablo_helm: A helm worn by members of the Recon Rangers. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of a demon said to have broken off its own horn to use as a weapon when it faced its end.
item.properties|f.warm_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within burns strong enough that it feels warm to the touch.
auction.properties|m.no_search: Your search did not match any auctions.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_4_3b: I'm sorry {0}, but you currently do not meet the necessary requirements. Please speak to me again when you are currently equipped with a 5 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
item.properties|f.haze_bomb: An alchemical bomb that creates a noxious cloud capable of stunning those caught inside.
mission.properties|b.heart_of_matter: Lieutenant Vaelyn led the first squad into the Clockworks that attempted to located the Alpha Squad.  She is a talented squad leader thought to be on par with Euclid himself.  Vaelyn has never given up her search and is now attempting to put together an on-site Core research team in order to better understand the very place where the Alpha Squad's trail is thought to end.
helptips.properties|m.atg_traps: Watch your step\!  Wait until TRAPS are down before walking over them.
item.properties|f.spiral_plate_mail: Heavyweight armor made of iron plates that can withstand a great deal of standard attacks.
sprites.properties|d.hexing_haze: Creates a miasma around you that hexes any target within. Each hex has a timer that deals damage to its target upon termination. For every target acquired by hexing haze, the duration of the miasma increases.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_3a: Sadly, even with our link to the Spirit Mother restored we can only do so much to save this place. Yet, even as one path closes another might open. It is the nature of this shifting world.  Good fortune, star-borne.
item.properties|f.stoic_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it, you sense the quiet passing of the wind and can call upon the rumbling storm that follows.
dungeon.properties|m.aurora_isles_desc: From atop mysterious floating islands, sun bleached ruins crumble under a false sky. Though the green grass and cool air feels real enough, the ever present grinding of the machine just below the surface is a constant reminder of this world's mechanical skeleton.
item.properties|f.sweet_dreams: Don't be fooled by this weapon's fluffy exterior. It hits much harder than it looks. The perfect weapon for fighting things that go bump in the night.
item.properties|f.poison_barrier: Surrounds you with toxic orbs that can cripple hostiles
sprites.properties|d.vengeful_shadow_clo: Creates an explosive disruption field around you when shadow cloak is interrupted that has a chance to stun targets.
pvp.properties|m.bribe_description: Everyone can pitch in to bribe King Krogmo. Fill the meter with energy to reveal a BONUS PRIZE\!
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Well, guess it's time to be a hero again. Shall we?
chat.properties|m.usage_auction: Go to the Auction House in Haven.
conversation.properties|m.em_greeter_1a: Welcome to Emberlight, sanctuary for outcast gremlins.
conversation.properties|m.npc_campknight: Come get warm by the fire.
mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r6: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
item.properties|f.super_crystal_bomb: A shard bomb stuffed with even more alloy. Apply directly to your foe's head.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_7a: (You sense great pride coming from the fallen knight, but he says no more and stares off into the distance towards a lifetime that only he sees.)
item.properties|f.helm_brow: An accessory that can be attached to the brow of select helmets.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_cardho: Please enter your entire name as it appears on your credit card.
item.properties|f.padded_demo_helm: An upgraded helm for bombers that is lined with soft, stimulating padding.
item.properties|f.prize_box_rose_regalia: Contains various unique Rose Regalia costumes and accessories. Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
guild.properties|m.not_in_guild: Sorry, you're not presently in a guild.
mission.properties|o.reporting_duty: Report to Lieutenant Feron in the Haven Arcade
item.properties|f.electron_bomb: Adapted from several unconventional Gremlin theories on physics, anyone unlucky enough to be dragged into this bomb's blast is in for a shock.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_undead: The ruins of Owlite castles are dark and cursed places that are swarming with legions of undead spookats.  The worst of these, the seemingly invincible grimalkins, constantly lurk in the shadows, awaiting the moment your life-saving light is finally snuffed out. \n\nSome knights succumb to the darkness and become paralyzed with fear in these shadowy realms. The only thing that can save them are brave knights who have long lost their childhood fears of the dark and all the terrible creatures that lurk within.
item.properties|f.sacred_pathfinder_armo: A reinforced suit of double padded armor that is sure to stop the sharpest of foes.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_15: I'd like to see the shops. (Follow Tylen)
item.properties|f.sacred_hex_helm: A phantasmal helm for those who are aiming for the infernal.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_button: If a door won't open, search under blocks for a hidden floor button to open it.
item.properties|f.vial_poison_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing debilitating toxins. It can be used to inflict enemies with Poison.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and wither the attack power of your foes\!
sprites.properties|d.firestorm: Summon the power of true dragon fire to burn everything in your path.
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_2a: My knowledge is yours, little one.
sprites.properties|d.plentiful_pain: Increases the bonus duration of hexing haze as additional targets are acquired.
item.properties|f.slicer: Energy spikes go in. Flying razor disks of barely-understood primordial energy come hurtling out\!  And look out for that extra-peppy boomerang effect...
item.properties|f.trinket_slot_upgrade: Once used, this upgrade opens a trinket slot for {0} days.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_1c: No thanks, I'll explore on my own.
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_9a: Where do I find accessory tickets?
item.properties|f.vial_poison_super: An ornate glass vial containing debilitating toxins. It can be used to inflict enemies with Poison.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and wither the attack power of your foes\!
item.properties|f.lightning_capacitor: An upgraded Capacitor that can explode with the fury of an electrical storm.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_2: Ok, here is the gist of it all- collect materials and recipes and turn them into weapons and gear.  Easy right?
conversation.properties|m.rc_warning_1a: Up these stairs lies the gate to Haven. Be sure to talk to Virgil before you enter so you know what to expect.
dungeon.properties|m.rc_bomb_training_de: Just beyond the perimeter of the Rescue Camp is a field of ruined equipment and overrun defenses.  The surviving knights abandoned this area after a series of deadly attacks during the night.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_mat_5: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.spiral_demo_suit: Sturdy armor designed for use by explosively-inclined knights.
mission.properties|r.best_of_beast_1a: Well thanks Hahn, it's almost as if-
item.properties|f.winged_helm: A helm whose design evokes an almost heavenly beauty.
mission.properties|b.toy_soldiers: Recon Knights are reporting much greater numbers of mecha knights in the first stratum of the Clockworks and have discovered a mecha knight production facility close to Haven. \n\nMecha knights are believed to be gremlin-engineered sentries of the construct family that share many of the capabilities of a Spiral Knight.  Proceed with caution when seeking out the production center and then shut it down for good\!
helptips.properties|m.loading8: If you become frozen you will not be able to move or turn, but you can still attack. If adventuring with others, ask them to chip away at the ice with their best attacks.
mission.properties|m.great_escape_3a: One was clearly not enough last time... so now there are two\! TWO\! Brilliant\!
item.properties|f.slime_key: A slippery key that can only open a Slime Lockbox.  Once used, the key is destroyed.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_3a: Great, thanks for being a good ambassador\! \n\nLastly I need to get you up to speed on something called 'energy.'  It's very important to your mission here on Cradle.
conversation.properties|m.seerus_1: Is it power you seek? The fury of a burning star bound in steel? I will show you both\!
item.properties|f.stellar_sentinel_suit: This suit was was once worn by Isoran starfarers of eons long passed that stood watch over extrasolar operations. With this equipped, you feel like you could dive into the heart of a star.
conversation.properties|m.rc_vet_3a: I won't be able to relax until we've linked up with Spiral HQ.
mission.properties|m.shocking_sentient_s: The Sparkcaster Deluxe is almost stable, I promise. I need a little more time, Warmaster.
helptips.properties|m.party_locked_warni: WARNING\! Upon using this elevator your party will be locked for the remainder of the mission.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_1a: Thought you could just walk away with the artifact did you?  Hand it over now or I'll light this fuse and turn you into a million, tiny, smoldering bits\!
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Amazing...I never thought I'd see another one of us ever again\! I'm glad to see you made it here safely.
item.properties|f.winter_pullover: A not-so-stylish sweater for the snowy season. The perfect pullover to embarass your family and guildmates alike.
exchange.properties|m.anonymous_purchasi: Purchasing is disabled until you create an account.
exchange.properties|m.tradefooter: Current offers are set by the players. If a suitable offer for you is not available, click the market tab to post your own.
item.properties|f.punkin_pie_pan: A hot steamy pie made from real gourdlings\! Not suitable for Knight consumption, please discard at nearest friend.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_6a: Bombs are special in that they have no standard attack.  A bomb can ONLY be used as a CHARGE ATTACK, so make sure to evade monsters while charging\! \n\nFeel free to give it a try.  Just remember to equip it at that arsenal station up ahead.
item.properties|f.exp_west_5f: An expansion that adds two rooms to the western side of the Guild Hall.
uplink.properties|m.metal_sonic: Thank you for purchasing Sonic CD on Steam\!  Attached is your Metal Sonic Suit and Mask.  These items are costumes that can be equipped over any armor allowing you to look like Metal Sonic whenever you like\! \n\nPlease note, gear can only be equipped in towns or at an Arsenal Station.  If you are a new recruit and have just emerged from your crash pod, make your way to the Rescue Camp.  Once you reach the Rescue Camp you can equip your Metal Sonic Suit and Mask.
item.properties|f.nefarious_hood: A hood said to be crafted by a nefarious imp. The floating rune is certain to cloak you during clandestine campaigns.
item.properties|f.venom_veiler: The ultimate in toxic dispersal devices, the Venom Veiler can be used to destroy pests on crops. Failing that, it can also be used to destroy crops.
helptips.properties|m.loading15: To add a friend to your friends list, simply click on that friend and choose "Add as Friend." To see the list of friends and what they are up to, click on the Social button.
item.properties|f.argent_peacemaker: An ancient handgun forged from sun silver. Its bullets serve as ushers for those that refuse to leave this world.
item.properties|f.volcanic_plated_sentin: A helm reinforced with volcanic plating to defend against a range of elements.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_5a:
Ok, back to business then. 

Punch can add Unique Variants, a kind of special bonus to your weapons and gear for a price. But his methods are, er... chaotic.  You never really know what you're going to get. 

Vise is a little more precise.  He can unbind your weapons and gear for a price, allowing you to sell or gift the item again\!
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft2_r9: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_snar: A long, razor-sharp tooth, proof that you encountered the fabled Snarbolax and survived to galumph back.
item.properties|f.clockworks_box: A celebration of all things related to the Clockworks\! Contains costumes and accessories built from the same girders, plates, cogs, and gears that make up the Clockworks deep within the planet of Cradle. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_1: You'll be alchemizing amazing items in no time\!  In fact, here are a couple of recipes to get you started.
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch:
Black kats are the darkest souls of the former Kat Tribe. They carry the heaviest curse of all and mindlessly seek to devour magical auras. This constant consuming of power makes them incredibly strong. 

They were likely attracted to the power radiating from the ancient grimoires here in the Archives. 

Please {0}, you must help us restore the Moorcroft Archives\!
helptips.properties|m.can_resurrect: You have been granted a Spark of Life by a party member. Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to revive.
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight1_1a: We salvaged what we could from the Skylark and cobbled together the rest with help from the Strangers.
item.properties|f.fiendglyph: A fragment of a Fiendish ID Card. Combining five different glyphs into an ID Card will allow you to open the Grim Gate in the Ancient Grove.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_stri: Greetings {0}, I'm Echo, a knight who utilizes gear fit for a squad striker.  The recipes I have for you produce weapons and gear that focus on rapid, close-quarters combat. \n\nThe arsenal of a striker focuses on speed.  You want to get in close with your enemy, hit them hard and get out.  The gear I specialize in will make you a knight that leaps into battle ahead of your squad, striking first before they can even fire off a shot.
mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_mat_3: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_9: Another strange device\! This one was clearly not made by the Almirians any more than the previous device was made by jellies. One thing we've noticed however\: this device is still active. On top of that, the energy signature is similar to the readings we took off the Artifact before it was stolen. This requires some further research I think.
exchange.properties|m.getenergy_tooltip_: Click here to complete your purchase.
item.properties|f.industrial_catalyzer: A Catalyzer modified to fire dangerously supercharged projectiles. Catalyzer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
sprites.properties|d.seraphic_aura: Party members within the protective aura gain increased shield regen.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: It'll take forever to decipher this gremlin cryptography...
mission.properties|m.advanced_alchemy_1a: We meet again, {0}.  Spiral HQ has asked me to introduce you to some advanced alchemy.  Don't worry, this won't take long.  I've got an old mecha knight to work on anyway.
craft.properties|e.wrong_item_group: Variant cannot be applied to this item type.
item.properties|f.freeze_barrier: Surrounds you with icy orbs that can freeze hostiles in their tracks
projectx.properties|d.achievement_bc04ed: Earn clearance to explore Tier 2 of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.rename_guild: Allows you to choose a new name for your guild. This item can only be used by a Guildmaster and is destroyed once used.
help.properties|m.controls_options: You can change your current control scheme from the Options menu.
sprites.properties|d.heavy_smoke: Increases the defensive power and duration of the flame barrier.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_gate_fiend: Free the captured Knights from a fiendish corporate prison\!
helptips.properties|m.loading4: Rare monsters offering unique items roam the Clockworks. Have you discovered any yet?
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_s:
We got enough that Anomalie let me mess around with a few. 

See, I had this handgun chassis from an old import.  Cool little launcher, but impossible to get parts for, especially the ammo. 

Well, with a little wrenching and a little creative misapplication of thermodynamics, I converted it into a pretty peppy little Spike Slicer\!
item.properties|f.furni_rainbow: A magnificent arc of refracted light. What does it mean?
item.properties|f.night_cap_pith: A comfortable cap for knights to wear at night. Sure to give the wearer a restorative night of sleep.
projectx.properties|m.spritelocked: SPRITE LOCKED\: Battle Sprites can be equipped, fed and skill points assigned in towns or at Arsenal Stations.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_b631f6: Power up a derelict Mecha Knight.
item.properties|f.jaws_megalodon: A fearsome helm made to resemble a deep sea monster.
item.properties|f.biohazard: Be sure to check your armor's seals thoroughly before engaging in the operation of this weapon, or you may end up as miserable as your foes. Biohazard bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
item.properties|f.purring_cap: A curious cap made to resemble a mewkat. It is said to grant the wearer nine lives.
conversation.properties|m.core_lead_4: I'm saying that we know this entire world isn't natural, and I for one don't believe that those hordes of miserable gremlins, no matter how industrious, could have built an entire world.  They had to have been aided by something far beyond their measure and perhaps whatever that is lies within the Core. \n\nThe same goes for the Alpha Squad.  They wouldn't just disappear, even within the furthest depths of the Clockworks.  They were our very best.  It was this Core that swallowed them.
conversation.properties|m.casino_imposto: Waiter? Oh sorry about that good sir.
conversation.properties|m.mission_locked: We were securing the elevator when the door shut behind us.
item.properties|f.primal_buster: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it you can sense the natural energy within waiting to be unleashed.
dungeon.properties|d.gate_materials: The materials listed can be found within this gate, however additional materials can also be found depending on the themes of each individual level.
item.properties|f.token_core: A fragment of strange material found within the core of the Clockworks. Each fragment seems to have an entirely unique composition, like snowflakes. These fragments are highly prized by Spiral HQ as they hope to learn the nature of the core through their study.
conversation.properties|r.test_greeter_1: I shall do my best in this test\!
mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r7:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!
item.properties|f.polar_twilight_warden_: An insulated hood that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The full coverage mask makes it ideal for scanning the horizon during polar twilight.
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_2a: Very well {0}, let's get right to it.  It seems the closer monsters get to the Core, the more their unique properties begin to surface.  In most cases this takes the form of their being able to inflict special damage types that require special defenses in order to withstand properly. \n\nIn Tier 2, a monster inflicting a special damage type will always produce a split normal/special damage output.  Thus, normal defense is still a somewhat valid defense choice.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.heavy_splinter_bomb: A solid chunk of synthetic mineral with an explosive surprise inside. Wolvers hate surprises.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_5a: I'll stay here and protect these sprites. Some of these sprite transport crates are empty. I think someone or something is after them. \n\nYou go on ahead and clear the area of hostiles so that a rescue squad can arrive safely.
guildhelp.properties|m.record_info: The Guild Record logs important recent activity within the guild, such as donations to the Guild Treasury, deposits to and withdrawals from the various Guild Storages, and promotions, additions or departures of guild members. They allow higher-ranked guild members to track who is donating or taking a lot from the guild, and act accordingly.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Grantz he...he fell while protecting us from The Swarm. He stood his ground even when the rest of us were forced to flee. I'll never forget how brave he was.
chat.properties|m.fail_format: {0} is appalled at that display of failure.
item.properties|f.beast_scale: A relatively intact scale recovered from a Clockworks creature.
support.properties|m.subheader_step206:
Revealing personal information is not acceptable, whether it is their own or another player's. Asking for personal information is not acceptable either.

Asking people how old they are or what grade they're in or what sorts of sports they do etc. is not considered personal.

But things like phone numbers or address or real name are personal information and should never be revealed.
item.properties|f.prize_box_plunge: Contains various unique costumes and items to celebrate the warm days of summer.  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
chat.properties|m.ident_set: Your forum identity has been set to this knight.
item.properties|f.shako: A ceremonial cap worn by knights during highly prestigious occasions.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_1a: There you are, {0}\!  I was beginning to think you wouldn't show up\! \n\nOk, let's get to work securing this place.  But first, you'll need to equip that Proto Bomb I gave you.  Head over to the Arsenal Station behind me and equip it.
item.properties|f.token_jelly: Typically only carried by jelly royalty, these squishy gems are the official currency of the jelly kingdoms. Though highly prized by slimes, most other creatures simply eat them as they are quite delicious.
item.properties|f.crimsonite_deposit_3: A large lump of minerals that will generate a great many units of crimsonite.
item.properties|f.grand_flourish: A fanciful blade for those who prefer to solve their problems with a hop, a skip and a stab.
item.properties|f.plague_essence: A powerful essence left behind when a creature perishes from a particularly putrid disease.
chat.properties|m.usage_sound: Usage\: /{0}\nToggle all sounds between full and silent.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_3a: Spiral HQ believes you are our best choice to help track down the energy signature, since you were the one to bring us the Artifact in the first place.  Rhendon will be dispatched to get on the trail of the gremlins below.
social.properties|m.booted: {0} has been banned from the party.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_fiendbook: 5 Ways to Appease Your Pit Boss
projectx.properties|m.confirm_return: Are you sure you want to return to {0}?
mission.properties|o.skies_under_cradle: Chart an expedition through the Aurora Isles
mission.properties|m.anniversary_start_3: In any case it would seem that this new 'recipe' caused the cakes to turn into horrible monsters that have overtaken my kitchen and infested the Clockworks.  I'd like to have my kitchen back, so could you please assist me in destroying these horrible Creep Cakes?
prologue.properties|m.helmsman_warning: Captain\! Energy signatures are shifting\! I've never seen anything like-

item.properties|f.prismatech_alchemer: An alchemical handgun that fires bullets of photon-charged liquid that split on impact.

item.properties|f.stop_sign: A strange shield capable of stopping many status attacks from harming the user. However it has an unnatural power that causes the user to come to a halt when behind it.

conversation.properties|m.emberlight_vis: None know for sure. Tinkinzar not seen for many many years. Crimson Order carries out Tinkinzar's plans for Cradle. Emberlight was blight on master plan because built by outcasts. Haven probably the same, founded by non-gremlins. Not part of plan\!
mission.properties|m.another_trace_3a: The energy signature is coming from somewhere in the Royal Jelly Palace and we need you to investigate.
