Shadow Keys can be purchased from the Supply Depot. \n\nOnce a party member uses a Shadow Key, the party is locked and cannot be changed, so choose your party members wisely\!
mission.properties|r.becoming_champion_4: I think you're on to something, Lieutenant.
help.properties|m.controls_chat: Press [[CHAT_START]] to enter chat or commands. Type /help into your chat window for a list of commands.
item.properties|f.blazebreak_armor: A reliable set of armor adept at deflecting the most fiery of rhetoric. It's not bad at resisting flame attacks, either.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_4a: That's the kind of spirit I like to see. Continue to complete missions for Spiral HQ as they are assigned to you. With your help we stand a chance at reaching the Core and saving Isora.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_4_3: Take some time to rest up and enjoy this tremendous victory.  Sprial HQ will no doubt call on you again\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_rummagekni: I know it was here somewhere...
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_2b: Do the gremlins have a leader?
mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!
item.properties|f.furni_library_lectern_: A podium displaying an ominous tome filled with unreadable scribbles and smudged ink prints of Kat paws.
item.properties|f.fur_coat: An extra-toasty coat made from the hide of a furry beast.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_mat_4: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.armor_fallen: A cursed suit of armor once worn by a celestial being cast down from paradise.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_mat_5: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.shining_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within burns like a star shining in the night sky.
item.properties|f.prize_box_extraordinar: Contains various unique costumes and items sure to revitalize your vigor and bring the pep back into your stride\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeexplo: Don't let spikes drop near monsters\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_minerknigh: Spiral HQ wants us to haul these minerals back up to Haven.
item.properties|f.fire_raider_tunic: Treasure is at your fingertips and ash in your wake with this soot laden coat.
item.properties|f.strike_needle: Plans to modify the Strike Needle for non-combat usage were shelved after a recruit accidentally riddled Lieutenant Feron's bunk with holes.
help.properties|m.monster_1: Monsters in the Clockworks are divided into six distinct families, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Be sure to equip yourself accordingly before venturing below ground\!
mission.properties|r.shadow_knows_4a: I'm going to need you to go over that-
mission.properties|b.terminal_meltdown: Drawn to the Firestorm Citadel, a horde of fiery slime and beast monsters have swarmed a nearby fuel depot putting the depot and our access to the citadel at risk. Should these monsters spread the fires into the fuel drums, the whole place will go up in flames. \n\nSpiral HQ needs you to enter the depot and put out the fire before time runs out and an explosive disaster is triggered\!
item.properties|f.elemental_blaster: An enhanced blaster modified to fire elemental rounds.
item.properties|f.surge_breaker_helm: A reliable helmet that's charged with protecting your skull from any unpleasant jolts.
projectx.properties|i.style_kit: Use cosmetic items to permanently add them.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_2a: Missions range from dangerous combat engagements to talking to certain people, such as myself.  By completing missions, you'll earn progress towards new ranks, which will in turn give you access to increasingly powerful gear.  Greta informed me that you'll be tackling our power supply problem in the Ancient Generator?
mission.properties|b.true_champion: Having come out of the Firestorm Citadel alive, Intel Agent Kora eagerly awaits to hear from you.
mission.properties|r.first_contact_b_2a: (Tell Kora about the Ancient Generator, Razwog and the mysterious Artifact.)
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_4a: Your sprite will evolve as you level it up. At certain key levels your sprite will require an Evo Catalyst be fed to it in order to level up further. Once fed, your sprite will physically change its appearance\! \n\nIt will be interesting to see how these strange, new forms of battle sprites evolve in time.
item.properties|f.gel_drop: A drop of goo collected from a jelly. It's still quivering.
item.properties|f.grand_solstice_ring: A magnificent, enchanted ring that embodies the spirit of the solstice. Its surface seems to change color over time, sometimes hot and sometimes cold to the touch.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_bomb: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
mission.properties|m.collector_prisoner_: I think so... we'll try and slip out when we can.\n\nOh, but be careful\! Whatever caught us is still here, guarding a large cache of our captured battle sprites. If you plan on fighting it, beware its deadly charge. Good hunting\!
item.properties|f.armor_rear: An accessory that can be attached to the rear of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
item.properties|f.gh_env_rain_shower: The perfect environment for Guild Halls without fire insurance or whose members are simply too lazy to ever water their plants.
pvp.properties|m.playagain_team.1: 1 guildmate is needed for a {1} team.
item.properties|f.grey_feather_cowl: A downy hood made for scholars who like to get out into the field. It's softer than the most luxurious of pillows, yet extraordinarily protective.
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_2: The Forge uses the heat stored in your gear and combines it with the power of Fire Crystals to unlock its new potential.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Careful, those Gremlins have lined the place with barbed wire.
item.properties|f.seerus_fragment_2: A flawed fragment of the mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus, recovered from the siege of his Grand Arsenal.
item.properties|f.toxic_vaporizer_mkii: A Toxic Vaporizer modified to disperse noxious agents over a wider range.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Having smashed the most terrifying zombies to dust, escaped the cold maws of grimalkins and stood victorious in battle against an army of trojans, you have no doubt collected samples from these encounters that would be of great use to Spiral HQ's research teams.
mission.properties|m.alien_ooze_1a: I have nothing to say yet, but it involves Beast Bells. (DEV-ONLY)
item.properties|f.gh_theme_fire: A fiery theme that's sure to keep your Guild Hall warm and toasty... or sweaty.
item.properties|f.tri_guard_armor: A special suit of armor designed specifically for knights on first recon of alien planets. This rugged suit protects against a variety of harsh elements.

item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roya: A squishy gem highly prized by slimes. This one was liberated from the Royal Jelly Palace and painstakingly preserved as a conversation piece.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_6: Many recipes require an equip-able, leveled item.  These are called 'special items' in a recipe and you are free to select the special item you wish, provided it's the correct item. \n\nThis is useful if the recipe calls for an item that you have two copies of, but one is superior.
item.properties|f.plated_shade_armor: A suit of fiendish fabric interlaced with dark matter to conceal its wearer while they creep in camoflauged corners.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_11a: Oh my\!  What is the connection between these gremlins and that Artifact anyway?
item.properties|f.casting_cone: A cap for comfortable casting. Conical, but no laughing matter.
item.properties|f.mining_hat: A sturdy, old helmet once used to dig for precious minerals. It offers a little more defense than a Spiral Helm.
mission.properties|b.abandoned_depot: The Knights stationed in the Rescue Camp have converted a derelict facility below the surface of Cradle into a training facility to help teach new recruits the basics of survival within the Clockworks.  Beware\! As part of the Clockworks it is likely to be inhabited by all manners of monsters.  Stay alert\!
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_r9: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.fiery_vaporizer: An alchemical bomb that creates a cloud of highly combustible mist.

mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_r7: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.powderkeg: Careful, this thing could go off like a metaphorical powder keg.

mission.properties|m.legion_almire_1a:
Nothing like a death-defying romp through a haunted necropolis to really get the blood pumping, eh Rangers? 

The necropolis originates from Almire, fallen kingdom of some crazy lord something-something, population\: innumerable legions of Undead.  Apparently these less-than-living residents are guarding something that Spiral HQ would like to acquire. 

Our job is to recover a special book, a piece of a much larger collection of works that may give us more insight into the nature of this cursed kingdom.  So grab your helmets, and your best zombie-basher- I'm not expecting a warm reception. 

Let's ride, Rangers\!

conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_5: In most cases this is just a standard favored item, but when your sprite is ready to evolve, an Evo Catalyst will be required.
item.properties|f.vial_curse_ultra: A glass vial containing concentrated fiend essence. It can be used to inflict enemies with Curse.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and give your foes 10 years of bad luck\!
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_2: Thank you for defeating the Snarbolax. Too many of our squires met an early end because of that beast. I can rest easier knowing that threat is now behind us. \n\nI look forward to hearing about your future exploits, Soldier\!
helptips.properties|m.tg3_charge_1: Spiral Knights are capable of unleashing the hidden powers locked from within the weapons they use called "charge attacks." Charge attacks are more powerful than a standard attack and can often produce special effects.
item.properties|f.bristling_buckler: A small shield spiked to supplement your sword in a skirmish.
helptips.properties|m.tglobby_vitapod: Vitapods temporarily increase your maximum health until you return to town.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_2a: As you know I am attempting to assemble a research team to work on-site in the Core terminal.  In order to successfully utilize it to restore the Skylark, it is imperative that we reach it and set up this research station. \n\nAll evidence seems to point towards you having the potential to finally reach the Core.  By breaking through the Firestorm Citadel and establishing a link to the Core, my team could set up the necessary supply lines and get to work immediately.  But we can't do that while that infernal citadel and its horrible ruler stand in our way.
support.properties|m.subheader_step2_gif: We have saved the offending gift box message already waiting to be added to the complaint, so there is no need to hurry from here. Please carefully choose the correct option matching what the player did\:
item.properties|f.mad_bomber_suit: Some people have axes to grind. Others have points to make. This armor is for those of us with explosive tempers.
item.properties|f.furni_statue: A commemorative statue that may be placed in a Guild Hall. Up to {0} statues may be placed per hall.
mission.properties|r.alchemy_mastery_1a: I could always use a good sword.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_8a: Well, that's the end of the tour, {0}. Would you like me to go over that again or are you ready to try everything out for yourself?

item.properties|f.dragon_scale: An armored scale from what was thought to be an extinct creature. It reflects light with an otherworldly sheen.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_4_1: {0}\!  I can hardly believe you managed to confront the Warmaster head on and come out of that inferno alive\!  You've got the makings of a true hero\!
item.properties|f.obsidian_carbine: A deadly gun made from the obsidian obelisks found within the realm of the Apocrea. With every shot fired, a faint whisper is heard, believed to be the true name of its target.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_5a: Along the north wall here we have all sorts of blocks, switches, doors, and buttons from the Clockworks. If you want to overcome the devious and deadly mechanisms down there I suggest you become familiar with how these work\!
support.properties|m.option_206_0: If there is no doubt this was personal information then please click here to file the complaint.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_kit: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.

projectx.properties|d.achievement_169085: Defeat Lord Vanaduke in the heart of the Firestorm Citadel.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_3a:
What?\! You're still here?\! 

This artifact is mine\!  You miserable knights will never have its power\! 

I'll just have to destroy you myself\!
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro4_1a: I'm going to stay here for now and locate any other Knights that have crashed in the area.  I'll meet you at the Rescue Camp to the north. \n\nAnd should you encounter anything really dangerous, press [[?DEFEND]] to use your shield\!
mission.properties|b.high_temperature_ho:
Intel had reported a gremlin deconstruction crew dismantling a portion of the Clockworks in order to generate scrap resources for use in their Project R. Using powerful welding torches, they are truly burning the place to the ground. 

One of the squads investigating the site has gone missing and is believed to be now held in captivity at the site. 

Infiltrate the fiery deconstruction zone and rescue the captive knights.  But be warned, the deconstruction crew are said to have a powerful security construct hidden somewhere on site.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_5a: Once freed you will collect an Apocrean Sigil as proof of your deed. Bring these to me and my friend here will reward you with special treasures I have collected during my time in this world. You can use these items to craft rare and powerful items using that obelisk of creation over there.
helptips.properties|m.tut_hearts_short: If you are hurt, use Hearts to heal yourself\!
conversation.properties|r.hav_clock_2d: On second thought, I've got some adventuring to do. Bye\!
helptips.properties|m.tut_fighting: Aim at enemies with your mouse and attack with [[ACTION]].
guild.properties|i.officer_storage: Community item storage for officers and above.
sprites.properties|d.dark_harness: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal shadow damage. \nCan be used by\: Drakon, Maskeraith
mission.properties|o.alchemy_mastery: Discover the potential of master level alchemy
uplink.properties|m.auction_cancelled: Don't think twice next time, items just love being sold\!
conversation.properties|m.almire_histori: We've recovered what little remains from Owlite Keep concerning the Kingdom of Almire. Combined with the snippets we've gotten from the nature sprites within Firestorm Citadel itself, we are starting to get a clearer picture of Almire's history.
item.properties|f.shadow_blaster: An enhanced blaster modified to fire shadow rounds.
item.properties|f.gift_of_autumn: A rare charm cherished by travelers that fortifies the wearer during the winter season.
mission.properties|b.time_enough_at_last: A knight named Edger has gone missing while exploring the Scarlet Fortress.  Given that this crumbling castle is swarming with spookats and jelly cubes, his squadmates fear for his safety and have asked a more experienced knight like yourself to investigate. \n\nLocate Edger within the fortress and bring him back to Haven\!
guild.properties|log.energy_added: Deposited {0} energy to the energy well (new total\: {1}).
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_2a: What the- are these...battle sprites? Something has happened to them, they've changed into some kind of creature.
chat.properties|m.usage_spawn: Usage\: /{0} name attr value attr value...\nSpawns an actor in the scene.
item.properties|f.wyvern_scale_shield: A spiny buckler forged from beast chitin, providing ample resistance to both heat and venom.
mission.properties|o.p_halloween_r3: Seek an audience with the Punkin King.
item.properties|f.twisted_targe: A tulgey targe that will give your sword thrusts some teeth.
item.properties|f.spiral_tailed_helm: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_1_7a: Cradle is growing more mysterious by the day.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_6a: There were sounds of shouting and explosions coming from the lab just now.  I think we may be under attack\!  Better gear up.  I've no idea what is going on in there but we'd better be prepared for anything\!
item.properties|f.serene_armor: An ancient suit of armor weathered by the elements. While standing in this armor you can sense the far-off tremors caused by the migration of countless tortodrones journeying to lands unknown.
item.properties|f.redwood: A sturdy chunk of fine, unfinished wood. It's typically used in the production of cabinets.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_2a: It should, there're plenty of new recruits that chatter about them constantly. They're like heroes to some knights. \n\nThe Alpha Squad was an elite squad of knights that Ozlo personally selected to first enter the Clockworks in an effort to locate the source of the massive energy signal below.  Because all systems on the Skylark were offline for several weeks, radio communication was not possible.  Instead, they left a series of recon modules throughout their travels, sort of like a breadcrumb trail.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_4a: Looks like I need to get you up to speed.  We've crashed on a planet known as 'Cradle.'  Cradle is a fascinating world in that the entire interior of the planet below its surface is an ever-changing mechanical complex known as the 'Clockworks.' \n\nThe Clockworks seems to have been built by 'gremlins,' a furry race of malevolent monsters that have not taken kindly to our presence.
item.properties|f.furni_drawer_spiral: A small set of drawers filled with a variety of important items.
mission.properties|m.alone_in_dark_3a: Should you attempt to enter the citadel and manage to reach the throne room, please, end his suffering.  Allow the souls he keeps bound to this world a chance to return to their loved ones. \n\nAnd one more thing- I've heard that some kind of force of nature had once tried to right his wrongs but Lord Vanaduke imprisoned it somewhere within his fortress.  Finding and freeing it may prove useful.
guild.properties|m.regen_hall: The Guild Hall is being updated...
craft.properties|m.confirm_variants: This will replace all or some of the variants on your item. Are you sure?
mission.properties|b.the_gauntlet: One final battle stands in your way before reaching the Firestorm Citadel. Thought to be devised by Lord Vanaduke himself, this unrelenting gauntlet is teeming with all manners of dark creatures and culminates in a nightmarish battle arena that must be conquered in order to gain access to the gates of the Firestorm Citadel. \n\nThis mission will take everything you've got and requires a full arsenal of powerful weapons and gear.  If Lord Vanaduke is testing you, give him the fight that he's asking for and show him what a true Champion can do\!
item.properties|f.aerohelm: A light, aerodynamic helmet sure to lift your attitude. It won't let you fly, so you'll just have to wing it.
guild.properties|m.theme_change_warning: You are paying to install this theme. If for any reason it is removed you will have to pay to install it again.
mission.properties|b.beyond_axes_of_evil: Despite your previous efforts, gremlins have reformed their logging operation in the Jigsaw Valley in order to supply their munitions plants with resources. Given the results of their last project, the Roarmulus Twins, Spiral HQ would like you to end their eco-destruction before it becomes anything more serious\!
item.properties|f.token_spirit: An otherworldly brand placed upon a soul claimed by the mysterious Apocrea. Removing it allows the captured soul to escape imprisonment within the terrible realm of the Apocrea.
item.properties|f.splinter_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in a synthetic mineral. Prone to shattering, the otherwise useless material in this bomb is perfect for giving foes a nasty splinter.
steam.properties|m.confirm_convert: Are you sure?  The conversion cannot be undone.  Once complete, \nyou will be logged back in with your Steam account.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_weap_1: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
exchange.properties|i.mini_sell: Instantly sell energy for crowns at the energy exchange.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Hail, Vanguard {0}. Kora said you had news of the Alpha Squad. Please, give us your report.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_gr: A short torch filled with ghastly green fire.
mission.properties|o.p_apocrea_r9: Investigate the area of the Clockworks where several knights have gone missing.
item.properties|f.arthro_pod: A streamlined helmet fashioned after the tough chitin of a beetle's carapace.
mission.properties|r.creators_and_create: That and a solid arsenal, yeah.
item.properties|f.vog_cub_coat: This hide garment is so flame retardant that you won't even mind that it reeks of wood smoke.
item.properties|f.circuit_breaker_armor: Armor with a hacked elemental core aimed at resisting shock. However, this non-standard modification creates other elemental weaknesses.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_partypad_1: Head into the room ahead with the party pad. You're almost done.
conversation.properties|r.mon_pocket_2: Thanks Nonna, but maybe next time.
helptips.properties|m.unlock: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use a Silver Key.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_1a: Well met soldier, and good work on reaching our base camp here in Haven. I'm Lieutenant Feron. I have been assigned by Captain Ozlo to oversee our Clockworks mining operation. \n\nBefore you lies "the Arcade," a fascinating complex that serves as our link into the heart of the Clockworks. Since you're new here, I'll give you a quick run-down of what Spiral HQ has us doing here.
mission.properties|b.chilled_to_bone:
By now you have no doubt run into strange, undead monsters known as 'spookats.'  Recon Knights have finally discovered what seems to be the source of these ghostly cat-like creatures. 

Large concentrations of spookats have been sighted in what is believed to be the darkened remains of an owlite castle.  Dubbed the 'Candlestick Keep' this shadowy realm is only illuminated by a series of owlite candles.    

Proceed with caution while exploring outside the light of the candles.  Lurking in the dark are enormous spookats known as 'grimalkins.'  Grimalkins seem to withstand all weaponry and are to be avoided.  Your only defense is to stay in the light\! 

Spiral HQ has issued you this mission in order to collect more data on the origins of the spookats and the mystery behind the fall of the owlites.  Investigate the Candlestick Keep and report your findings\!
helptips.properties|m.loading0: The basic play controls can be viewed at any time by pressing [[TOGGLE_HELP]].
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: The seraphynx is a battle sprite that embodies protection and restoration. Its skills focus on supporting knights in combat\: ray of light creates a steady beam of holy light, heart attack increases the chance of hearts dropping from monsters, and angelic aura creates a light shield that protects its knight and party members within. \n\nThe seraphynx is best suited for knights who wish to protect their party and provide them aid.
chat.properties|m.usage_sprite_level: Usage\: /{0} [level]\nSets the battle sprite to that level.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_mat_0: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_cb03dd: Earn clearance to explore Tier 3 of the Clockworks.
mission.properties|r.reporting_duty_2a: If we could somehow harness that power...
global.properties|m.internal_error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.
conversation.properties|r.atg_greeter_1b: No thanks, I'll explore the place myself.
sprites.properties|d.vengeful_quills: Each time a quilled target is hit, another quill is fired from the target to the next available target.
item.properties|f.divine_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
guild.properties|x.rename_desc2: The renaming item will be consumed.
item.properties|f.prize_box_decoration: Contains various festive decorations for your Guild Hall to help ring in the winterfest season.  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
item.properties|f.stranger_robe: A robe once worn by one of the enigmatic Strangers.  Local Snipes seem to be drawn to the wearer.
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_mon_3: they are waiting to ambush you ahead
town.properties|m.haven_desc: A peaceful town that is home to the Strangers. These salvagers offer the Spiral Knights sanctuary in return for the treasures that they acquire while investigating the Clockworks. Haven is also heavily populated with snipes, bulbous little birds with a curious means of locomotion.
sprites.properties|d.frenzied_firestorm: For every monster caught in the blaze, you and your party have a chance of receiving an attack power and speed bonus.
item.properties|f.recover_accessory: Accessory tickets can be redeemed at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
item.properties|f.power_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_mat_012: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_housepla: A rosy red plant inside a cheerful pot.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_1: Well met {0}, it has been some time since I first met you having just arrived from the Rescue Camp.  You've come along way since then, rising to the rank of Defender Elite no less. \n\nYou are a gifted soldier, {0}.  I have no doubt you will soon be a Champion amongst the Spiral Knights and instrumental in our solving the great mystery that is the Core, restoring the Skylark and returning home.  You have proven that you have what it takes to face the legions of dark forces that lurk below the surface.
logon.properties|m.under_maintenance: The game is currently undergoing maintenance.  Please check back later.
item.properties|f.spark_life: A powerful charge of pure energy that instantly revives you or a fellow party member.
item.properties|f.quilted_hunting_coat: A flexible coat lined with luxurious stay-alert quilting. It smells musty.
mission.properties|m.darkest_depths_3a: It's just a feeling really.  I hear it from some of the other knights as well\: a feeling like we... belong here, like maybe the crash occurred for a reason. \n\nBut that just can't be, right?  In any case, I'm rambling now.  Back to the mission\!
chat.properties|m.usage_clear: Usage\: /{0}\nClears your chat display and history.
conversation.properties|r.almire_histori: What have you learned about Almire?
item.properties|f.iron_dragon_helm: A helm once worn by a member of the 'Iron Dragons,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Biotech Hahn is attempting to further his research of fiend and undead family monsters and is requesting samples from your recent missions.  He has once again specifically requested that you be reminded of his 'best free lecture yet' when making your decision as to whether or not to comply.
guild.properties|m.storage_warning: WARNING\: Items left here can be taken by any guild member of the appropriate rank.
helptips.properties|m.tg_doors: Doors can be opened in many different ways.
conversation.properties|m.mission_surviv: B-beware...it stalks us...it watches our every move\!
item.properties|f.fireworks: During times of celebration, the Spiral Order devotes some of its munitions experts to create spectacular fireworks.
dungeon.properties|m.leaveparty_return: Leave the party and return to {0}.
mission.properties|o.p_ghost_machine_r4: Join Desna's Recon Rangers in discovering the source of the distress call within the derelict facility.
social.properties|m.join_guild_mission: Join your guildmate {0} at depth {1} on the Mission\: {2} ({3})
pvp.properties|m.start_soon: Your {0} game will be starting soon...
guild.properties|log.expansion_added: Added the {0} expansion for {1} crowns, plus {2} crowns for pro-rated upkeep.
item.properties|f.dragon_scale_helm: A mythical helmet crafted from the scales of a creature of legend.
item.properties|f.master_blaster: This advanced sidearm is an excellent choice if your adventuring party happens to need another hero.
item.properties|f.quilted_demo_suit: A suit snugly lined with luxurious stay-alert quilting. It smells a bit sweaty.
helptips.properties|m.tut_lever_alt: Switches can open doors. Try throwing a pot or shooting this one with your handgun\!
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Having faced the jaws of the most ferocious wolvers, avoided the spikes of fully evolved jelly cubes and even the vile regurgitations of virulisks, you have no doubt collected samples from these encounters that would be of great use to Spiral HQ's research teams.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We saw the explosions all the way from camp\! That was amazing\!
mission.properties|o.blades_fallen: Place the sword of an unknown knight at the memorial in the soldier's graveyard
item.properties|f.confetti_equinox: When thrown, this spring confetti bursts with freshly sprouted grass and fragrant flowers. No rain required\!
item.properties|f.celestial_nav_helm: A special helm built to commemorate Isoran spacefarers of old.  With this equipped, you can see a clear path across the night sky to countless worlds beyond.
item.properties|f.holiday_hat_snow: A holiday hat so festive, snow falls above it\!  Fortunately for the wearer, the hat itself is super warm.
social.properties|m.autofriend_single_ma: Your {0} friend {1} just started playing Spiral Knights as {2}\! Unfortunately, that knight already has a full friend list, so you were unable to be auto-friended.
projectx.properties|m.confirm_quit: Are you sure you want to quit?
uplink.properties|m.confirm_att_account: This is an account-wide mail, you can read it with any of your knights but the attachment can only be accepted once.\n\nAccept the attachment now?
helptips.properties|m.tg3_lift_2: The door ahead is locked, but you can open it with the hit switch to your left. Try throwing a clay pot at the switch. They're quite useful in this way if you don't have a gun handy.
item.properties|f.volatile_catalyzer: Removing the safety overrides from a piece of Gremlin technology is a good way to lose a limb. In this case, it probably won't be one of yours. Catalyzer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
item.properties|f.seraphic_helm: A beautiful mail coif that causes its wearer to strike out at evil with righteous fury.
mission.properties|b.p_apocrea_r4: Several capable knights have gone missing in a seemingly normal area of the Clockwork Tunnels. Spiral HQ suspects foul play and has assigned you to investigate the level.
item.properties|f.prize_box_electric: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in an Electric style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.furni_beacon_floor_blu: A Spiral-issued light source typically used to illuminate special areas, or indicate the presence of a limited-time sale.
item.properties|f.slumber_smogger: An alchemical bomb that fogs an area with a sleep agent.
item.properties|f.raiders_axe: An ornate, fiery axe favored by raiders for its versatility.
support.properties|m.subheader_step4: Your complaint has been sent, thank you for helping us keep the game an enjoyable environment.\n\nWe read through all complaints filed, but we do not report back to you on what happens with each complaint. And we may not be able to look over your complaint right away, but rest assured they are all read and handled according to our policies.
helptips.properties|m.atg_crowns: CROWNS are used to buy items and pay for other services.
item.properties|f.thunderous_plate_mail: A legendary suit of armor said to imbue the wearer with the might of heavenly thunder.
helptips.properties|m.atg_treasure: GREEN Treasure boxes contain crowns and other useful items\! RED Treasure boxes are rarer than green blocks and contain better items\! HEART boxes contain hearts that will restore your health.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_mat_0: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_snar: A large model Snarbolax, depicting in minute detail his jaws that bite and claws that catch.
chat.properties|m.complain_self: You can't file a complaint about yourself.
item.properties|f.rocket_hammer_2: Designed by Warmaster Seerus himself, this nefarious gremlin weapon is equipped with a rocket engine that can launch the wielder forward with a powerful hammer smash.  This particular model is a more stable version that blew up gremlin test subjects far fewer times than the prototype.

conversation.properties|m.casino_yesman_: Welcome to the High Wobbler Lounge\!
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r7: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Biotech Hahn is attempting to further his research of construct and gremlin family monsters and is requesting samples from your recent missions.  He has once again specifically requested that you be reminded of his 'other very informative lecture' that was given to you 'free of charge for the second time' when making your decision as to whether or not to comply.
item.properties|f.heater_shield: A shield with a built-in furnace that keeps its user toasty warm, protecting them from most freeze attacks. Many knights also use it as a makeshift stove top when out in the field.
item.properties|f.shadow_key: A mysterious key that grants a party entrance to Shadow Lairs.  A Shadow Key is destroyed once used.
item.properties|f.skelly_suit: A bone-chilling outfit that naturally wards off shadowy attacks.
mission.properties|o.new_chapter: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_wasd_move_: Mouse used for targeting, attacking and menu navigation
mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
dungeon.properties|m.candlestick_keep.de: All that remains of the Owlite Academy, the Candlestick Keep is now a grim shadow of the once great school of magical arts.  Knights who have made it out of this cursed keep have only this advice to offer- 'stay in the light.'
design.properties|e.furni_max_deployed: There are no available units of that furnishing to deploy.
conversation.properties|m.rc_nervous_1a: I want to buy something with the crowns I've earned in the training grounds, but that merchant is totally giving me the creeps. What do you think it's hiding under those robes?\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_bomb_1a: Had a chance to try out bombs yet? Unlike other weapon types, bombs can only be used as a charge attack. Doing anything else just causes it to fizzle out. But if you do charge them up... BOOM\! They can put a serious hurt on multiple monsters at once\!
item.properties|f.empty_room_checker_sma: An empty Guild Hall room with a checkerboard pattern on the floor.
item.properties|f.spiral_demo_helm: A sturdy helm designed for use by explosively-inclined knights.
pvp.properties|m.removed: Your coliseum signup has been cancelled.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_2a: Do Strangers sell anything else besides weapons and gear?
dungeon.properties|m.sleeper_sanctuary: The Sanctuary|A Calm in the Storm
exchange.properties|m.coins_traded_poe: You have received {0} crowns as the result of an energy trade.
mission.properties|m.honor_duty_1a: Well met, {0}, Champion of the Spiral Knights.  Your service to our cause has been of the highest caliber.  Without you, reaching the Core would still be a dream.  Now, we have a chance of actually restoring the Skylark and returning home.
chat.properties|m.usage_unmute: Usage\: /{0} player name\nStops blocking messages from the specified player.
mission.properties|m.toxic_plant_2a: An official order from Herex, the Whispering Venom\: \n\nProduction of Compound 42 is to cease immediately.  While a formidable poison and no doubt useful in achieving a... 'higher' power amongst the Order, it seems to have formed an intelligence well beyond the scope of a standard bio-toxin.
item.properties|f.barbarous_thorn_blade: A mythical blade that lashes out with the fury of the Snarbolax itself. Those who wield it claim to feel the fiery stare of the beast upon them whenever they close their eyes.

mission.properties|o.shopping_again: Follow Bechamel on a tour of the Bazaar's more advanced offerings
item.properties|f.deadshot_chapeau: A mythical hat for those that never miss their mark. It's rumored to have been made from cloth that was previously interred.
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_2: During your travels in the Clockworks you will encounter five special minerals\: crimsonite, moonstone, valestone, luminite and dark matter.
item.properties|f.razor_ribbon: Remember\: when handling Grinchlin giftboxes, always wear your plate mail gauntlets.
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Biotech Hahn for research.
item.properties|f.zee_core: A pungent mass pulled from a slimy assailant. Its aroma is an excellent remedy for insomnia, as well as nighttime sniffling and sneezing.
item.properties|f.kat_claw_cowl: A magnificently crafted cowl said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Scraith, first to scale the walls of the Owlite High Academy of Magicks.
item.properties|f.ranger_signal_flare: A flare that signals a nearby Recon Ranger to provide support fire
mission.properties|r.elemental_my_dear_3: Once again you talked pretty fast, can you go over it-
chat.properties|m.no_tell_mute: You can't tell to a person that you've ignored.
monster.properties|m.fired_3: Ahh, I'm gonna have to fire you. OK?
mission.properties|m.intro_expansion_loc: Complete Rank Missions to gain access to Expansion Missions\!
item.properties|f.warmaster_bomb_3: The perfected version of the shadowy bomb that Warmaster Seerus engineered with the sole purpose of eliminating other gremlins that stood in his way.  It is thought to have been reserved for use against other members of the Crimson Order.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_10: Congratulations {0}.  The Geo Knights owe a great deal to your efforts.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_3a: Congratulations {0}, you meet the necessary requirements and have received your 2 Star Certification.  Take the elevator behind me in order to complete your mission.
auction.properties|m.no_mybids: You have not bid on any recent auctions.
pvp.properties|m.playagain_team.n: {0} more guildmates are needed for a {1} team.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_9a: Hi {0}\!  Look at you, wow\!  Hey, Vanguard or not you know where to go if you want to really stand out right?
item.properties|f.grintovec: Your enemies will surely enjoy the cool, refreshing sensation of being hit by a glacier.
exchange.properties|m.trade4energy_toolt: Click here to accept the listed trade, and buy energy with crowns.
mission.properties|r.reporting_duty_1a: Sure sounds important, tell me how it all works.
sprites.properties|d.dark_veil: Increases the defensive power of the shadow cloak.
conversation.properties|r.sprite_tut_1a: How do sprites level up and evolve?
guild.properties|e.leave_current_first: You must leave your current guild before accepting this invitation.
conversation.properties|m.almire_histori: Well, we now know there were massive citadels housing Almire's armed forces and great estates for its noble houses. It must have been quite a sight to see. We assume the rest of the kingdom is still a smoldering ruin somewhere. It is possible that some of it might have survived...though given the anecdotal evidence we think it is unlikely at best.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_weap_2: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_end: Seems like you have a good grasp on the basics. I think you're ready to join the rest of the recruits in the Sparrow Gate. There you will learn how to work as a party. There's a lot of recruits out there depending on you now. Great job\!
item.properties|f.arcana: An exceptional handgun that fires powerful, elemental shots that many Spiral Knights refer to as 'magic missiles.'
item.properties|f.deadly_splinter_bomb: A large chunk of synthetic mineral primed with a potent explosive. Fact\: the easiest way to find the splinter in the haystack is to blow up the haystack.
mission.properties|r.first_contact_b_4a: I'd like to help however I can.  Where is Spiral HQ now located?
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_3b: I'm sorry {0}, but you currently do not meet the necessary requirements. Please speak to me again when you are currently equipped with a 2 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
item.properties|f.celestial_vortex: A Celestial Bomb modified with a payload of a dying sun. Foes caught in its fiery blast radius are shown a glimpse of the dawn of creation.
item.properties|f.prize_box_chess: Contains one randomly-chosen Chess Mini liftable statue furniture.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|b.sovereign_slime:
The source of the strange energy signature is believed to be located somewhere in the Royal Jelly Palace, the home to one of the members of the slime aristocracy, the Royal Jelly. 

The might of these sovereign slimes is not to be underestimated.  Should you find yourself facing this hot-tempered highborn, you would be wise to be equipped with the appropriate gear and backed by a full squad of experienced knights. 

It is highly recommended that you equip yourself with pierce resistant gear and shadow damage weapons before deploying for the Royal Jelly Palace\!
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro2_2a: You just hit the surface of Cradle.  My escape pod crashed just north of your position.  We should meet up and find the nearest rally point. \n\nBe careful and ready your sword, there are hostile creatures everywhere\!
uplink.properties|m.detached_accessory: Spiral Knights had a change and the attached accessory was removed from your {0}.\n\nApologies.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_4a: Some items can be used to attack monsters, like these vials.  You can practice picking them up and throwing them in this target range here.
pvp.properties|m.refunded: You have been refunded your Coliseum entrance fee of {0} crowns.
helptips.properties|m.converse: Use the arrow keys and spacebar to navigate the conversation.
social.properties|m.trade_request_pendin: You have already sent a trade request to {0}.
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_tall_blu: A tall, elegant street lamp that emits a blue glow with a gentle hiss.
pvp.properties|m.idle_removed: You have been removed from {0} for non-participation.
mission.properties|o.from_below: Find and save the squad of Recon Rangers
conversation.properties|m.hav_clock_3c: Something of immense power, little one. There is an enormous energy signal coming from the center of the Clockworks, but that is all we know. No one has ever made it to the core. Or at least if anyone has, they have never returned.\n\nThe ones to ask would be the gremlins, for they have likely gone deeper into the Clockworks than any creature. But that might prove difficult as they are quite a disagreeable lot.
item.properties|f.firetail_mask: A simmering simian mask made to celebrate the new year. The searing silhouette will display your dominant demeanor.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: Oh no\! Tell her the cakes will be ready. Erm, I'm just a little behind.  I'll make you a deal\: I'll give you some extra cake if we can keep this between you and me. I don't want to be kicked out of the party.
mission.properties|o.ancient_generator: Explore the Ancient Generator and restore power to the Rescue Camp before night falls\!
helptips.properties|m.atg_shield: Surrounded? Use your SHIELD to push back attacking enemies.
item.properties|f.rock_salt_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in rock salt. Not recommended for use in the kitchen.
item.properties|f.slime_slasher: A sturdy shovel modified to dole out a little extra damage to slime family monsters.
item.properties|f.eye_pack_shapely: Contains three shapely eyes for your style kit\: Triangle, Square, and Hexagon.
mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_1:
The Hall of Heroes is where knights go to receive their Star Certification allowing them to access deeper depths of the Clockworks.  Each certification ensures a knight meets the star level required to deal with challenges in the upcoming missions. 

The Hall of Heroes also allows knights the opportunity to speak to veteran knights and discover their loadouts, even offering the opportunity to purchase recipes for these loadouts. 

Visit the Hall of Heroes and receive your 2 Star Certification in order to obtain access to missions within deeper levels of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.grate_plate: A protective plate with peephole perforations permitting ventilation of exhalations.
exchange.properties|m.billing_spending_l: You have reached your spending limit. Your card has not been charged.
mission.properties|m.the_flickering_flam: We don't know for sure but it has to be related to the Artifact. The energy signatures are identical. If the Artifact is involved that means...
sprites.properties|d.iron_harness_adv: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal normal damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 5% \nCan be used by\: All battle sprites
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_3a: I'm glad you asked, they certainly do\!  Let's head over to Vatel.
item.properties|f.hive_helm: Insects know each other by scent, but the eyes are still for glaring at rivals.
chat.properties|m.usage_recharge: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nCharges a player (yourself by default) up with mist energy.
chat.properties|m.usage_shout: Usage\: /{0} message\nShouts a message to a wider area.
item.properties|f.royal_skewer: A jagged, razor-sharp barb from one of the most powerful slimes on Cradle. Once removed from the slime it grows brittle and eventually turns to dust.
helptips.properties|m.tut_goldkey: Pick up and use on Gold Doors\!
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_slime: Deliver a shipment of rock salt to the research team stationed in the lichenous lair\!
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
item.properties|f.rogue_lite: Be a guiding light or a glowing spark, charging forward to leave your mark. Universally venerated, procedurally re-generated, you'll never be lost in the dark.
item.properties|f.prize_box_surprise_2: Contains two randomly chosen Prize Boxes in celebration of the Spiral Order's anniversary on Cradle.  No key required to open.
mission.properties|o.p_heart_of_ice_r9: Discover the source of the terrible blizzards emanating from Amu-Sol
mission.properties|b.p_r7_weap_4: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2a: Battle sprites level up by acquiring heat, just like your weapons and gear. They can acquire heat in two ways\: absorbing it as you battle in the Clockworks and by consuming materials and synthesizing them into heat.
conversation.properties|m.atg_guard: Greetings\!  Beyond this door you will find the advanced training hall. As a Spiral Knight, you are free to use it to practice your skills and learn more about the Clockworks.
mission.properties|m.shocking_sentient_s: It looks like time has run out, Sputterspark.  You'd better hope your little toy works.
mission.properties|m.time_enough_at_last: Ah yes, my squad.  A good bunch... strong and determined.  I'm not sure I really fit in to be honest, was always more of a reader\!  They should be fine without me I would imagine.
guild.properties|log.upkeep_default: Upkeep not paid\! Guild Hall is in default.
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: I am here to listen. Let it all out.

Guild Member chat channel
Guild Officer chat channel
