Guild Member status updates
chat.properties|m.usage_back: Usage\: /{0}\nNotes that you have returned to the keyboard.
mission.properties|r.pumping_up_8a: Let's go over that again. [Restart tour]
item.properties|f.shadow_steel: An extraordinary metal imbued with the creeping darkness of the Underworld.
conversation.properties|m.mission_collec: This place gives me the chills.
item.properties|f.celestial_nav_suit: A special suit built to commemorate Isoran starfarers of old.  With this equipped, you feel like you would never get lost in space... if only the Skylark could fly.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_mat_2: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_lift_1: It's time to flex those muscles\! Some objects you encounter can be lifted and carried or thrown. Walk up to these clay pots and press ATTACK when you see the action icon.
item.properties|f.prize_box_nemesis: Contains various unique items representing good and evil. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|b.new_chapter: Having defeated the Snarbolax and recovered the Alpha Squad recon module, it's time to check in with Intel Agent Kora to get a report on the analysis of the module and information about certification in the Hall of Heroes.
item.properties|f.exp_west_4f: An expansion that adds three rooms and a small overlook to the western side of the Guild Hall.
dungeon.properties|m.spirits_graveyard: Shroud of the Apocrea|The Grasping Plateau
sprites.properties|d.firebolt: Launches a searing ball of fire that explodes on impact.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_3a: Once the charge aura has reached maximum charge, release the ATTACK button and unleash a devastating charge attack\!
item.properties|f.kilowatt_pulsar: A Pulsar upgraded with Spiral technology to deliver an unpleasant shock on impact. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
mission.properties|b.elemental_my_dear: Biotech Hahn has agreed to inform you about the monsters in the Clockworks that inflict elemental damage.  Contact him via comlink and hear what he has to say.
conversation.properties|m.imposto_50: Glorp\! If I had bones, they'd be broken\!
conversation.properties|r.tut_warden_1a: Great, I'm looking forward to a hot meal.
item.properties|f.owlite_feather: A small feather plucked from an Owlite, said to be a mythical race of great magician birds.
dungeon.properties|m.tutorial_b: The Crash Site|Waking in a New World
mission.properties|m.collector_prisoner_: My rescue team was ambushed by some giant mechanical horror. We didn't stand a chance. I'm glad you got here when you did, otherwise I don't know if we would have made it.
monster.properties|m.vanaduke_defeated: We shall never fall\! We shall... never...
item.properties|f.frost_sword: This sword is as cold as ice, and it's willing to sacrifice your love, in addition to any monsters that happen to get in your way.
chat.properties|m.usage_respond: Usage\: /{0} message\nResponds to the player who sent the last /tell.
conversation.properties|m.vise_seerus:
Hello there lad\!  
Taking on ol' Seerus aye?  Careful now, he's not right in the head. Proper imbalanced that one.  

He and I go way back, but not in any way worth remembering.  Should your mission prove successful, see if you can bring me back a little souvenir.  I'll make ya something nice for your troubles.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Be careful confronting the Warmaster\!
uplink.properties|d.battle_pack: A Battle Pack is the ultimate resource for facing the challenges of King Krogmo's Coliseum.  Gift it to a friend who is brave enough to enter the arena with you\!
item.properties|f.arctic_rogue_mail: A plated mail said to be crafted by an arctic rogue. It comes augmented with ice plating to conceal your location during arctic expeditions.
item.properties|f.ultra_shock_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly orbs of lightning that can give hostiles a jolt
item.properties|f.fine_fabric: A well-made length of sturdy cloth, swiped from a Clockworks inhabitant.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_3: Hi there, {0}\! As Head Chef of the Skylark I've been assigned to oversee the nutritional development of our new sprite companions. They seem to have really diversified themselves down there in the Clockworks. It will be interesting to see how they develop. \n\nDo you have any questions about feeding and caring for your sprite?
item.properties|f.capsule_health: A small capsule that restores a small amount of health. An adventurer's best friend\!
item.properties|f.pepperbox: An Autogun modified to fire high-temperature bullets capable of engulfing foes.
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_1a: Greetings, {0}\!  I hear you've recently arrived in Haven from across the great chasm.  While you were out there, did you encounter any of our battle sprites?
item.properties|f.shade_helm: A dark matter infused helm that allows its wearer to get the drop on foes by shooting straight from the shadows.
uplink.properties|m.love_rejected: Sorry, your Crucible level was rejected\: {0}
item.properties|f.ironmight_plate_mail: Superior plate mail forged from an alloy of several rare metals. It's restrictive, but incredibly strong.
item.properties|f.lockdown_guardian_shie: A shield carried by a Spiral Guardian, a stalwart protector on the battlefield.
conversation.properties|m.mission_collec: They burst out of the ground all around us...
chat.properties|m.usage_alchemy: Go to the alchemy machine in the Bazaar.
conversation.properties|m.biscotti_3: Thanks {0}, I appreciate it.  And do me a favour, please don't mention this little 'incident' to Spiral HQ...
mission.properties|o.mission_sprite_3: Secure a cache of battle sprites and return them to the Lab
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Can't...go on...
item.properties|f.deadly_dark_matter_bom: A large chunk of Dark Matter primed with a potent explosive. This bomb would be in stark violation of the Spiral Order's safety handbook if they hadn't lost the last copy in the crash.
conversation.properties|m.sl_guard_2: Recon Knights who have ventured within these strange, new worlds claim to feel a dreadful darkness enveloping them at every turn.  There's something else happening here and we need our most elite knights to investigate.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: So, you have chosen the radiant seraphynx, battle sprite of those who wish to protect their party and provide them aid? \n\nOnce you choose there is no going back\!
item.properties|f.heavy_gear: A weighted gear that previously assisted in the operation of an enormous machine.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
projectx.properties|m.love_opt_in: Join the Coliseum Crucible to test community PvP levels\:
item.properties|f.honor_blade_4: A ceremonial sword issued to Vanguards of the Spiral Order. Though intended for formal occasions, its fine edge makes it suitable for combat use.
item.properties|f.crown_fallen: A cursed crown once worn by a celestial being cast down from paradise.
item.properties|f.raging_dragon_helm: An enchanted helm crafted into the visage of a beast who some believe razed the world in its passing\: its rage became magma rain, its breath a typhoon.
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_3a: Yes, at this point you must begin forming an arsenal that protects you against special damage types. \n\nYour current missions will have you facing monsters with piercing damage attacks.  Thus, you must begin acquiring helmets, armor and shields that defend against piercing damage.
item.properties|f.stranger_cap: A hat once worn by one of the enigmatic Strangers.  Local Snipes seem to be drawn to the wearer.
social.properties|m.friend_party_full: Oops\! {0}'s party is no longer accepting new members.
item.properties|f.frenzy_dragon_helm: An enchanted helm crafted into the visage of a beast who some believe shaped the world in its passing\: its frenzy started the mighty winds, its scales became the shadows.
conversation.properties|m.mission_resear: Don't know how long before our forcefield gives out...
mission.properties|b.plan_of_attack: Deep within a toxic cavern lies a hidden test lab that gremlins have been using as a testing ground for components of Project R.  One of these components still in development is reported to have schematics for the project close by. \n\nIf this is true there will likely be a terminal of some kind close to one of Project R's components.  Locate the terminal and recover the schematics for analysis.  It should shed light on the exact nature of Project R.
projectx.properties|m.suggestion_message: Please enter your comment or suggestion. If you need more space,\nfeel free to send an e-mail to suggestions@spiralknights.com.
item.properties|d.gsc_vip: C O M P L I M E N T A R Y\n\nBecause you are a key casino patron, we are pleased to offer you membership free of charge.
monster.properties|m.overtime_2: I'm not saying to work this weekend, but everyone else is, so...
item.properties|m.use_change_color: Use your {0} to change your personal color?
helptips.properties|m.tglobby_equip: Inside the Clockworks, use Arsenal Stations to change your equipment.
item.properties|f.crimsonite_deposit_1: A small mineral deposit that will generate a single unit of crimsonite.
support.properties|m.option_204_0: Names that are offensive are not acceptable. Be aware that what you consider offensive may not generally be considered offensive. So please only click here to file the complaint if you know for sure everyone would find that name offensive.
logon.properties|m.non_public_server: The game is not currently open to the public.
helptips.properties|m.atg_teblocks: TIMED EXPLOSIVE BLOCKS will count down to 0 before exploding and causing damage.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
item.properties|f.peppermint_repeater: This holiday hand cannon is the proper piece to pepper your opponents with hot lead of holiday cheer.
item.properties|f.prize_box_companion: Contains various items for your sprite and a chance for rarities. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.chilling_duelist: Start settling disputes at the crack of dawn with this cold, custom handgun.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_1a: Greetings, {0}\!  We have two missions of vital importance.  First, we've located an energy signature similar to the one emanating from that Artifact you found in the Clockworks.  We're homing in on that energy signature now.  Finding the source might help us understand what that gremlin schemer Razwog planned on doing with the Artifact or what the device is actually capable of.
item.properties|f.prize_box_guildhall: Contains random furnishings.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.lockdown_striker_shiel: A speed-enhancing device used by Strikers, the hard-hitting shock troopers of the Spiral Order.
item.properties|f.buccaneer_bicorne: A trusty cap that offers tough protection from sun, wind, storms and spiteful seagulls.
helptips.properties|m.recon: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to activate Recon Module.
design.properties|i.place_room: Install a room at this location.
projectx.properties|m.deposit_minerals: Gather minerals and deposit them in any gate in the Arcade.
item.properties|f.ocarina_slime: Call up a companion cube to complete your conquest.
item.properties|f.capsule_health_ultra: A capsule that restores an extreme amount of health. Never leave home without one\!
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_compl: Our focus with the Spirit Mother is strong now thanks to you\! Use the water that flows from the spirit wells to extinguish the shadow fire. The path ahead is is ridden with shadow fire and Vanaduke's minions and while we sprites can do little to aid you in battle, we can at least summon spirit wells in certain areas.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_3_3: Aye, it appears I'm no longer fit for this fight.  It's up to you now, {0}. You alone possess the strength to face Seerus and bring him to justice.  Many knights have lost their lives here today.  Honor their spirits by finishing the job\!
item.properties|f.soul_dust: The dust of the departed. Whether it still retains any shred of a soul remains to be seen.
support.properties|m.subheader_step201: Spamming is when someone repeats text or sends long lines of random characters with the sole purpose of annoying others because it fills up the chat screen so they can't chat normally.\n\nIt's important that you only file a spam complaint when the spamming was so bad that you couldn't chat with others. For example a couple of lines of a few characters, while not necessary perhaps, is not bad enough to file a complaint for. Also if the repeated lines are far between (like 10 seconds between) then it also won't prevent people from chatting, even if it may be annoying that they're just writing nonsense.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_5a: Then I now authorize you to take on Arcade Missions.  You can access the Arcade via your Mission interface or approach the gates directly here in the Arcade itself. There is a massive world beneath your feet waiting to be explored.\n\nGood luck to you\!
item.properties|f.almire_tapestry: A tailored tapestry emblazoned with the elevated emblem of Almire.
item.properties|f.cobalt_armor: High-performance armor of the Spiral Order suitable for any adventure.
item.properties|f.obsidian_obstacle: A baleful shield of obelisk fragments bound by Apocrean ritual. Every time the fragments align, dark memories echo in your mind.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_4a: Vatel here will sell you a selection of recipes as well as personal color changers and other items.
item.properties|f.dread_venom_striker: An assassin's armament whose edge causes deep wounds that seep with vitriol. You should probably store it separately from your snacks.
mission.properties|r.guardians_of_cradle: I know, Vaelyn. I feel the same way.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_6a: Once again these sprites seem to have adapted their form to suit their surrounding environment.
item.properties|f.swimsuit_wrap: A spiral issue sarong draped over a one piece suit intended for coastal expeditions and fun in the sun.
item.properties|f.humbug_hat: A horrible hat worn by those who truly loathe the magic of Winterfest. The only possible explanation for this feeling is having a heart two sizes too small.
mission.properties|o.toy_soldiers: Destroy the Mecha Knight factory's production center
item.properties|f.monster_spike: A shimmering accretion found during energy storms. Clockworks creatures go wild for it.
item.properties|f.gran_faust: An upgraded Faust forged from pristine-quality shadow steel. Its charge attacks are powerful enough to curse its wielder, but that hasn't stopped Devilites from treasuring these rare blades even more highly than their meager vacation time.
item.properties|f.savage_tortofist: A handgun alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. While wielding it you can feel the primal energy of a rampaging wolver pack within waiting to be unleashed.
item.properties|f.mad_bomber_mask: A sturdy helmet designed to keep out explosions, radio waves and high-tech mind control devices. At least, that's what they *want* you to think it does.
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_c: I think I need to craft a better shield when I get back to Haven.
conversation.properties|m.af_chat_constr: I need your clothes, your boots and your motorcycle.
item.properties|f.gm_armor: Impressive indigo armor that's the indisputable indication of one of the Spiral Order's incredible Game Masters.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_r4: Meet with Biscotti in her kitchen and provide 'baking assistance.'
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_undead: The ruins of Owlite castles are dark and cursed places that are swarming with legions of undead spookats.  The worst of these, the seemingly invincible grimalkins, constantly lurk in the shadows, awaiting the moment your life-saving light is finally snuffed out. \n\nSome knights succumb to the darkness and become paralyzed with fear in these shadowy realms. The only thing that can save them are brave knights who have long lost their childhood fears of the dark and all the terrible creatures that lurk within.
item.properties|f.luminite_deposit_4: A mother lode of metalliferous minerals that will generate a jackpot of luminite.
item.properties|f.ticket_variants_1: Use this ticket at the Variant Forge to reset an item's variants to 1 random variant.
item.properties|f.hail_driver: Once you've seen the splitting bolts of unnaturally cold ice it produces, you'll understand why this Driver is hailed.
sprites.properties|d.backfire_barrier: Gain a brief movement speed boost upon executing flame barrier.
projectx.properties|m.equip_loadout_lock: There are unbound items in {0}. Equipping this loadout will automatically bind them. Are you sure?
exchange.properties|m.trade4crowns_toolt: Enter the amount of energy you want to sell, in multiples of 100
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_1a: Hello there little one. You look as though you require knowledge of some kind.
item.properties|f.blighted_bone: A peculiar patella that's seen better days, after having seen a few better knights.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_plump_rooste: An impressively-large Buhgok that is taking a nice, long rest after a hearty meal.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: Out, out, oooout\! Too many cooks in the kitchen\! Too many cooks in the kitchen\!
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_4a: Remember to accept that mission and be careful down there\!
projectx.properties|m.mission_imf: Recover the recon module in the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.
guild.properties|i.buy_themes: Change the theme for the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.shock_barrier: Surrounds you with orbs of lightning that can give hostiles a jolt
item.properties|f.guild_members_150: Allows your guild to recruit up to 150 members\!
item.properties|f.nightblade: A short slicer infused with the essence of the Underworld.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_blu: A tall torch filled with bizarre blue fire.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_partypad_2: This is a party pad. It's a big floor button that only activates when all members of the party are standing on it. They often open doors, but sometimes there is a little more to it than that...
steam.properties|e.already_converted: You have already converted one account to your Steam account. You cannot convert another.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_12: Vanguard, eh?  The Rangers are always looking for skilled knights like you, {0}.  After all this pomp is done, come see me if you want to laugh in the face of death and danger once more\!
item.properties|f.fiery_vaporizer_mkii: A Fiery Vaporizer modified to disperse combustible material over a wider range.
item.properties|f.polar_day_wolf_coat: A warm coat, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. The thick fur is needed during their never ending day patrols.
item.properties|f.warmaster_helm_2: A remake of a mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus of the Crimson Order.  Though it very much resembles the original, it is still missing pieces.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_1a: Hello {0}, I hope you're doing well.  Something has come up that will require you to face your greatest challenge yet. \n\nI have an order from Spiral HQ that comes from Captain Ozlo himself.  You have been selected as one of the Knights to actively search for traces of the Alpha Squad.
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_luggage: Some stylish suitcases suitable for stowing everything you'll need for the last trip you'll ever take.
conversation.properties|r.och_leader_2_2: The gates are as good as opened, Lieutenant\!
item.properties|f.lite_shield: A lightweight knight light that offers holistic protection.
guild.properties|i.console_edit: Work with others to decorate and modify the Guild Hall.
chat.properties|m.usage_guildinfo: Usage\: /{0} guild name\nRetrieves information about a guild.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_ora: A tall torch filled with otherworldly orange fire.
helptips.properties|m.tg_end: Hey, you made it\! That's just great, really. You just saved me a whole lot of paperwork, so thanks. Hope those retrodes weren't too much of a surprise. Head on over to the elevator and we'll call this expedition complete.
redeem.properties|m.instruct: If you have a special code to redeem a reward, you can enter it here\:
mission.properties|o.p_r9_weap_5: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_2a: I bet. I guess you'll have to fill me in for once\!
item.properties|f.empty_room_checker_lar: An empty Guild Hall room with mixed flooring and plenty of space for furniture\!
item.properties|f.gh_theme_poison: A very unique theme that gives your Guild Hall all the beauty and ambiance of a sewage system.
item.properties|f.spell_book: An old dictionary that seems to have quite a few spells within it.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_elem: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
guild.properties|m.rename_too_soon: You have renamed your guild too recently.
sprites.properties|d.high_heat: Increases the offensive power of the flame barrier.
mission.properties|m.a_call_to_arms1: This is Vaelyn at the Core Terminal. Team wiped out. Darkness everywhere. Send help. It is opening.
uplink.properties|m.login_event: Hail, {0}\! Thanks for playing Spiral Knights\! As part of a special event, please accept the attached rewards to aid you in your adventures\! \n\nAnd don't forget to check out the Supply Depot for more rare items and special offers\!
logon.properties|m.network_error: Either there is a temporary network outage or the server is not yet fully operational. Please wait a moment before reconnecting.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: You... I... What was that? Did you say something?
chat.properties|m.usage_joinknight: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nAttempts to join a player's instance or party.
item.properties|f.sinful_brew: A noxious drink favored by all fiends. Despite its prevalence, it's officially outlawed in the Underworld as a marketing ploy.
pvp.properties|m.love_delete_confirm: Are you sure? The level will be deleted.
item.properties|f.big_beast_basher: It was suggested that this brutally sharp mining pick could probably be used to hunt both beasts AND minerals. The Clockworks were never the same.
item.properties|f.pummel_gun: A Punch Gun properly modified for combat use. The recoil from its powerful charge attack is notorious amongst recruits.
item.properties|f.shade_armor: A suit of armor infused with dark matter that allows its wearer to shoot straight and surprise foes from the shadows.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeexplo: One of them lobbed a spike at me\!
conversation.properties|m.emberlight_vis: Gremlins of Emberlight thank you for stopping this threat.
mission.properties|m.intro_reward_expans: Select a mission card to receive a mission briefing, see the available rewards and enable options for starting the mission\! Expansion Missions must be unlocked via purchase in order to access.
conversation.properties|t.af_chat_beast_: Maybe they want to play catch?
item.properties|m.moved_to_arsenal: Your inventory items have been moved to your arsenal.
item.properties|f.tabard_rose: An aged, embroidered tabard that once belonged to a Knight of the Rose, a sacred order of brave and especially dashing heroes whose numerous adventures are the subject of many folk tales. The Knights of the Rose were said to be peerless fencers, believing that their blades were like the flowers of their name\: a delicate thing of beauty that hides a vicious sting.
item.properties|f.nether_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a corrupted tortodrone. A tormented howl of rage can be heard on the wind when this shield smashes through your foes.
item.properties|f.polar_night_wolf_hood: A warm hood, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. The thick fur is needed during their never ending night patrols.
item.properties|f.raging_crusader_helm: A helm worn by mythical soldiers who are said to ride their rage into battle.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: The rest of us thought we weren't going to make it. But then...then the light surrounded us and we were safe. We've taken to calling it The Sleeper. We aren't sure what it is exactly, but it needs our help. This world was created to protect it but somehow The Swarm breached the Core and has been feeding on the energy and growing like a leech ever since.
item.properties|f.sacred_keeper_helm: A cerulean hued helm for those who want to wreck some robos.
item.properties|f.defender: A durable, high quality shield of the Spiral Order that is suitable for any adventure.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_1a: Greetings, {0}. I imagine you have some questions about battle sprites. How can I assist you?
mission.properties|b.first_contact_b: With the power restored to the Rescue Camp, you can now use your comlink to contact Spiral HQ and find out where they have located after the crash of the Skylark.  Once you have made contact with Spiral HQ you will hopefully find out what caused the crash and the nature of this alien world you now inhabit.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: If only there were some way to open up those gates\!
mission.properties|m.search_continues_3a: Perhaps.  It certainly could be when you look at it.  We'll need to study it further.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: What little we've recovered from the Core Terminal has every Geo Knight, Biotech, and Tech Knight absolutely stumped. We'll be analyzing these findings for quite some time.
mission.properties|o.darkest_forces: Learn about the most powerful fiend and undead monsters
mission.properties|m.new_threat_bystande: I just heard an explosion in the back of the lab\! \n\nWe'll handle these monsters, {0}.  You go and make sure the Artifact is secure\!  Hurry\!
chat.properties|m.usage_cry: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nCause your knight to cry.
helptips.properties|m.token_trader_info: Spiral HQ offers special items to select knights through the exchange of special tokens found within the Clockworks. These tokens are often earned from defeating fierce boss monsters and are proof of the owner's bravery.
item.properties|f.exp_east_4f: An expansion that adds three rooms and a small overlook to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
helptips.properties|m.pressure_pads: These special buttons will only trigger if something is holding them down. Try using that statue to hold one down.
helptips.properties|m.loading16: Using a shield can help you completely avoid damage, so make sure to use it\! Press "[[DEFEND]]" to defend. As the shield takes damage it will turn red and eventually break. The shield must regenerate before it can be used again.
chat.properties|m.player_between_scenes: That player is moving between scenes.
uplink.properties|m.autoprune: Note\: Mail is automatically deleted 30 days after sent date.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: So, you have chosen the shadowy maskeraith, battle sprite of those who wish to lurk in the shadows and strike the enemy with sneak attacks? \n\nOnce you choose there is no going back\!
craft.properties|e.cant_use_accessory: This item is not compatible with this accessory type.
conversation.properties|r.och_leader_3_3: Roger that, Lieutenant.  I'll make the Warmaster pay.
conversation.properties|r.final_test_kni: (Tell Feron about the Rescue Camp, Razwog and the Artifact)
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_1a: Congratulations {0}\!  Knight Elite huh?  Wow, you must be proud\!
conversation.properties|r.final_test_kni: Thank you, Lieutenant, I'll head on into Haven.
item.properties|f.furni_table_manor_1: An exquisite end table, meticulously manufactured for monumental magnificence.
conversation.properties|m.mission_crimso: King Tinkinzar alone holds the Iron Law\!
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r6: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
uplink.properties|d.starter_pack: A Starter Pack is everything a Knight needs to begin their adventure on the strange, new world of Cradle. Gift it to a friend that you know will have your back\!
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_9a: Okay then, let's start from the top.
item.properties|f.sinister_skelly_suit: A bony barrier that throbs with malevolence. Anyone skeptical of this suit's power deserves a good ribbing.
mission.properties|b.alone_in_dark: The spookats of Moorcroft Manor have another valuable piece of intel for us that is worth investigating.  They say that a lost soul of the former Kingdom of Almire resides in a soldier's graveyard near the Firestorm Citadel.  This soul is willing to provide us with the information on the nature of the citadel as well as how we can get through it and reach the Core. \n\nReaching him will not be easy given his location.  Graveyards are terrible places, especially at this depth.  It is highly advisable that you move through the graveyard as quickly as possible in your search for this lost soul.
mission.properties|r.securing_camp_b_1a: I'll head over to the Arsenal Station and equip my Proto Bomb\!
guild.properties|e.guild_deleted: Sorry, that guild has been disbanded.
mission.properties|r.pioneers_7a: Tell me about Squad Recon Parma.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_6a: Hold fast, traveler. You stand in the court of the Kingdom of Almire. Do you not hear the trumpets sound the return of our mighty legions? Are you not in awe of the prestigious heraldry of our great houses and statesmen?
mission.properties|b.mission_sprite_1: Rhendon is waiting for you in an area of the Clockworks known as the Sunset Steppes where reconnaissance has located a cache of missing battle sprites.  Secure the sprites and clear the area of hostiles.  You are authorized to utilize any sprites you secure in order to complete the mission.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.celestial_ore: An extremely rare metal of great power said to be from the heavens above.  It is often completely wasted on crowns and jewelry for slime royalty.
mission.properties|r.go_shopping_7b: Thanks Bechamel, I'll be seeing you\!
item.properties|f.firebreak_armor: Upgraded Emberbreak armor further hacked to resist fire.

mission.properties|m.first_contact_2a:
You're eager, that's good.  Your current mission is to reach the town of Haven where Spiral HQ has set up base.  Spend the time you need within the Rescue Camp to prepare yourself for your journey to come. 

Make use of any traveling merchants as well as the knowledge of other knights in the camp to learn how to survive in this new world.  I will contact you again once you reach Haven. 

Good luck to you.

The master of this realm has seen to it that the flames surrounding him will always burn.

item.properties|f.prize_box_rooster: Contains various unique items to celebrate the year of the Rooster\! Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro_1a: Welcome to Cradle, recruit\! Always happy to see a knight survive a drop in one piece. We have a Rescue Camp not far from your position.  I'll guide you there- but ready your sword, there are hostiles on the road ahead\!\n
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_pur: A tall torch filled with peculiar purple fire.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
chat.properties|m.epicfail_format: {0} is appalled at that profound display of Epic Fail.
mission.properties|m.darkest_forces_2a: You have a strange definition of recreation if that's the case.  Tier 3 fiends and undead are nothing to sneeze at, in fact they're among the worst creatures you'll find so close to the Core. \n\nDevilite management seems to be the worst at these depths and that results in some very violent devilites.

mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_5: It is time you entered the Hall of Heroes once more.  Having been fully Star Certified and successfully completed so many missions that have ensured the survival of the Spiral Knights on Cradle, Spiral HQ is preparing you for the high rank of Vanguard.

mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r7:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.
item.properties|f.infernal_guardian_armo: Charred, stygian armor worn by those who defend the infernal depths.
item.properties|f.vial_fire: A glass vial containing a molten mixture. It can be used to inflict enemies with Fire.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and turn 'em into toast\!
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro3_1a: {0}\! Am I glad to see you\!  This place is so alien, I'm happy to see a familiar face and not another hostile.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: We've had a few cases where knights have met non-hostile constructs that they swear behaved like true sentient creatures.  But that is very difficult to believe. Gremlins are brilliant, but brilliant at the kind of direct engineering that simply gets the job done and little else.  Brute force. \n\nArtificial life?  Well, that's something else entirely.
mission.properties|m.intro_arcade_locked: Complete Rank Missions to gain access to Arcade Missions\!
item.properties|f.bushy_tail: A peculiarly intact specimen of a Clockworks beast's tail.
mission.properties|b.crossing_chasm_b: Having restored power to the Rescue Camp and established contact with Spiral HQ, it's time you attempted to cross the chasm north of the Rescue Camp and reach Haven where the rest of the Spiral Knights have taken refuge. \n\nIn order to cross the chasm you will need to take an elevator down into the Clockworks and find another to bring you up on the other side.  There's no telling what dangers lurk in the dark depths below so Rhendon will be accompanying you on your journey.
mission.properties|b.blades_fallen:
Not every knight who enters the Clockworks returns to feel the sun on their face once more.  Within the perilous depths of the Clockworks, those that brave its dangers always face the reality that every expedition may be their last.  Sometimes their bodies can be recovered and other times all that is left is remnants of their gear. 

Just outside of Haven, Spiral HQ has built a soldier's graveyard where fallen knights can lay to rest.  As a Spiral Knight, you must face the reality of death in order to understand its gravity. 

Deliver the remains of an unknown knight, a sword, to a memorial within the graveyard.  But stay alert- dark energies resonate from the graveyard, attracted to the countless souls it houses.

item.properties|f.ancient_plate_shield: An antique shield whose origins have been lost to the passing of time.
conversation.properties|m.casino_yesman_: Everyjelly is welcome at the Golden Slime\!
item.properties|f.proto_blade: A swift, compact utility blade issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.aero_armor: A sleek-fitting aerodynamic armor made with lightweight gremlin alloys. It will reduce unwanted turbulence during chaotic dogfights.
item.properties|f.woven_shade_helm: A loose fitting helm that enables its wearer to slink through the shadows and assault unaware enemies.
craft.properties|e.existing_accessory: This item already has an accessory of this type. Remove it first.
mission.properties|o.shocking_sentient_s: Battle your way to the secret weapons facility
item.properties|f.overcharged_mixmaster: An industrial strength handheld mixer that is sure to stir things up.
item.properties|f.obsidian_hood_of_devot: 'Wrap thy self in my embrace and succumb to my infinite love. Let your breath drift from you like candle smoke, dreaming deeper and deeper still.'
item.properties|f.torpor_tantrum: The ultimate sleep bomb. It's like a bedtime story, only more explodey.
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_shock: We've been receiving reports that Groat, a local Emberlight chef has been acting... strange. It seems that Biscotti commissioned him to do some baking on her behalf but the responsibility may have gone to his head.  He disappeared into the Clockworks soon after Biscotti delivered the last crate of batter. With the Anniversary celebrations at stake once again, Biscotti needs some culinary champions to help her sort out this mix-up\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_end_1a: This is it, recruit. This is the final gate that leads out of the Rescue Camp, through the chasm and into Haven. Once you pass through, you will never need to return here. You can buy everything found in the Rescue Camp and much more in Haven. \n\nAny questions?
mission.properties|b.alien_ooze: One of our field research teams is under siege from a large colony of lichens. Lichens are an alien species of the slime family thought to have come to the Clockworks via a meteor that crashed on to the surface of Cradle.  This particular species of slime is formed from innumerable smaller slimes that form mobile, sentient 'colonies.' \n\nLichen colonies can further combine to form larger and larger versions of themselves, rapidly evolving a range of deadly claws and barbs.  Prevent them from combining at all costs and save the research team\!
item.properties|f.brute_jelly_shield: A thick shield made from the remains of particularly ill-mannered slimes. It is durable, light, and delightfully berry-flavored.
item.properties|f.training_room: A simple room providing access to a private guild training hall, perfect for learning new skills or keeping old ones current.
item.properties|f.thwacker_shield: A shield repurposed by gremlins and worn by Darkfang Thwackers. Similar to the gremlins themselves, it is resistant to fire and shock attacks. Knights who use these shields report that is impossible to completely remove all the fur stuck to it.
item.properties|f.seraphic_mail: A beautiful mail coat that causes its wearer to strike out at evil with righteous fury.
helptips.properties|m.loading5: You can see what your friends are up to by clicking on the social button in the bottom left corner of your screen. You can even instantly join them if there is room in their party.
mission.properties|o.axes_of_evil: Stop the gremlin logging operation in the Jigsaw Valley
sprites.properties|d.protection: Increases the defensive powers of the angelic aura.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_pu: A short torch filled with peculiar purple fire.
item.properties|f.plate_helm: A heavy duty helm suited for heavy combat.
item.properties|f.wild_shell: A shield alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. It's tough enough to dull a jelly barb on impact.
auction.properties|e.selected_updated: The selected auction has been updated.
mission.properties|m.shadow_knows_1a: {0}, I hear you have been promoted to Knight... er, well done, yes?
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: There isn't much time. I can't reach you from here and you need to make it out. Warn headquarters. Warn Haven\! If the Core isn't kept sealed The Swarm will escape and it will continue to consume everything and everyone.
logon.properties|m.trying_next_port: Failed to connect to the server. Trying an alternative port. Please wait...
item.properties|f.buckled_coat: A verdant coat fastened with shiny golden buckles.
sprites.properties|d.violent_heart_attac: Targets destroyed while enchanted create an explosion.
item.properties|f.zapper: A modified Proto Gun augmented with a low intensity electrical charge.
helptips.properties|m.atg_togswitch: Switches can open AND close doors.
item.properties|f.evo_catalyst: A contained charge of highly unstable energy that can be synthesized by battle sprites. In doing so, sprites can evolve into greater forms and learn new skills.
global.properties|e.invalid_xfer_state: An error has been detected with your knight. Please log off and back on again. If the problem persists, please file a bug report.
conversation.properties|m.rc_technician_: According to these scans there should be some kind of power source in the depths below the camp, but it's being diverted somehow...
projectx.properties|m.cross_the_chasm: Cross the chasm to reach Haven.
mission.properties|r.winterfest_danger_1: I need all the help I can get, tell me all you know.
item.properties|f.rock_jelly_shield: Crafted from the most adamant of slimy specimens, it also functions as an emergency source of calories for stranded knights.
item.properties|f.vile_seal: A small scrap of ancient parchment imbued with dark magicks. It is believed that they grant power to those with evil souls.
helptips.properties|m.controls: Press [[TOGGLE_HELP]] at any time to view the controls.
conversation.properties|m.final_test_kni:
Astounding\!  I would have never expected a new recruit to crawl out of that fiery wreckage alive\!  You must really be something else... 

The name's Feron, Lieutenant of the Spiral Order.  We had believed this entire complex was derelict until the elevator leading to it suddenly surged to life.  Upon investigating the whole place soon went up in a blaze\! 

How did you end up here?
conversation.properties|m.almire_histori: From the tomes we have recovered, we've learned that Firestorm Citadel was once part of a much larger kingdom known as Almire thousands of years ago. Although it was bordered by other aggressive nations, Almire was renowned for the martial prowess of its many legions. These legions kept the kingdom safe for many years. Alas, they weren't enough.
item.properties|f.bucket_of_flawed_snowb: This bucket seems to have an endless supply of Flawed Snowballs. Unfortunately, they will start to melt when exposed, so you better use them fast\!
mission.properties|m.anniversary_start_4: Great\!  I'll meet you near the exit once you've cleared them out.  Careful though, they seem to have adapted the use of birthday candles as weapons...
conversation.properties|m.npc_lostknight: I could leave but think of all I could learn if I stayed\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_4a: Heh, don't look now, {0}, but there's a ghost over your shoulder\! Let's hope these sprites haven't invested all their power into good looks. \n\nUse that one to clear the path ahead so a rescue team can get through safely\!
item.properties|f.obsidian_mantle_of_rit: 'With great practice and tender care, with an eternal heart and mind so pure\: sharpen the stone, sturdy the chain, welcome the night, drink the Cup of Kings.'
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: The seraphynx sounds like the battle sprite for me\!
mission.properties|m.pioneers_9a: Rulen was recruited as the technical genius that Captain Ozlo believed would be required for navigating the vast, mechanized world of the Clockworks.  His primary responsibilities included everything from disabling locks to repairing armor to wrecking sentient constructs.  He was additionally the lead on analyzing the Core once the squad reached it.
uplink.properties|m.mission_rewards: Attention {0}\!  Our data shows that a recent mission you successfully completed, {1}, did not issue rewards to you following the end of the mission.  These rewards are enclosed in this mail. \n\nPlease accept these rewards, gear up and continue your adventure\!
logon.properties|m.peer_redirect: You are logged into a different peer. Redirecting...
mission.properties|m.alone_in_dark_2a: Lord Vanaduke rules over the citadel now.  His soul bound to some horrific armored prison. \n\nHe has the citadel ready for battle at all times, believing that his kingdom is still under siege.  He doesn't even realize that what he is trying to protect was lost a thousand years ago.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roar: An unarmed, half-scale reproduction of the end product of Project Roarmulus. Without armaments, it's really only good for cheering up a dreary room.
item.properties|f.firo_driver: A high-tech alchemical sidearm that fires powerful firo bullets that split multiple times on impact.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_cj_gamepad: Gamepad used for targeting, attacking, movement, advanced commands and quickslots
mission.properties|r.cwt_mintut_6: Sounds great\! Thanks for the info\!
item.properties|f.shock_raider_helm: A simple helm, shielding the wearer from the elements and enemies alike.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_2_3a: Congratulations {0}, you meet the necessary requirements and have received your 3 Star Certification.  Take the elevator behind me in order to complete your mission.
conversation.properties|r.biscotti_1: This all sounds really strange, but I'm happy to help if I can.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_gunn: Howdy {0}, the name's Daxen. I'm a knight who specializes in gunslinging.  The recipes I have for you produce weapons and gear that focus on ranged combat... you know, shootin' stuff. \n\nHandguns allow you to hit your enemies from a safe distance, but don't offer you many options once they close in on ya.  You've got to think and shoot fast to be a good gunslinger.  The gear I specialize in will make you a dead shot, not a dead knight.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_10a: Rulen was very... logical.  I think he was very aware of the odds we have of reaching the Core and then doing something with it in order to restore the Skylark.  I think Rulen knew exactly what kind of mission he was undertaking when they made their first descent into the darkness of the Clockworks.
chat.properties|m.usage_get_values: Usage\: /{0}\nGet the current spawn floor values.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_16: Another tour? No problem, follow me\!
item.properties|f.firebreak_shield: An Emberbreak Shield modified for increased protection against fire.
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch: Welcome to the Moorcroft Archives, traveler. Here you will find an illustrious collection of ancient grimoires from many forgotten worlds. It's quite the sight, I know\! \n\nYou're free to look around but please don't touch- some of these books are filled with incredible mystic power. You could hurt yourself\!
item.properties|f.starlit_hunting_cap: An advanced hunting cap, illuminated and downy, that resists the strongest sleep mists.
conversation.properties|r.arc_mintut_1: I'm here to learn about the minerals found within the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.storm_chaser: A rare elemental found hovering in storm clouds. Their electric hum creates an almost melodic choir that can be faintly heard between thunderclaps.
item.properties|f.authentic_mask: A high quality {0} mask made to celebrate the Dark Harvest Festival. It's very well made and lasts forever\!
item.properties|f.dark_matter_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in Dark Matter. Since its original discovery, Dark Matter has been put to a variety of uses, from powering Spiral technology, to rearranging Gremlins on a subatomic level.
helptips.properties|m.event_module: Warning\! An unidentified place of interest lies beyond this gate. By entering you will not be able to turn back until you complete the challenges within.\n\nHowever, should you manage to come out victorious you will be rewarded for your bravery. Enter at your own risk\!

mission.properties|o.abandoned_depot: Learn the basics of survival in the Abandoned Depot
mission.properties|o.p_r9_weap_4: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_securi: Please check that the CVC or CVV security code is correct and try again. Your card has not been charged.
item.properties|f.prize_box_volcanic: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Volcanic style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.valestone_deposit_3: A large lump of minerals that will generate a great many units of moonstone
item.properties|f.polar_day_warden_hood: An insulated hood that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The full coverage mask makes it ideal for hours of daytime watch duty.
item.properties|f.budding_helm: This cracked biotech helm is home to a harmless decorative plant.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_3_8a: I assume you've named them as well?
helptips.properties|m.danger_module: Warning\! The path beyond this point is far more dangerous than what you would expect on this level. Enter at your own risk\!
item.properties|f.luminite: A fabled mineral of a radiant, golden color said to contain the faith, wisdom and zeal of the life surrounding it.
item.properties|f.almire_chair: A chiseled chair as ancient as Almire's ailing aristocrats.
item.properties|f.shocking_edge: A light blade that can deliver a painful shock to its victims. Youthful knights enjoy waving these around on holidays.
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_4: Once you safely reach the elevator, the mineral you are carrying gets deposited in your arsenal for use later. Everyone in your party gets everyone else's minerals, so no need to fight over who gets the best one\!
item.properties|f.helm_top: An accessory that can be attached to the top of select helmets.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
mission.properties|o.welcome_to_haven: Contact Intel Agent Kora via Comlink
social.properties|m.autofriend_single: Your {0} friend {1} just started playing Spiral Knights as {2}\! You have automatically been made friends.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_or: A short torch filled with otherworldly orange fire.
mission.properties|b.from_below: A squad of Desna's Recon Rangers is trapped somewhere in the depths of the Clockworks by a mysterious force. Judging from the severity of the reports and panicked communications from the squad, Spiral HQ believes that only someone with your experience is capable of handling whatever deadly force has trapped them.
exchange.properties|m.trade4energy_toolt: The best current market price. A response of ??? indicates that there is no current market offer for the amount you've entered.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_1a: Welcome to the Haven Bazaar\!  It's a pleasure to meet you {0}, my name is Bechamel. Since I work here in the Bazaar, Spiral HQ has asked me to show new arrivals around this fabulous epicenter of commerce and let them know everything it has to offer. \n\nSo let's go on a quick tour shall we?  Try and keep up, I walk fast.
social.properties|m.already_invited: {0} has already been invited to your party.
item.properties|f.starlit_demo_suit: An advanced demolitions suit capable of resisting the strongest sleep mists. The soft glow is strangely stimulating.
projectx.properties|e.too_young: You must be at least 13 to play Spiral Knights.
conversation.properties|m.npc_mineraltec: Hmm, certain combinations seem to attract different kinds of monsters.
item.properties|f.rocket_hammer_1: Designed by Warmaster Seerus himself, this nefarious gremlin weapon is equipped with a rocket engine that can launch the wielder forward with a powerful hammer smash.  This particular model is a prototype version.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Royal Jelly \nThis massive gelatinous cube has a short fuse and loves to throw his weight around. When his royal tasters are absent a poisoned parfait would be a royal pain.
mission.properties|o.crimson_chaos: Investigate a Crimson Order base that has suddenly gone silent
item.properties|f.prize_box_gobble: Contains various festive Gobble Snipes for your Guild Hall including the very large 'Plump Gobble Snipes.' Items are randomly chosen. No key required to open.
support.properties|m.option_1_1: 2. If {0} has been offensive or harassing and has not stopped when asked, click here to file a complaint.
mission.properties|b.axes_of_evil: A gremlin logging operation has been discovered in levels known as the 'Jigsaw Valley.'  These strangely carved islands are home to an even stranger species of twisting trees that gremlins seem to be determined to completely wipe out. \n\nSpiral HQ believes that gremlins are using the lumber from this operation as resources for the development of Project R and needs you to enter the Jigsaw Valley and shut it down.
item.properties|f.spark_plug: A small, mechanical component that really gets a construct's motor running.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_6b: I'd like to see the services. (Follow Tylen)
item.properties|f.gremlin_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a gremlin.  It's so convincing, you just might receive an invitation to the Colony\!
helptips.properties|m.tg1_shield_2: As your shield absorbs damage it will turn from green to red and eventually break. Once it's broken you cannot defend until it regenerates, so be careful\!
item.properties|f.flamberge: A fiery foil that burns through as it runs through.
trade.properties|e.cart_removed.n: NOTE\: a stack (of {0}) of {1} was removed from the cart.
exchange.properties|m.credit_card_toolti: Purchases the selected amount of Energy right now with your credit card.
mission.properties|o.advanced_alchemy: Visit Bosco and discover the potential of advanced alchemy
mission.properties|b.p_moorcroft2:
Someone or something has summoned a horde of cursed black kats into the Clockworks. These shadowy beasts hunger for arcane power and raided the Moorcroft Manor Archives' precious collection of magical grimoires. 

In the wrong hands these ancient tomes could be catastrophic, but it turns out that black kats can't read, so they instead decided to just eat them.

The residents of Moorcroft Manor would like you to retrieve the Ancient Pages of the magical grimoires that quite likely reside in the stomachs of black kats. We'll leave you to figure out just how to recover them... 

For this mission, journey into a fiery furnace where intel has located a black kat nest. Recover those Ancient Pages and return them to Moorcroft Manor\!
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft3_r6: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
mission.properties|o.scarlet_fortress: Chart an expedition through the haunted halls of the Scarlet Fortress
mission.properties|b.shocking_sentient_s:
Recon Knights have uncovered a secret weapons facility that according to the intel we have available, could belong to a high ranking gremlin of The Crimson Order.  It is heavily fortified by a small army of electrified constructs who have no doubt been programmed to defend the facility at all costs. 

While it is unclear if this weapons stash actually belongs to a gremlin of The Crimson Order, it is no less worth infiltrating and neutralizing the weapons stash. 

It is advised that you prepare yourself with elemental damage and shock resistant gear before deploying.
item.properties|f.royal_jelly_mail: A viciously viscous set of armor crafted painstakingly from the most noble specimens of quivering slime.
shop.properties|m.cart_costume_own: Warning\! You already own this exact costume.
mission.properties|m.darkest_forces_4a: Yes, I can think of no greater tragedy.  Good luck then, {0}.
support.properties|m.option_210_0: You should only be using this option if none of the other options covers your complaint. Click here to go back and see if the other options might be useful.
sprites.properties|d.enduring_light: Increases the duration of the ray of light.
mission.properties|b.shadowplay: Even after Lord Vanaduke's defeat at your hands, Firestorm Citadel continues to burn with accursed flames. Though the nature sprites have been steadily making progress in fighting the flames, something or someone has recently caused a violent resurgence in its destructive power. Spiral HQ requests that you gather together a crack squad of knights and return to the collapsing ruins of Firestorm Citadel in order to discover the source of the disturbance.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_mat_2: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|b.operation_crimson_h:
Warmaster Seerus is the master of munitions of the gremlin's Crimson Order.  Thought to be the true mastermind behind the Roarmulus Twins and countless other gremlin weapons, he is the Crimson Order's creator and supplier for their diabolical engines of war. 

Recon Knights under the command of Lieutenant Feron recently discovered Seerus's 'Grand Arsenal,' his development center and storage facility for all his weaponry.  Now, Feron himself is leading several squads of knights directly into the Grand Arsenal, with the intention of weeding out Seerus and destroying his war machines. 

Met with heavy resistance, Feron's squads require reinforcements and Spiral HQ is sending you in to assist.
mission.properties|m.arsenal_knight_1a: You can use the Arsenal Station behind me to change your gear. Once you head down into the Clockworks you will only be able to swap out your equipped gear at an Arsenal Station like this one, so it's best to be prepared\!
item.properties|f.furni_pet_plump_gobble: An impressively-large gobble snipe that is taking a nice, long rest after a hearty meal.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_5a: We discovered a town known as 'Haven' and have set up a base of operations there. The locals have provided us with food, shelter and power.  It's not Isora, but it's home for now. \n\nI've pinpointed your location.  Unfortunately you'll need to cross a massive chasm in order to reach Haven.  Perhaps now that your camp has power there is an elevator somewhere leading into the Clockworks.  You may just be able to reach us that way.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_gate_construct: Destroy the operational war machines within the ruined factory\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_supplies_b: It's been days since we had fresh supplies.
board.properties|i.joinparty: Join a party already in progress.
mission.properties|o.hall_of_heroes_5: Visit the Hall of Heroes and receive your commendation
item.properties|f.dangerous_draped_armor: Loose-fitting armor worn by more experienced Recon Rangers. It's rumored that gear like this is crafted from the remains of armor from Rangers who fell in combat, acting as a reminder to the wearer that they are always within Death's embrace.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_7b: Wonderful\!  I'm glad I could help you get your bearings. Good luck to you, {0}\!
item.properties|f.mecha_knight_kit: Instantly creates a mecha knight for your protection
mission.properties|o.hall_of_heroes_4: Visit the Hall of Heroes wearing 5 Star gear and receive certification
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_16: Wonderful\!  I'm glad I could help you get your bearings. Good luck to you, {0}\!
projectx.properties|m.downloading: Please wait while we install the rest of the game.
item.properties|f.mercurial_demo_helm: A demo helm made from gremlin technology. It is for the bomber that wants a boost of speed, more power and a greatly reduced chance of dying by electrocution... which is probably every bomber out there.
item.properties|f.prize_box_gremlin: Contains various unique costumes and items crafted by Gremlins. Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: I'll sneak out after it's safe.  Thank you for rescuing me\!
mission.properties|b.p_r9_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
guild.properties|e.statue_deploy_limit: Sorry, only {0} knight statues may be placed in a hall at once. To add this statue, please remove another one.
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_6: That jelly palace...what an odd place. Also, I wonder what that strange device you found inside the palace was? It didn't appear to be made by the likes of jellies.
mission.properties|r.go_shopping_b_2a: Sure, let's head to the bazaar.
helptips.properties|m.sprite_cooldown: After using any sprite skill, a cooldown is required on all skills before using them again.
mission.properties|o.delved_too_deep: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
conversation.properties|m.biscotti_1: Hi there, I'm Biscotti, Head Chef of the Skylark\!  We've got a little situation on our hands that may or may not involve sentient, monstrous cakes that may or may not have completely overtaken my kitchen and infested the Clockworks... \n\nAnyway, I've worked it out with the Strangers to provide rewards for turning in slices of cake that prove you've helped eradicate these horrible monsters that may or may not exist.
mission.properties|m.another_trace_2a: The place is as strange as it sounds.  Apparently, monsters within the slime family actually have a ruling aristocracy of elite slimes.  These 'Royal Jellies' are enormous, selfish and ill-tempered slimes that live in opulent palaces that we can only guess have been squatted in as we do not believe slimes are capable of building structures.
item.properties|f.ticket_unbind_1: Use this ticket at the Unbinding Forge to unbind a 1 star item.
item.properties|f.prize_box_spritely: Contains various unique accessories and new Sprite colors to celebrate Battle Sprites. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|m.core_guard_1: You should go speak with Vaelyn.
item.properties|f.scary_skelly_suit: An upgraded Skelly Suit infused with the elemental essence of fear. It comes standard with matching pants that cannot be scared off.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_10: Your sarcasm has been noted. \n\nNow then, about those empty sprite transport crates; we have confirmed foul play.
mission.properties|m.true_champion_2a: Well, as far as I'm concerned this is only the beginning for you, {0}.  You are a true Champion of the Spiral Knights.  And since I haven't been reassigned, I suppose it's just the beginning for 'us' as well\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_g: Have you seen a danger room yet? I hear they are really tough.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_3a: Well, keep your wits about you. If the surface of this world is crawling with monsters, who knows what you'll find down there in the dark\!
guild.properties|log.mist_added: Deposited {0} energy to the energy well (new total\: {1}).
item.properties|f.cold_snap: A Proto Bomb modified to generate small bursts of frost upon detonation.
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_s: Hey\!  I hear you're the one bringin' in all these spikes?
uplink.properties|m.royal_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, we've detected another Recon Module of the Alpha Squad within this palace.  It is your mission to locate and retrieve the module. 

The Royal Jelly Palace is a strange place.  It appears to be some sort of castle that slimes have re-purposed as a residence for members of their oozing aristocracy.  Known as a 'Royal Jelly,' these noble slimes are said to rule over their countless loyal subjects with an iron fist-shaped appendage. 

Our intel suggests that the module is located somewhere near an enormous concentration of slimes, so it is reasonable to believe that it may be the 'throne room' of a Royal Jelly.  If so, be prepared for a fearsome fight- Royal Jellies are quick to anger and love to throw their enormous weight around.  Your best bet is to find a way to suppress their natural regenerative abilities. 

Good luck\!
dungeon.properties|m.lobby_desc: A lobby before entering a gate where knights can strategize and gear up for the adventure to come.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Sneak around and see if you can get inside that gatehouse\!
item.properties|f.token_krogmo: A coin issued by the great King Krogmo to participants in his Coliseum.  It can be exchanged for prizes from the Coliseum Rewards Supervisor.
item.properties|f.kamarin: A low-tech sword that's less effective at cutting than it is at crushing your enemies and seeing them driven before you.
guild.properties|log.room_placed: Placed a {0} for {1} crowns, replacing a {2}.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_2a: The inhabitants native of Haven are called 'Strangers.' You can't miss them- they're the towering, cloaked figures with masks. Despite their intimidating appearance, they have been extremely helpful to us and mostly keep to themselves. The odd, little birds in town certainly seem to like them anyway\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeknigh: Wild energy spikes down in the Clockworks.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_1a: Listen up, Rangers\!  Grab your scarves and sharpened swords because where we're going isn't going to include a warm welcome\!  Our scouts report that Amu-Sol is a frozen wasteland filled with fiends and hungry beasts.  This fiendish city seems to be spreading its icy chill throughout the Clockworks and if we don't get in there and figure out why, it's going to be a long winter here on Cradle. \n\nLet's ride, Rangers\!
mission.properties|b.crimson_chaos: Spiral HQ has been monitoring several known Crimson Order bases in hopes of intercepting one of their elusive high-ranking members. Recon knights assigned to watch one of those bases report that it has suddenly gone silent and have requested backup before investigating it further. Head down to their location and investigate the base for any signs of what has happened.
exchange.properties|m.other_tooltip: Opens the online Energy Depot in your browser where you can use a variety of payment methods to get more Energy.
item.properties|f.prize_box_hunter: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Hunter style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_b4e2c2: Unlock and fill every equipment slot.
