item.properties|f.chroma_tear: A crystallized Chromalisk tear suitable as a lens for focusing weaponry, or for correcting myopia.
social.properties|m.watch_full: Oops\! That party is no longer accepting new watchers.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We'll hold the line\!
item.properties|f.token_candy: A piece of candy made to celebrate the Dark Harvest Festival.  It can be exchanged in the Haven Town Square for various costume masks.
item.properties|f.nodeslime_shield: This weathered wobbling wall can withstand a walloping when wielded by unwaveringly willed warriors.
item.properties|f.toxic_core: A solid, pulsating lump that oozes with vitriol.
projectx.properties|e.name_vulgar: Sorry, that name contains an inappropriate word. Please try another.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Get inside, use the elevator...blow up whatever is controlling those cannons\!
exchange.properties|m.steam_overlay_disa: The Steam overlay must be enabled in order to purchase energy.  Please ensure that "Enable Steam Community In-Game" is checked in the Steam "In-Game" settings, then restart the game.
item.properties|f.lump_coal: A Grinchlin gift for those who have been naughty or nice.  Grinchlins are equal opportunity party poopers.
item.properties|f.round_helm: A svelte helm that's just waiting to be accessorized.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Continue to fight the good fight, {0}. Remember what you've learned. Farewell\!
item.properties|f.tusk_helm: Modeled after noble beasts known for their strength and fearlessness, this helm strikes such terror and respect in its wearer's enemies that the deeds will be talked about for ages to come.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_3a: Punch and Vise are gremlin smiths that can change the properties of your weapons and gear.
steam.properties|m.convert_to_steam: Would you like to move your knights, energy, achievements, etc., to your Steam account? \nThis will allow you to log on automatically at start up as well as to take advantage of \nSteam features such as achievements, voice chat, and invites.
sprites.properties|d.golden_harness_eli: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal piercing damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 10% \nCan be used by\: Seraphynx, Maskeraith
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Zombies \nShambling Zombies will rise from the dead if killed near a Grim Totem. Draw them away so you can give them eternal rest.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_1a: Greetings {0}, this is Intel Agent Kora confirming your contact with Spiral HQ. I will serve as your main connection to Spiral HQ during your time here on Cradle and provide you with intel for the many dangerous missions you have ahead of you. \n\nMy data briefing on your training performances in the Skylark suggests that you will be well-suited for what's to come.  I look forward to our working together.
mission.properties|r.creators_and_create: So all constructs in the Clockworks were created by the gremlins?
item.properties|f.hololite_box: Contains one randomly-chosen Hololite costume or accessory.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.honor_blade_2: A ceremonial sword issued to seasoned Spiral Knights. Though intended for formal occasions, its fine edge makes it suitable for combat use.
uplink.properties|t.newsletter: Subscribe to the Spiral Knights Newsletter\!
conversation.properties|m.energy_info_3c: Energy can only be obtained by purchase with a real money transaction or for trade via the Exchange. To purchase or trade for energy, simply open the Supply Depot and click the 'Get Energy' button.
item.properties|f.wild_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_5a: You don't understand, do you? You simply don't have a choice.
item.properties|f.final_flourish: The premier armament of the serious fencer, it can riposte just as easily as it can rip up foes.
item.properties|f.guild_storage: Permanently adds Member Storage, Veteran Storage and Officer Storage options to Guild Command Console. Storages allow guild members of sufficient rank to exchange unbound items with other guild members.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_coba: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_2a: You stand within the Hall of Heroes, where the best of the Spiral Knights offer what they can to aspiring knights.  Knights like you yourself once were when you first emerged from your drop pod and found your way to Haven. \n\nAnd after so many successful missions, daring rescues and exemplary performance in battle, you now stand fit to join these heroes.
mission.properties|r.darkest_forces_1a: Yes, my next missions will have me facing fiends and undead.  Sounds fun.
item.properties|f.blizzbrand: A high-tech blade that fuses Spiral and Clockwork technology. It can produce a concentrated low-temperature explosion that is harmless to knights.
mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_2: In order to venture even deeper within the Clockworks you must once again visit the Hall of Heroes and speak to Lieutenant Barrus to receive your 3 Star Certification.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_ebcd68: Defeat the Royal Jelly squatting in the Royal Jelly Palace.
item.properties|f.ice_queen_mail: A regal suit of armor resembling the ever-frigid Ice Queen.  In addition to providing great defense, it is said to dramatically boost one's ego and create a cold detachment from those around them.
conversation.properties|r.fountain_1: Thanks for the information, I'm off to explore\!
mission.properties|o.frostifur_fandango: Hunt down the ferocious Snowclaw Pack
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_2a: Great\!  Now a quick lesson on charge attacks. \n\nCharge attacks can be performed with any weapon by holding down the ATTACK button and waiting for the charge aura to reach maximum charge.  You can still move around while charging\!
mission.properties|o.aggressive_assembly: Rescue the lost squad and decommission the factory foreman
conversation.properties|r.impostoclaus_2: Complete the 'Save Winterfest\!' mission and receive special Winterfest rewards? I'm on it\!
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_5a: Energy can only be obtained by purchase with a real money transaction or for trade via the Exchange. To purchase or trade for energy, simply open the Supply Depot and click the 'Get Energy' button.
mission.properties|r.darkest_forces_3a: Well, I certainly wouldn't want to miss that.
item.properties|f.dark_matter_deposit_2: A good-sized mineral deposit that will generate several units of dark matter.
mission.properties|o.explosive_plot: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
mission.properties|b.p_r6_mat_1: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
conversation.properties|m.mission_resear: We're cut off\!  Please help us defeat those lichens\!
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_cowl: A magnificently crafted cowl said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Torair, who clung to the gates of the Owlite High Academy of Magicks as both it and his explosives burned.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_2a: You, curious traveler, stand in the Obsidian Nexus, realm of the Apocrea. You will likely never see the sun again.
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_11b: I think I've got it Bechamel, thanks\!
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_5a: I'd like to go over your energy tutorial one more time.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_mat_0: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.hive_box: Contains one unique hive-themed item. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.polar_night_wolf_coat: A warm coat, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. The thick fur is needed during their never ending night patrols.
dungeon.properties|i.difficulty_medium: Advanced difficulty features an increased challenge for players who have a thorough grasp of combat. Monsters can deal and receive more damage and traps are more dangerous. Heat, crown, loot payouts and chances for rarities are increased.
item.properties|f.quilted_hunting_cap: A flexible helm lined with luxurious stay-alert quilting. It smells like animal.
conversation.properties|m.npc_survivorkn: They came from the darkness. There was no time to react.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_wasd_move_: Keyboard used for movement, advanced commands, quickslots and chat
item.properties|f.sacred_ghost_helm: A haunting helm for those who are gunning for ghosts.
mission.properties|o.ending_in_fire: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
arena.properties|m.chat_all: Spectators may now chat with players.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
helptips.properties|m.loading17: Check out forums.spiralknights.com. Be a part of the conversation\!
projectx.properties|m.confirm_mode_chang: Mode changed. Click to accept within {0} or the\nmode will automatically revert to the previous setting.
conversation.properties|r.forge_knight_7: I'll look at it later. (End conversation)
item.properties|f.needle_shot: An Autogun modified to fire piercing bolts at an alarming rate.
item.properties|f.pig_armor: Hog all the attention in this leather suit. Its durable protection may just save your bacon one day.
item.properties|f.prize_box_lucky: Contains various lucky and rare items. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|m.npc_onwatch_b: I know they will come back.
item.properties|f.blaster: A versatile handgun issued to Spiral Knights who have proven themselves in the field.
help.properties|m.support_4: To report a bug in the game, press F2. Keep in mind that bug reports are not answered, but they include non-personal debug information that helps track down the root of the problem. If you need assistance from a GM, please file an in-game support request.
item.properties|f.wyvern_scale_mail: It requires extreme temperatures to forge this fine armor made from the scales of rare Clockworks beasts.
item.properties|f.arcane_salamander_mask: A Salamander Mask imbued with magical power.  It is thought to be made from the familiars of powerful witches.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_c: I always carry a blaster, never know when it might come in handy.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_1: Hello. I'm Wegner, Chief Geo Knight of the Skylark and head of geological studies within the Clockworks.
conversation.properties|m.mission_crimso: Well met\! When I heard they were sending you {0}, I didn't believe it. THE Vanquisher of Vanaduke\! It's an honor to be reporting to you.
exchange.properties|m.billing_declined: Your card has been declined. Please check that the information you have entered is correct.
item.properties|f.green_shard: A shard of Valestone that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
social.properties|m.autofriend_multiple_: Your friend list is already full\! You were unable to friend these {0} friends at this time\:\n{1}\n{2}
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_4: When using the Forge, you will see a list of any items that are ready to level up. Selecting an item will show you how it can be enhanced.
item.properties|f.padded_hunting_cap: An upgraded helm for hunters that is lined with soft, stimulating padding.
mission.properties|r.alchemy_beginners_9: Let's go over it all one more time.
mission.properties|m.breaking_in_recruit: Gremlins\!? Am I reading this data right? An ambush\!? How were they able to trick our sensors?
conversation.properties|r.ritual_1b: I think I have something that might be of interest to you.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_r9: Meet with Biscotti in her kitchen and provide 'baking assistance.'
item.properties|f.nitronome: An advanced explosive issued to only the most elite Spiral Knight grenadiers. It's made from a synthetic substance that ticks ominously even when unarmed.
support.properties|m.option_1_2: 3. If you meant to send a message to {0}, click here.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_undead: The ruins of Owlite castles are dark and cursed places that are swarming with legions of undead spookats.  The worst of these, the seemingly invincible grimalkins, constantly lurk in the shadows, awaiting the moment your life-saving light is finally snuffed out. \n\nSome knights succumb to the darkness and become paralyzed with fear in these shadowy realms. The only thing that can save them are brave knights who have long lost their childhood fears of the dark and all the terrible creatures that lurk within.
item.properties|f.ignition_armor: Light armor augmented to help protect knights venturing into heated situations.
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_h: It's hard to tell, but it seems to correlate to Constructs. \n\nThese Mecha Knights went wild\! Faster, stronger -- I think one was trying to climb the elevator\!
mission.properties|e.good_unavailable: Sorry, that item is no longer available.
helptips.properties|m.atg_blocks2: Blocks can even affect each other\!
item.properties|f.mega_tundrus: An upgraded tundrus that takes no prisoners, except when it does and then the prison is made of ice. A charged shot can even plow through multiple enemies.
monster.properties|m.overtime_4: Remember, tomorrow is Hawaiian Shirt Day and every other day is Unpaid Overtime Day.
conversation.properties|m.rc_vet_2a: Always be on your guard. Who knows what other dangers await us on this world?
projectx.properties|i.render_effects: Enables more detailed graphical effects, but\nmay reduce graphics performance with less powerful systems.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_1b: What services can I find here? (Follow Tylen)
mission.properties|o.p_r3_min: Gather minerals for Chief Geo Knight Wegner's research.
item.properties|f.spiral_cloak: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.divine_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
mission.properties|m.shadowplay_2a: Go. I will allow you to have one last moment before I destroy your meddling kind. However, should you choose to turn down my generous offer then you are welcome to come and face me in the Core where I will hasten your demise.
projectx.properties|m.mission_fc: Recover the recon module in the Firestorm Citadel.
item.properties|f.eye_pack_amazing: Contains three amazing eye shapes for your style kit\: Clover, Skull, and Circuitry.
conversation.properties|m.emberlight_vis: Emberlight founded by gremlin outcasts from Great Colony. Gremlins of Emberlight not obey the Iron Law, so flee or die. We start over with Emberlight. New colony home to few of us\: most ex-schemers, some merchants, some fighters, all traitors in eyes of Great Colony gremlins.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_3: Then use them with honor and let them protect you from the fury of the countless foes you will soon face.  The Core that we seek, there's something truly dreadful about it.  I know that it may very well be what gets us home, but I can't shake this feeling that we've been thinking about it all wrong.
conversation.properties|m.fc_greeter_2: May your end be mercifully swift.
mission.properties|b.strength_unity: Something has riled up a pack of beasts in the Aurora Isles and they have descended upon a Geo Knight research team.  Cornered, the team has sent a distress signal and Spiral HQ has issued the task of saving them to you. \n\nBy standing together, the Geo Knights have made it this long but their time is running out. Assemble a team and confront the beasts that seek to devour your fellow knights\!
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_3a:
Re\: Re\: Resource allocation request, Amu-Sol 

Thank you for your prompt response.  Unfortunately your resource allocation has been denied. 

Reason\: 
Provided summary of need for requested resources\: 'All hail the great and terrifying Maulos, true lord of the Blinding Abyss.'
helptips.properties|m.energy: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to spend energy on this device.
item.properties|f.token_roarmulus: A special circuit board developed by gremlin engineers designed to enhance both the bark and bite of the Roarmulus Twins.
uplink.properties|m.love_accepted: Krogmo thanks you for your kindly contribution.
item.properties|f.spiral_hood: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.woven_pathfinder_armor: A flexible suit of armor built for mobility and interlaced with slime fibers to protect against prickly and thorny foes.
helptips.properties|m.loading10: If you become shocked you will regularly spasm from the electricity coursing through your body. This will interrupt anything you are doing.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogmas: Think you can just open the front door and walk in?\! You will suffer for this\!
mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r3: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
conversation.properties|m.core_lead_3: Yes, Captain Ozlo himself has ordered that we hold out as long as possible and learn whatever we can.  If we ever leave this planet, it will be because of this Core.  \n\nI am confident that aside from a potential energy source, the Core is a kind of nerve center for everything you see within the Clockworks.  You can feel it in what little air is down here; a wild, ominous sense that this is no mere machine.
item.properties|f.cryo_driver: A high-tech alchemical sidearm that fires powerful cryo bullets that split multiple times on impact.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_crowns: Crowns are the currency of the Clockworks. You can use them to purchase all kinds of things like new weapons and armor. While playing with others, every party member gets crowns whenever anyone picks some up.
item.properties|f.vitasuit: A special suit that provides a hearty, healthy bonus to the wearer.
item.properties|f.twicer_slicer: Slicer prototype Mk II.  They say a little bit of knowledge is a dangerous thing, so that's exactly how much knowledge we have about the mysterious spikes we're slicing up and launching out here.
item.properties|f.moonstone_deposit_1: A small mineral deposit that will generate a single unit of moonstone.
item.properties|f.silent_nightblade: Crafted with some of the most devilish materials found on Cradle, this inky blade can explode with fiendish fury.
item.properties|f.spiral_draped_armor: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.solid_cobalt_helm: A sturdy Cobalt Helm with upgraded internal systems and external reinforcement.
projectx.properties|m.reboot_msg_downtim: The game will be unavailable for a short time during scheduled maintenance.
item.properties|f.valestone_deposit_2: A good-sized mineral deposit that will generate several units of moonstone.
mission.properties|r.time_enough_at_last: Yes, you must be Edger.  Your squadmates requested that I come find you.
projectx.properties|m.save_continue: In order to access this feature, you must create an account to use when logging into the game.
item.properties|f.potocrowns: An unlucky thing for your foes to find, it explodes in a painful blow.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We're in\!  This is it\!
projectx.properties|x.rename_desc1: You may only rename your knight every 30 days.
item.properties|f.confetti: Use this item to throw it into the air and celebrate good times. Come on\!
help.properties|m.monster_fiend: Deal SHADOW - Weak to PIERCING - Strong against SHADOW
helptips.properties|m.unlock_gold: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use the Gold Key.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_2a: Strangers like Quillion here sell you weapons and armor.  Each one specializes in a particular kind of item, so talk to them and find out what they carry. They're not very chatty, but they always have a fresh stock of items every day\! \n\nJust be sure that you've reached the appropriate rank to equip an item\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_crimso: That's just it {0}, nothing. We've been monitoring the base below for weeks then it went silent. Quite suddenly. We're not sure what you're going to find down there. Our sensors show no active life forms.
item.properties|f.searing_edge: A light blade that sets foes ablaze as it slashes. The technology that keeps the hilt from catching fire is more advanced than the sword itself.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_weap_3: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_d: Between the warmth of the fire and the safety of the defensive turrets, I think I'll sleep well tonight.
help.properties|m.clockworks_1: The Clockworks is your gateway to the planet's Core\! It's filled with a huge variety of worlds and populated with monsters and treasure beyond your imagination. Beware, however\: the deeper you go below the surface, the tougher and smarter your opponents will become\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_virgil_4a: Hail, {0}.  When you restored power to the camp, this elevator powered on as well.  I imagine it will take you down deep into the chasm below and what you will find there is anyone's guess. \n\nIf your aim is to travel down into those depths, ensure that you are ready to face whatever is waiting for you.
item.properties|f.dark_shard: A shard of Dark Matter that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
projectx.properties|m.reach_terminal_1: Delve into the Clockworks and find your way to the first Terminal.
sprites.properties|d.enduring_night: Increases duration of the shadow cloak.
item.properties|f.ancient_shell: A fragment of resilient Tortodrone shell. It is rumored that by sleeping on a Tortodrone shell, one can feel the subtle vibrations that call these mighty beings towards the Long Migration's mysterious final destination.
mission.properties|r.pumping_up_2b: No thanks, I'll wander around on my own.
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research
monster.properties|m.overtime_3: Glad I caught you. I'm looking for someone to really rise to the challenge this weekend...
conversation.properties|m.dark_harvest_e:
Welcome to the Dark Harvest Festival\!  This annual celebration honors the undead with festive masks, delicious treats and dangerous tricks\!

To participate, explore the Clockworks and try to find the legendary 'Punkin King.'  This ghoulish gourd gives out candy to visitors.  You can exchange the candy to the traders here in the Haven Town Square for monster masks\!

Should you prefer the direct approach, or just need a few more, our vendor will sell you candy as well.
mission.properties|m.time_enough_at_last: Oh hello there.  I suppose you're with Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.big_angry_bomb: An immensely powerful bomb with a terrible attitude.
uplink.properties|m.end_survey_prompt: To help us improve the game, please rate your enjoyment of this session on a scale of 1 to 5.
item.properties|f.volcanic_plate_mail: Superior plate mail imbued with the elemental essence of flame and designed to withstand tremendous impact.
item.properties|f.ancient_plate_mail: A suit of artifact armor that is said to have been worn by titans. Though it offers amazing protection, its incredible weight makes it cumbersome to wear.
item.properties|f.almire_table: A table transplanted from the hallowed halls of Almire to adorn your abode.
item.properties|f.magic_hood: An enchanting hood for knights who dabble in divination and contemplate conjuring.
social.properties|m.play_pvp: Sign up for a game of {0} {1} in the Coliseum\!
item.properties|f.gh_theme_shock: A high-energy theme that fills the air with electricty. Side effects include constant static shock from touching absolutely anything.
item.properties|f.ticket_unbind_3: Use this ticket at the Unbinding Forge to unbind a 3 star item.
uplink.properties|m.bonus_reward: As part of the Homecoming Celebration for the new Guild Hall Expansion, Spiral HQ has authorized you receive these exclusive rewards. \nTo use the Battle Stand, deposit it into your Guild's Treasury and place it in a room in Design Mode. Enjoy\!
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_3: In town, you can access the Forge at any time.  In the Clockworks, you can access it by using an Arsenal Station.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft1_r6: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
item.properties|f.toy_box: Contains one unique toyland costume or accessory. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.nog_blaster: One highly volatile chamber full of creamy, high-cholesterol cheer that when fired really packs a punch.
item.properties|f.frostbreaker_shield: A Proto Shield modified to provide some protection against freeze.
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r7: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_2: During your travels in the Clockworks you will encounter five special minerals\: crimsonite, moonstone, valestone, luminite and dark matter.
mission.properties|m.cryptic_coder: Schemer Razwog\: Work away from the others. The Order must never know we have the artifact. Find a way to power it. Bring it to me. Do not betray me.  I will know. \n\n-H
item.properties|f.armor_arms: An accessory that can be attached to the arms of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_b: Did I leave my calibur back at the Arsenal Station...?
chat.properties|m.unknown_flag: Unknown flag {0}. Use /help toggle to list flags.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_mastery_2a: A good sword is, well, good and all, but how about a great sword? If you want weapons that will shake the heavens, then mastery level alchemy is what you need. \n\nOnce you craft an item into its 4 and 5 star incarnation, you unlock that item's true hidden potential.
item.properties|f.static_flash: A Proto Bomb modified to generate small bursts of electricity upon detonation.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_mat_01: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.hailstone: A small rock that's always a little cold to the touch. It's great for chilling beverages without diluting their flavor.
projectx.properties|e.password_mismatch: The passwords you entered do not match.
item.properties|f.toy_soldier_coat: Tailored for duty in the battle for Toyland but also perfect for posing in parades.
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_5a: It would seem so.  And this place, it just radiates evil, it's almost indescribable.  It's even starting to affect the levels surrounding it- fires are breaking out everywhere. \n\nYou're one of the best we've got, {0} and if there's anyone that could lead a squad through the citadel it's you.  But even reaching it won't be easy.  We're going to need to take care of a few fires and gather a bit more intel before storming the gates.
item.properties|f.gold_wolf_coat: Armor once worn by a member of the 'Gold Wolves,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
item.properties|f.snow_hat: A comfy winter hat, keeping you warm whether hunting frozen jellies or merely melting marshmallows in your hot chocolate.
item.properties|f.unstable_core: A hazardous hunk pulled from a fulminating foe. It hums menacingly.
projectx.properties|m.shutdown_warning: This server will be refreshed in {0} minutes. {1}
helptips.properties|m.tut_chromalisks: Those chroma whelps up ahead can lash you with their tongues from afar. Avoid facing them when they get ready to strike.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_4a: Thanks, {0}.  I thought we were done for back there. \n\nLet's get the artifact back to Spiral HQ before someone else tries to nab it.

mission.properties|m.cryptic_coder_spark:
The Iron Law is Broken\! 
The Crimson Order is False\! 
The Nine are blind, they cannot see the Truth that lies below. 
The Nine are deaf, they cannot hear the Resonance that beats within this world. 

Herex no longer serves as one of the Nine. 
Only Herex sees and hears the Truth. Only Herex will prevail. 
Follow Herex and you will be spared.

This C.U.B.E. Club Membership Agreement constitutes a binding legal document between the undersigned (the "knight"), Golden Casino Holdings LLC (the "Casino"), and the entire slime community ("slimes").

 I. General Terms and Conditions
  1. Membership in the C.U.B.E. Club is for personal use only and can not be transferred to other knights, Devilites, or other Clockwork creatures.
  2. Selling access to your ability to spin is prohibited.
  3. Keep your arms and legs inside the Casino at all times.
  4. Please do not drop items into the core.
 II. Description of Benefits
  1. Benefits are varied and may be changed at any time.
  2. Lounge access is not guaranteed and limited by availability.
  3. Buffalo Wings are not included.
  4. All disputes will be arbitrated by the Casino floor manager and all decisions are final.
 III. Winnings, Payments, and Fees
  1. Winnings may be paid in Golden Slime Coins at the discretion of the Casino floor manager.
  2. No additional fees are collected at this time.
 IV. Promotional Awards
  1. Sale promotions\: Reduced prices for members, if any, will be displayed plainly in the shop interface.
  2. The Gift Shop reserves the right to modify, alter, discontinue or terminate these promotions at any time for any reason whatsoever without notice to the end users. No whiners.
 V. Restrictions and Conditions of Use
  1. As a condition of your use of the club services, you agree not to use club facilities or interfaces for any purpose that is unlawful or prohibited by the terms, conditions, and notices included in this Membership Agreement or any relevant Licence Agreement, or anything generally regarded as uncouth by the slimes.
  2. The Spiral Knights Terms of Service supersedes these terms where applicable.
  3. The knight agrees to all terms and conditions enumerated here, and those not enumerated here. The slimes may add new conditions at any time that require complete retroactive compliance.
 VI. Termination of Account
  1. The Casino has the right to terminate your membership for violating any terms or conditions, precise or vague, enumerated herein or generated at the time of infraction. You've been warned.
 VII. Disclaimer of Warranty; Limitation of Liability
  1. Your use of the Casino is at your sole risk. You click it, you bought it.
  2. The Casino nor the general slime community shall not be liable in contract, tort, negligence or otherwise for any loss or damage whatsoever arising from or in any way connected with your use of the Casino.
 VIII. General
  1. This Membership Agreement is governed by the laws of Haven and the laws of Cradle. You hereby irrevocably consent to submit to the jurisdictions of the Courts of Cradle and Haven.
  2. This agreement was written by a few slimes with little grasp of legal language beyond what they saw when watching A Few Good Men. Thus, any parts that don't make sense are usually blamed on the other guy. Any good parts left over are still good. They don't go bad just because we screwed up on the other badder parts. There's a word for that concept and the fact that we don't know it is one of the bad parts.

Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.

mission.properties|b.silent_legion:
Guardian Knight Arkus was one of the finest warriors serving the Spiral Knights until some time shortly after the crash.  As one of the first to search for the Alpha Squad, Arkus's own squad perished in a grisly battle with a horde of dust zombies.  Since then, Arkus has blamed himself for their loss, saying that he betrayed his Guardian's Oath to protect his squad. 

Arkus now journeys into the Clockworks alone, never risking the loss of another squad and we believe, somehow trying to find the squad he once lost.  As these expeditions began to appear self-destructive, Spiral HQ issued him a direct order to cease. 

Arkus ignored these orders and has gone deep into the Clockworks and not returned.  Not wanting to lose the last member of his squad, Spiral HQ is asking you to pursue him to his last known whereabouts, some kind of mysterious statuary at depth 26.
town.properties|m.rescue_camp_desc: The Rescue Camp serves as a refuge for newly dropped Spiral Knights. It offers a few creature comforts as well as a training facility to prepare recruits for their journey to Haven.
mission.properties|o.choose_your_sprite: Talk to Morlin and choose a battle sprite as your companion
guild.properties|log.energy_removed: Withdrew {0} energy from the energy well (new total\: {1}).
mission.properties|o.p_fiend_test_t2: Help us test this new content.
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_mask: An impressive mask instilled with the might of Kat Hissers, the unstable bombers of the Kat Tribe.
helptips.properties|m.back_to_haven: This path will take you back to Haven if you are not able to enter the Fiend's Grim Gate.
dungeon.properties|m.emberlight_desc: A village of outcasts, Emberlight serves as a refuge for gremlins who were banished from the Great Colony. Now they live humble lives, selling wares and repairs to passing travelers, always fearful that one day the gremlin king Tinkinzar would see fit to wipe them out entirely.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
item.properties|f.capsule_remedy: A small capsule that refreshes its user. It can be used to remove all status conditions you're afflicted with.\n\nDon't panic\! Remedy capsules can be a life saver, if you remember to use them\!
craft.properties|m.name: Name
item.properties|f.solid_cobalt_armor: A sturdy set of Cobalt Armor reforged for additional comfort and protection.
help.properties|m.controls_attack: [[ACTION]]. Hold to do a charge attack. [[ACTION]] also lifts large items, speaks to NPCs, and activates stations.
mission.properties|b.darkest_forces: Hearing that your next missions will have you facing the likes of fiendish and undead monsters in the depths of Tier 3, Chief Biotech Hahn has requested you contact him before deploying for your latest missions.
helptips.properties|t.tg1_overgrown_1: See you on the other side
item.properties|f.fowl_cowl_vol: A beaked mask shrouded in a scorched hood. Herald in the new year in this elemental gown.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_3_3a: Congratulations {0}, you meet the necessary requirements and have received your 4 Star Certification.  Take the elevator behind me in order to complete your mission.
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_2b: What sort of challenges await me in the final gate?
dungeon.properties|m.battle_arena_1: Battle Arena|Fight for Glory, Fight for Treasure
mission.properties|b.p_moorcroft1:
Someone or something has summoned a horde of cursed black kats into the Clockworks. These shadowy beasts hunger for arcane power and raided the Moorcroft Manor Archives' precious collection of magical grimoires. 

In the wrong hands these ancient tomes could be catastrophic, but it turns out that black kats can't read, so they instead decided to just eat them.

The residents of Moorcroft Manor would like you to retrieve the Ancient Pages of the magical grimoires that quite likely reside in the stomachs of black kats. We'll leave you to figure out just how to recover them... 

For this mission, journey into the depths of a moldering sewer where intel has located a black kat nest. Recover those Ancient Pages and return them to Moorcroft Manor\!
mission.properties|m.search_continues_5a: I haven't given up the search for Euclid, Parma, Grantz and Rulen.  They're out there somewhere and I will find them, even if it means entering the Core myself.
item.properties|f.dread_skelly_mask: The ultimate in haunted headgear, certain to protect your cranium from even the most hellish of shadow attacks.
item.properties|f.token_winter: A tiny wishlist created by one of the children of Emberlight. It signifies that you fufilled their holiday wishes and saved Winterfest. Doesn't that just fill you with cheer?
item.properties|f.groundbreaker_helm: A sturdy helm worn by knights who were among the first to brave the depths of the Clockworks.
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_3a: Amazing that after all this time we didn't know the truth. I mean, we've suspected for a while now that this planet was some kind of prison but who could have guessed that this 'Swarm' was just waiting for someone to stumble across the Core and free it?
helptips.properties|m.tut_buttons: Not all buttons are in plain sight. Have a look around\! They are sometimes hidden under blocks.
social.properties|e.maxfriends_invitee: Sorry, you already have the maximum number of friends.
item.properties|f.vial_stun_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing shimmering flash pellets. It can be used to inflict enemies with Stun.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be too stupefied to give chase\!
item.properties|f.grave_soil: Dreadful dirt dredged from a creepy crypt. It is always a little cold to the touch.

conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_4a: Even though you have defeated Vanaduke, it appears as though the curse he brought down upon this kingdom still lingers. It requires all of our power to keep these raging shadow fires in check.
mission.properties|r.true_champion_3a: If there's a way, we'll find it.
prologue.properties|m.ozlo_evac: All hands\: Evacuate the ship immediately\!
mission.properties|b.the_flickering_flam: After your victory in Firestorm Citadel, the nature sprites of the great Spirit Mother finally began to make headway in battling the cursed flames engulfing the charred remains of Almire. A recent flare-up has impeded that progress, hinting at some lingering malevolent force that continues to fuel the fires. Contact Intel Agent Kora for details.

mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: The maskeraith sounds like the battle sprite for me\!
mission.properties|r.darkest_depths_5a: Thanks Kora.  I'll do my best.

item.properties|f.umbra_driver: This horrifyingly powerful handgun fires bullets that are completely devoid of color, odor and mercy.

Well, before you get all 'hero' on me and go marching off into the darkness below why don't you and I go head on over to the other side of the camp and teach a few of the monsters that tore up this camp last night a lesson?
item.properties|f.furni_library_bookstac: A loose pile of miscellaneous texts, ranging from cookbooks to eldritch codexes scribbled in unintelligible script.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_compound_: The others must never know.  Silence them. -H

conversation.properties|m.tortodrone_hav: Tucked away inside a mysterious garden we found a strange portal that HQ is calling a Grim Gate. From what we were able to decode you will need a key of sorts to open it. Spiral HQ thinks the glyphs we spotted the Fiends carrying might have something to do with opening the gate.
item.properties|f.silverweave: A length of understated cloth intricately interwoven with precious metal. It's tastefully ostentatious, yet prudently protective.
mission.properties|m.darkest_depths_5a: Then let's get started.  Now that you've stopped the immediate threat to Haven, Spiral HQ is hoping to pick up the trail of the Artifact. It won't be easy. Fortunately I've got some missions lined up for you that will be invaluable for your survival in the dark depths you are about to face. Good luck to you, {0}.

item.properties|f.mighty_cobalt_armor: An advanced set of Spiral Knight armor skillfully crafted using the most recently deciphered Clockworks technology.
mission.properties|o.p_ghost_machine_r9: Join Desna's Recon Rangers in discovering the source of the distress call within the derelict facility.
item.properties|f.scarlet_shield: A shield found within the Scarlet Fortress. It grants the user extra health. Those that carry one have said that they can sometimes hear a faint heartbeat emanating from within it.

mission.properties|m.best_of_beast_2a: Yes well, let's get started then. \n\nTier 3 is closest to the Core and much like how high level items respond to its power, so do monsters.  Many of them take on new forms and are considered at their most dangerous.  You must prepare before taking on each mission.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_shield_1: Let's get one essential survival tool out of the way right now- your shield. Hold [[DEFEND]] to defend with your shield. While defending you will completely withstand most damage from all sides. The gun puppies in the next hallway shouldn't be a problem to get past so long as you defend as you run through.
item.properties|f.sacred_shade_armor: A shadowy suit of armor built to outlast whatever might slink from the shadows.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: You did it\!  That explosion took out the cannons\!
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_3: You will find ore deposits in all levels of the Clockworks, and you must attack them in order to break them down into a size you can carry. You can only pick up one at a time, but you can swap them by picking up another. Look for the biggest, shiniest one you can find. They are the most valuable.
item.properties|f.blackened_crest: A shield once carried by a knight of Almire, now a cursed relic that has been nearly burned beyond recognition within the Firestorm Citadel. Very powerful alchemy would be required to restore it to its former glory.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2c: All battle sprites wear a mechanical harness that aligns their skills to a damage type. Not all sprites can wear all harnesses though. For example, a drakon cannot output piercing damage. \n\nBy default, you have an iron harness that any sprite can equip. If you want to branch out as you likely do with your weapons and gear, you need to purchase new harnesses.
support.properties|m.subheader_step207:
Scamming is when a player is trying to trick you into doing something you shouldn't do. Examples\:
- This could be trying to reveal your account name or password.
- Wanting to trade accounts with you.
- Claiming to be a Game Master or a friend of yours and trying take advantage of that.
There are many other ways to scam.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_15: No thanks, I'll explore on my own.
projectx.properties|e.name_too_consec: Sorry, names cannot contain the same letter in a row more than twice.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_spec: Hi there {0}, I'm Zebulon, a knight who utilizes specialty gear that is suited for specific scenarios.  The recipes I have for you produce weapons that target specific monster families and gear that has mixed defense types. \n\nSometimes what you really need is a sword that smites the undead or armor that raises your slime smashing proficiency.  The gear I specialize in is often built for a specific task, but is also great to mix and match with other sets.  Experiment\!
help.properties|m.support_3: If you're having problems with another player, click on them and choose the Complain option for assistance.
chat.properties|m.usage_grant: Usage\: /{0} number\nGives you a number of crowns.
item.properties|f.starlit_demo_helm: An illuminated helm strengthened against soporific smogs. It's surprisingly soft inside.
mission.properties|r.go_shopping_6b: I think I've got it Bechamel, thanks\!
monster.properties|m.vanaduke_1: What's this? More wolves hungry for the blood of Almire? Our great kingdom shall never fall to the likes of beasts\!
item.properties|f.dread_captain_cutlass: A custom curving cutter kept keen on careless castaways.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_9a: Here we have... me\!  I'm the Accessorizor, adding accessories to your gear so long as you have a ticket.  With accessories, you can make your gear really stand out in a crowd, I highly suggest giving it a try.  You'll soon become the apple of every one's eye\!
item.properties|f.owlite_shield: A wooden ward carved with the crude image of a long-lost Owlite.
conversation.properties|m.npc_captainkni: Use the environment to your advantage\!

mission.properties|m.elig_ok: You are eligible for this mission.
mission.properties|b.shadow_knows: Biotech Hahn has suggested that given your recent promotion, you are ready to learn about the nefarious monsters within the Clockworks that inflict shadow damage. Contact him via comlink and see what he has to say.
mission.properties|r.pioneers_6a: Tell me about Squad Guardian Grantz.
pvp.properties|m.hazardous: Hazardous mode\! Control points will have hazards.
item.properties|f.blight_needle: It's a proven fact that even the most virulent of toxins is a lot more contagious if it's fired indiscriminately over a large area.
item.properties|f.owlite_wand: They say the wand chooses the wizard, so don't let this one see your cute friend.
item.properties|f.prize_box_equinox: Contains various unique costumes and accessories celebrating Cradle's equinox\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogmas: Two cannons have stopped firing\!  Report at once, you mongrels\!
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
item.properties|f.raiders_hammer: An ornate hammer infused with the power of a great storm, it's as cutting-edge as a blunt weapon can be.
chat.properties|m.unspecific_command: Command not specific enough, did you mean "{0}?"
projectx.properties|m.confirm_delete: To confirm deletion of this character, type "{0}" below.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_bomb: Hello {0}, I'm Remi, a knight who specializes in bombs and explosives.  The recipes I have for you are pretty straightforward- producing weapons and gear that focus on blowing up your enemies to smithereens\! \n\nUsing bombs isn't a fire and forget kind of affair though.  Bombs require an understanding of timing, both before and after you drop one, in order to get the most bang for your buck.  The gear I specialize in will make you a knight that your squad sends in to take down many enemies at once.  Bombs are great for clearing out a mob of beasties in one swift KA-BOOM\!
mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.
item.properties|f.magmatic_fanatic_mask: A mask said to have been worn by fanatics that worshiped a magma god. Its fires will light the path to victory.
mission.properties|o.p_heart_of_ice_r7: Discover the source of the terrible blizzards emanating from Amu-Sol
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_1a: Tell me what you know about the gremlins.

item.properties|f.groundbreaker_armor: A suit of armor worn by knights who were among the first to brave the depths of the Clockworks.
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_2a: Oh {0}, I'm just doing my job.  And speaking of which, I have a job for you\!
projectx.properties|p.use_style_kit: Spend 1,000 crowns to modify your style?

chat.properties|m.usage_kick: Usage\: /{0} player name\nKicks a player offline.
