item.properties|f.miracle_cloak: A miraculous mantle said to grant a single miracle to the wearer when they need it most.
mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_5: Good luck to you. And try to stay warm\!
mission.properties|m.new_threat_8a: Pah\!  I am no mere gremlin.  I am the thousand eyes that watch you in the darkness.  I am the hissing blade that whispers your doom.  Tear down every wall and cog in this accursed place and you will find only shadows. \n\nI cannot be stopped by the likes of you\!  Hsst\!
item.properties|f.empty_room: An empty Guild Hall room with standard flooring and plenty of space for furniture\!
item.properties|f.owlite_mask: A mask of an owlite scholar. The Kats of Moorcroft have assured us with confidence that this reconstruction matches their "grotesque and feathered visage".
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: I'm either here celebrating or downing my sorrows.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_mat_2: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
dungeon.properties|m.waiting_to_advance: Waiting on all players to advance...
item.properties|f.storm_warrior_helm: A helm worn by a fabled sword master so skilled, he could cut through lightning as it struck the ground.
mission.properties|m.shocking_sentient_s: Eeeek\! No no no\! B-but it's not ready yet...\!  I guess I have no choice\! \n\nSparkcaster Deluxe....activate\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_winterfest: Contains various unique Winterfest prizes. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_bystande: We almost didn't make it out alive. One moment everything was fine and the next thing we know gremlins are bursting out of the ground\!
support.properties|m.option_1_0: 1. Remember you can click on players and choose "Ignore" to block any chat and mail from them. Click here to ignore {0} and skip the complaint.
item.properties|f.raider_tunic: Treasure is at your fingertips in this coat.
conversation.properties|m.rc_end_3a: No, you won't be able to return. Once you reach Haven your training is complete and your new objective will be to aid the Spiral Knights who are now based in Haven.
item.properties|f.combuster: Combining the principles of the Skylark's engines with the technology powering the Blast Furnace produced this brutal blade, which can ignite even the most flame-retardant materials at a distance.
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_3a: Our recent intel from Recon Knights suggest that gremlins are planning something big.  We believe they are developing some kind of weapon they're calling 'Project R' that will be targeting Haven itself.  Spiral HQ and the Strangers themselves are requesting that you investigate the matter given your performance in the Royal Jelly Palace.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_7a: Hsst\! So, you're the ones who defeated Razwog and took what was mine.  You are not worthy of possessing this powerful Artifact and so I am here to relieve you of it.
conversation.properties|r.tier_accept: Roger that, I'm on my way.
conversation.properties|m.atg_greeter_2a: To the West, you will learn about useful items found in the Clockworks. To the North, you will learn about a variety of block types and doors. To the East, you will find an array of traps and hazards as well as a combat room to practice defense against training cubes.  Don't worry, we have taken precautions to make sure the cubes are perfectly harmless\!
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_shad: Hello {0}, I am Sylvin, a knight who utilizes gear that offers high shadow damage defense.  The recipes I have for you produce armor and shields that protect you from the shadow attacks of fiends and the undead. \n\nShadow defense can be harnessed from the shadows themselves.  The armor and shields I specialize in are derived from the very fiendish and undead creatures that seek to use the power of the shadows against you.  Plus, it looks incredibly scary and cool.
item.properties|f.daring_rigadoon: A savage skewer that will slow even the most salubrious of foes to a crawl.
item.properties|f.foiled_frosted_helm: A delicious helm made of cake created during the Spiral Knights Anniversary Celebration. Even though it has a pretty foil wrapper, it's still made of cake, and eventually falls apart.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: I'm not ready to choose yet.
item.properties|f.guild_members_250: Allows your guild to recruit up to 250 members\!
mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_4: In order to venture deep enough to reach the Core you must visit the Hall of Heroes and speak to Lieutenant Barrus to receive your 5 Star Certification.
item.properties|f.ticket_variants_3: Use this ticket at the Variant Forge to reset an item's variants to 3 random variants.
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_6: Our geological research is ongoing, so there may yet be other fascinating uses for these strange and powerful minerals.
item.properties|f.static_clinger: A latent strand of energy that floats throughout the Clockworks, frequently catching on hair and clothing. It's too large to properly distill into Energy, but it's very useful in alchemy.
guild.properties|m.name_in_use: Sorry, that name is already in use.
mission.properties|b.go_shopping_b: The Haven Bazaar is a place where all manners of item-related goods and services can be found. However, there seems to be some kind of commotion just outside the normally bustling marketplace. It looks like there is no time to waste; there is trouble brewing\!
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_1a: {0}, I'm glad you called, I have something big here for you.
mission.properties|m.new_chapter_1a: Congratulations on becoming a Soldier, {0}\!  I hear you really gave that Snarbolax a clobbering, well done\! \n\nWe've had an opportunity to analyze Euclid's recon module you discovered in the Snarbolax's lair.  Based on the recording, it seems that Euclid suspected something our Geo Knights discovered sometime after the crash- that the levels within the Clockworks are comprised of terrain from multiple alien worlds\!
helptips.properties|m.scenario_fiendbook: What to Do if You Summon the Wrong Infernal Overlord
mission.properties|m.occurance_at_owlite: (This appears to be the Owlite tome that the spookats said describe the place above the Core.  Its pages are very worn and only portions of the original text can be deciphered.)
item.properties|m.item_permanent: This item cannot be sold or traded.\n
item.properties|f.cooling_cell: A small device used in complex machines to keep them from overheating. Also handy to keep in your pockets on hot summer days.
helptips.properties|m.tut_victory: You've made it\! Walk on ahead to enter the Rescue Camp.
mission.properties|o.laboratory_visit: Visit the Lab and meet with Biotech Morlin
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_1: Cradle is a dangerous world and it's important to make sure you have powerful gear in your arsenal in order to survive.  To do that, you will need to use the Forge.
conversation.properties|t.af_chat_slime_: I have a delicious fruity center\!
sprites.properties|d.venom: Increases the potency of the poison inflicted.
item.properties|f.riftlocker: A deadly handgun said to be capable of sundering heavy armor with a single shot. These firearms proved instrumental during the siege of Isora in breaking through the war machines of the Morai.
item.properties|f.freezing_vaporizer_mki: A Freezing Vaporizer modified to disperse ultra low-temperature chemicals over a wider range.
helptips.properties|m.lichenous_lair: Lichens are strange, alien varieties of slimes thought to have arrived on this world in a large meteor.  While a single-cell colony is mostly harmless, they can quickly combine into a most terrible foe.  Keep them from mingling\!
item.properties|f.obsidian_mantle_of_sig: 'Through my eyes you will see the path to ages. Pure is my gaze, free from the lies of reality.'
item.properties|f.galactic_guardian_helm: A commemorative helm that pays tribute to the countless brave Isoran guardians that have protected spacefaring crews in their adventures across the stars.
projectx.properties|i.limit_fps: Limit the frame rate to avoid overtaxing your video card, especially if offscreen.
mission.properties|r.search_continues_1a: Thank you, Lieutenant. Any more information with regard to the Alpha Squad?
item.properties|f.fowl_cloak_vol: A scorched feathered cloak. Set a fire under your feet and ensure punctuality as sure as the roosters crow.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_e: A bomb is great for dealing with a horde of monsters.
item.properties|f.crystal_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in an alloy of Moonstone and Valestone. Its soothing shade of cerulean has been clinically proven to both calm knights and annihilate the undead.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_kit: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
mission.properties|r.prestigious_opportu: Thank you, Kora.  I'll do my best.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_4: Once you safely reach the elevator, the mineral you are carrying gets deposited in your arsenal for use later. Everyone in your party gets everyone else's minerals, so no need to fight over who gets the best one\!
item.properties|f.hunting_blade: A jagged edge used for finishing off big game. It cuts through beasts like butter.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
guild.properties|e.item_treasury_limit: Sorry, an item you're trying to add is already at the limit for how many can be placed in a guild hall.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_6a: Good luck to you. Travel swiftly and avoid their grasp.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_7542da: Forge an item up to level 10.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_gunn: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
item.properties|f.nether_cannon: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a corrupted tortodrone. A tormented howl of rage can be heard on the wind when it is unleashed upon your foes.
conversation.properties|m.test_greeter_1: You here for some testing?  Ok, make sure you read up on the latest info regarding what to test on the Test Server board in the official Spiral Knights forums.  Thank you, move along.
item.properties|f.cosmic_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
dungeon.properties|m.training_grounds_de: This derelict portion of the Clockworks has been modified to train new recruits in the fine art of not dying when they have the rest of the world to explore.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_fiendnoti: Due to continual under-performance, there will be no paid holidays or free coffee in the break room.
item.properties|f.wild_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
conversation.properties|m.casino_klepto_: I won't steal anything... I promise\!
projectx.properties|m.please_relaunch: Please quit and re-run the game to check your new options.
item.properties|f.iron_wolf_coat: Armor once worn by a member of the 'Iron Wolves,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
monster.properties|m.fired_2: Your productivity is down .03% this week. You're fired.
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_6a: Indeed.  Let's start by putting out some fires and then we'll see about trying to get to the citadel.  Given the opposition, it's a one in a million shot. \n\nGood luck, {0}.
item.properties|f.master_door: Installs a force barrier at the entrance of the room that can only be passed by the Guild Masters of the guild.
mission.properties|o.guardians_of_cradle: Join Spiral HQ and discuss what to do next
mission.properties|o.strength_unity: Defend the Geo Knights from a monstrous assault
item.properties|f.grim_buster: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a corrupted tortodrone. Shadows seem to seep from the barrel whenever it is brought to bear.
item.properties|f.plate_mail: A clinking, clanking, cumbersome armor suitable for withstanding a clobbering.
redeem.properties|e.already_redeemed: The code you entered has already been redeemed. Doh\!
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight3_1a: We managed to pull the secondary generator from the Skylark mostly intact. Unfortunately it's barely powerful enough to keep this lab running, let alone power our ship.  We'll need to find another power source if we ever hope to return home.
mission.properties|b.darkest_depths: Having defeated the Roarmulus Twins and recovered the Alpha Squad recon module, it's time to check in with Intel Agent Kora to get a report on the analysis of the module and information about your new access to some of the deepest depths of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_skescape: A piece of Spiral technology used to escape disabled starships. They're very cramped inside.
item.properties|f.crimsonite_deposit_4: A mother lode of metalliferous minerals that will generate a jackpot of crimsonite.
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_expira: Please check that the expiration date is correct and try again. Your card has not been charged.
item.properties|f.raiment: A long, flowing battle garb best accessorized with a pair of angelic wings.
item.properties|f.hazardous_diablo_helm: A helm worn by members of the Scarlet Scouts. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of a demon said to have broken off its own horn to use as a weapon when it faced its end.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
conversation.properties|m.npc_mineraltec: Don't mind Hubert, he's been de-spiked.
item.properties|m.item_lock_acquire: This item will bind to you when acquired.\n
item.properties|f.gunslinger_sash: Clothing worn by pistol-packing warriors from a forgotten time. They smell of rawhide, gun smoke and action.
mission.properties|o.oilers_in_boilers: Discover and destroy the source of the fiery slimes invasion
conversation.properties|m.casino_imposto: Oh, haven't seen you around here before\!
item.properties|f.schemer_scrap: A fragment of a blueprint used by gremlin schemers to construct their mechanical monstrosities. With enough of them and a little tape, you could construct a metal death machine yourself\!
projectx.properties|m.find_rhendon: Find and talk to Rhendon to gain access to missions.
conversation.properties|m.af_chat_fiend_: I'm not even supposed to be here today\!
item.properties|f.furni_bench_manor: An exquisite bench, perfect for perching in plush repose.
item.properties|f.nameless_hat: A nameless hat worn by a nameless hero of legend.
conversation.properties|m.tut_warden_2a: You and me both. Now let's get- \n\nHold on, something's not right. Brace yourself, I think we've got company\!
mission.properties|o.p_r6_mat_1: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.raptor: An ancient pistol imbued with enchantments designed to smite the fiendish creatures of the Underworld. Like its namesake, its bullets fly fast and strike with deadly force.
item.properties|f.honor_shield_3: A ceremonial shield issued to Champions of the Spiral Order. Though intended for formal occasions, its solid construction makes it suitable for combat use.
mission.properties|b.great_escape: Recon Knights have collected intel that has revealed the gremlin 'Crimson Order' has begun ordering gremlins to build makeshift prisons within the Clockworks where Spiral Knights are being taken and imprisoned.  It is believed that these orders are coming in direct response to your destruction of the Roarmulus Twins. \n\nFurther data suggests that these makeshift prisons are a temporary solution until a larger facility can be built.  Spiral HQ however, has no intention of these imprisoned knights staying long enough to find out.
item.properties|f.salamander_mask: A mask crafted from the hide of a Salamander.
chat.properties|m.usage_summon: Usage\: /{0} player name\nSummons a player to your current location.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_2a: Who doesn't right?  Let's head over to Punch and Vise's workshop.
item.properties|f.var_slime_lockbox: An extra-special lockbox exuded from a normal Slime Lockbox.  It requires a Slime Key or Silver Key to open, but is guaranteed to contain a rare color slime gear, costume, or accessory.
chat.properties|m.inv_cannotinvite: You may not invite others (the party is locked or full).
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Hello {0}, it seems you had few problems with the oozing hordes and their like which can no doubt be chalked up to a good education on their behaviors prior to the mission.
uplink.properties|m.wildwoods_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, we've detected a recon module left by the Alpha Squad somewhere within this forest.  It is your mission to locate and retrieve the module. 

This forest is home to packs of wild beasts that have proven deadly for squads in the past. Because of this, Tech Knights have placed Beast Bells throughout the area.  Striking them should stun any beasts caught within the sound wave they produce. 

Be advised that Recon Knights have reported the presence of a terrible beast the likes which we have not seen before stalking this forest.  Known as 'the Snarbolax,' it appears as a shadowy mass of fangs and claws and seems completely immune to our weaponry.  Should you encounter it, try and find a means of escape as fast as possible. 

Good luck\!
conversation.properties|m.tut_warden_3a: Nicely done, {0}\! It seems you know your way around the battlefield. \n\nCome on, let's head to the camp. Maybe you can help us figure out just what the heck is going on here.
mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
guild.properties|e.in_default: Sorry, you cannot do that while the guild is in default.
conversation.properties|r.hav_clock_3b: Thanks for the info tall guy, see you around town.
item.properties|f.furni_block_ice: A block made of densely packed snow. It's perfect for assembling elaborate snow forts\!
conversation.properties|m.guard_laborato: I'm sorry, {0}, you are not authorized to enter the lab yet.
dungeon.properties|m.treasure_vault_desc: Treasure Troves contain vast quantities of treasure blocks, yours for the taking should you have the proper means to get past the numerous locked doors. Some of them are heavily guarded, so always be on the look out for hidden traps and monsters.
mission.properties|m.the_flickering_flam: That is our assumption as well. I hate to send you back into that horrible place, {0}, but if there is any hope of quickly getting to the bottom of this mystery it is you. The citadel is still very dangerous so please be careful\!
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_zip: Please check that the ZIP or postal code is correct and try again. Your card has not been charged.
chat.properties|m.usage_zgo: Usage\: /{0} zone name\nMoves to the named zone.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_3: You will find ore deposits in all levels of the Clockworks, and you must attack them in order to break them down into a size you can carry. You can only pick up one at a time, but you can swap them by picking up another. Look for the biggest, shiniest one you can find. They are the most valuable.
item.properties|f.glowing_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within burns bright enough to light a darkened room.
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_hood: A crudely hewn hood made to resemble a temperamental warrior of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_7a: I'll take the artifact to the Lab.  When you're ready you should head into Haven and meet up with the rest of the crew.  I have a feeling we might be stuck on this planet for quite some time, so we might as well see what we can do to help.
helptips.properties|m.atg_vitapods: Pick up VITAPODS to temporarily increase your maximum health until you return to Haven.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_3: Do you have any more questions about feeding and caring for your sprite?
helptips.properties|m.tg1_barrier: If you start feeling overwhelmed, use the force barriers like the one to your right to take a breather. Monsters and projectiles cannot pass through them.
item.properties|f.shivermist_buster: Originally used to flash freeze perishable supplies, the Shivermist Buster is far more satisfying when used to flash freeze monsters in their tracks.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: I will provide you with a summary of each battle sprite. In recognition of your valor in rescuing these sprites, Spiral HQ has authorized you to bond with one. This bond will last forever and is a significant responsibility. \n\nPlease think carefully before making your decision; there is no going back once you decide.
item.properties|f.somnambulists_totem: An ordinary object with a unique texture and weight, the result of having been partially digested by a Sloombargo.
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_b_: I'll be sure to say hello when I see a Stranger.
mission.properties|o.elemental_my_dear: Learn about monsters that inflict elemental damage
item.properties|f.furni_pet_mewkat: An adorable little spectral kitten that enjoys wandering around and mewing at just about everything it sees.
item.properties|m.use_change_height: Use your {0} to change your height?
item.properties|f.power_cell: A small device used to power complex machines.
conversation.properties|m.npc_onwatch_c: Did you see something out there?
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_8a: Yes, it seems that these sprites have mastered the ability to focus their powers on skills that protect their knight. Given that and their appearance I've dubbed them 'seraphynx.'
item.properties|f.serene_helm: An ancient, resilient helmet covered in a soft layer of moss.  Within the cool, stony interior of this helmet you can hear a faint and soothing song formed by the rustle of winds traveling from distant lands.
chat.properties|m.usage_grant_gift: Usage\: /{0} <account name> name attr value attr value...\nGrants a gift to the identified account.
item.properties|f.volt_driver: A high-tech alchemical sidearm that fires powerful volt bullets that split multiple times on impact.
item.properties|f.deadshot_mantle: A poncho for a pale rider with sights set on taking down the bad, ugly, undead denizens of the dark.
item.properties|f.mechaknight_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a mecha knight.  It's so convincing, your friends just might try to deconstruct you\!
mission.properties|o.great_escape: Infiltrate the gremlin prison, free the captured Knights and stage an escape
item.properties|f.dusker_cap: A hide helm for knights that prefer to take their opponents on toe-to-toe.
item.properties|f.cautery_sword: A sword adapted from a medical tool, its heated blade reduces tissue damage. It is very formidable at destroying monsters of the slime family.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_2_6a: What have they become this time?
item.properties|f.kat_claw_cloak: A crudely crafted cloak made to resemble a cut-throat warrior of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|o.p_tortodrone_r4: Investigate the Ancient Grove and put a stop to a Fiendish plot.
mission.properties|r.anniversary_gremlin: Biscotti asked me to come check on you.
item.properties|f.punch_gun: Used to blast open damaged drop pods, this emergency rescue tool doubles nicely as a powerful, single shot handgun.
item.properties|m.hatch_egg_prompt: The Battle Sprite inside will bind to you upon opening.
conversation.properties|m.rc_injured_b: One of those mechanical monsters got me.  The cursed thing's claws tore right through my armor\!
mission.properties|o.whipping_mishandlin: Deliver the supplies to the research team within the fiendish city of Sol' Fork
item.properties|f.lockbox_character: A special lockbox that contains one of many unique items that modify the appearance of your Knight\!  It can only be opened with a Silver Key.  Silver Keys can be purchased from the Supply Depot.
item.properties|m.unlock_box_prompt: A Silver Key is required to open this Lockbox. Lockboxes contain random prizes inside.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Whatever that was, we're here now. Wherever here is. It looks like our only option is to see where this leads.
item.properties|f.furni_wardrobe_sklocke: A locked cabinet containing currently unequipped clothing and armor.
item.properties|f.vial_shock: A glass vial containing hyper-charged electric fluids. It can be used to inflict enemies with Shock.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and give your foes a real ZAP\!
helptips.properties|m.loading1: The Clockworks below the surface cycle levels in real time. You will never see all the levels a world has to offer in a single trip. Only a true adventurer will discover all the secrets\!
conversation.properties|r.tut_intro3_2a: I'll scout ahead then\! Be careful, Rhendon.
item.properties|f.night_cap_sallet: A comfortable cap for knights to wear at night. Sure to give the wearer lucid dreams to face their nightmares.
dungeon.properties|m.ancient_generator_d: Beneath the Rescue Camp is a massive energy source, capable of powering the elevator to Haven if only it could be harnessed.
conversation.properties|r.mon_pocket_1: Show me who is up for adoption\!
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_2a: After the Skylark crashed, its primary tearium core exploded, destroying a portion of the ship and leaving it without a main power source. Since so far we haven't found several hundred tons of tearium just lying around, the bird has effectively lost its wings. \n\nWith the help of the Strangers, we were able to set up a small base of operations here in Haven. Once we got our systems online, we discovered that within the heart of this rock resonates a power signature of unprecedented magnitude.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_6a: On the east side we have a couple of combat practice rooms. These Training Cubes are mostly harmless and are perfect for experimenting with your weapons and shield techniques\!
item.properties|f.pith_helm: A simple but effective helm favored by Spiral Knight recruits.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_efbf39: Hit an opponent with a snowball in Lockdown.
item.properties|f.super_brawl_crown: Awarded to the champion of Super Brawl\!
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
helptips.properties|m.tg1_end: Hey, you made it\! That's just great, really. You just saved me a whole lot of paperwork, so thanks. Hope those wolvers weren't too much of a surprise. Head on over to the elevator and we'll call this expedition complete.
mission.properties|r.anniversary_start_3: Though my training never included confectionery combat, I'm in\!
item.properties|m.pvp_token_upgrade.1: Gives {0} extra Krogmo Coin in PvP.
item.properties|f.sacred_hex_armor: A phantasmal suit of armor for those who are aiming for the infernal.
mission.properties|b.p_fast_advancement: Use this Test Server exclusive mission to quickly power up your weapons and gear.  Each level of this mission is exactly the same, allowing you to change your equipped weapons and gear at each depth. \n\nOnly a few heat embers are needed to max out any item\! 'Return to Haven' before you reach the end so you can come back to this mission.
item.properties|f.shining_ward: A sacred shield that protects the user from evil.
mission.properties|m.time_enough_at_last: I'm saying that I have a lot of reading to do now.  The fight is over, that's all. \n\nPlease, head back to Haven and let everyone know things are ok.
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r9: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.

helptips.properties|m.tut_miniboss: You've almost made it to the Rescue Camp, run through the force barrier ahead\!
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_shock: Check on Groat the Gremlin Chef.
helptips.properties|m.need_key_grim_gate: The Grim Gate requires a Fiendish ID Card to activate.
item.properties|f.rock_jelly_mail: This gelatinous gear combines the sturdiness of stone with the piercing protection of sticky goo. It's a wonder that you managed to beat up the jelly this is made out of.
mission.properties|r.darkest_depths_4a: I'll make it.  Just you wait.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Reinforcements from Spiral HQ at last\!
item.properties|f.frosted_helm: A delicious helm made of cake created during the Spiral Knights Anniversary Celebration. Since it's made of cake, it eventually falls apart.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: Greetings, {0}\! Now that I've had sufficient time to research the battle sprites you rescued I can give you a proper evaluation of each. \n\nDespite their well, strange appearance, we have concluded that these 'new' battle sprites are not only suitable for combat but may have even further enhanced capabilities as a result of their transformation.
auction.properties|m.cancel_confirm: You will get your item back but will not be refunded your listing fee.
mission.properties|b.guardians_of_cradle: You have been invited to attend a meeting with several members of Spiral HQ to discuss what to do next about the Core and the threat of the Swarm. Join them in the Hall of Heroes to learn about Operations Missions.
item.properties|f.exp_east_3f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.love_puppy_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a love puppy.  It's so convincing, your friends just might want a kiss\!
chat.properties|m.usage_complain: Usage\: /{0} player name\nFile a complaint against the specified player.
item.properties|f.empty_room_catwalk: An empty Guild Hall room with industrial flooring and plenty of space for furniture\!
conversation.properties|m.casino_yesman_: Undercorp employees get a free mug with every visit.
mission.properties|o.minerals_rock: Report to Chief Geo Knight Wegner in the Haven Arcade
item.properties|f.golden_solstice_ring: An enchanted ring that embodies the spirit of the solstice. Its glittering golden luster shines brightest during the summer months.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_bl: A short torch filled with bizarre blue fire.
mission.properties|b.welcome_to_haven: Having survived the journey to Haven you must contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink and give her your report.  She has information as to what to do next as well as special instructions on the use of energy.
item.properties|m.use_recipe:
Use this item to add the {0} to your Known Recipes list? 

Items can be created at Alchemy Stations.
(You may view your learned recipes at any time by pressing <{1}>.)
item.properties|f.voltaic_radical_suit: A suit said to be replicated by a sentient mechaknight. It comes with a synthetic skinsuit that pulses with an electric energy.

mission.properties|b.occurance_at_owlite:
An unlikely source of intel has surfaced from the residents of Moorcroft Manor.  A few of the spookats that call it home contacted one of our visiting Recon Knights and provided details of the negative energy mass that has appeared above the Core. 

Calling it 'a place of burning hatred' and 'a prison for dark souls' they say that you can read all about it in 'one of those weird Owlite books' in an Owlite keep they pinpointed. 

If what they claim is true Spiral HQ could gain valuable intel from investigating the Owlite keep.  Just remember that these Owlite structures have all proven to be swarming with the lost souls of countless undead monsters.  Prepare accordingly.

mission.properties|b.operation_crimson_h:
Warmaster Seerus is the master of munitions of the gremlin's Crimson Order.  Thought to be the true mastermind behind the Roarmulus Twins and countless other gremlin weapons, he is the Crimson Order's creator and supplier for their diabolical engines of war. 

Recon Knights under the command of Lieutenant Feron recently discovered Seerus's 'Grand Arsenal,' his development center and storage facility for all his weaponry.  Now, Feron himself is leading several squads of knights directly into the Grand Arsenal, with the intention of weeding out Seerus and destroying his war machines. 

Met with heavy resistance, Feron's squads require reinforcements and Spiral HQ is sending you in to assist.
item.properties|f.savage_tortoise: A shield alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. Even a rampaging wolver pack would have a hard time puncturing its reinforced plates.
mission.properties|b.p_toxic_plant_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has uncovered a gremlin bioweapons facility deep within the Clockworks. It is believed that this facility belongs to a member of the Crimson Order known only as 'Herex.' The Recon Rangers have been tasked with infiltrating the facility and uncovering the nature of Herex's bioweapons before they are put to use.
mission.properties|b.vile_engine:
Somewhere below a level that lichens have taken to inhabiting lies a strange facility of unknown origin that seems to be used for the production of toxic slime monsters. The 'slime generators' are capable of rapidly producing slime monsters that then quickly populate nearby levels. 

Squads in neighboring levels have already reported overwhelming numbers of toxic slimes, making it impossible to lead expeditions beyond depth 23.  It is time a knight of your caliber form a squad to infiltrate this strange facility and shut down production of these vile creatures. 

Any data that you could collect as to their origin would be highly valuable to Spiral HQ.

mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_danger:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

On behalf of Impostoclaus, Spiral HQ has located the base of operations of the nefarious Grinchlins. It's time to take the fight to them and end their Winterfest terrorism once and for all. But it won't be an easy task. 

Those who accept this mission must climb Mount Krampus, a perilous trek filled with Grinchlin ambushes and icy deathtraps. Along the way you will find shelters that allow you to collect Grinchlin treasures and escape the mountain, or press on toward the summit for even greater rewards\! Just be warned\: Grinchlins and their allies are a stingy lot and will not drop ANY loot. All the treasures to be found on Mount Krampus are at the shelters. And should you pass on them for greater rewards ahead, you risk losing everything if you fail\! 

Some say that on the very summit of Mount Krampus lies a stash of Grinchlin loot that may contain treasures none have ever seen before...

uplink.properties|m.tf2_start:
G'Day, loyal customer\! 

You may have recently heard that I've become the fourth richest man in America, having surpassed the fifth richest man in wealth, and having killed the previously-fourth richest man in a harpoon duel. While this is, of course, entirely true (especially the part about the harpoon duel, which was long and bloody), it's not nearly enough. Fourth place might be fine for HIPPIES who wouldn't know victory if it wandered up and offered to braid their ponytails, but it's damn well not good enough for Saxton Hale\! 

Mister Reddy, my accountant, explained to me that the best way to light a fire under the backside of Mann Co.'s revenue would be to "open up new markets". I'd relate exactly how we plan on doing that to you, but as he was talking I immediately started doing military presses to keep from dying of boredom, and missed out on the intricate details. 

All you need to know, dear customer, is that I need a good man to find his way to a town called "Haven", bravely stride into one of the many gates there and then cut his way down to the first "Clockworks Terminal". Since we couldn't find a good man, you'll have to do it yourself. You'll be amply rewarded, of course\: there's NOTHING I wouldn't do for an employee who risked life and limb on a trivial task necessitated by my selfish whims. 

Don't bother directly contacting me once you're done, as I'll be too busy kickboxing giraffes to care. One of my other employees will handle things from there. Best of luck\: you'll need it\! 

Sincerely yours, 

SAXTON HALE 
Australian 
CEO, Mann Co.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
item.properties|f.power_mitt: A must have in every kitchen. The comfortable fit and heavyweight silverweave surface are great for handling high heat. Now you're cooking with power\!
item.properties|f.obsidian_hood_of_ritua: 'With great practice and tender care, with an eternal heart and mind so pure\: sharpen the stone, sturdy the chain, welcome the night, drink the Cup of Kings.'
dungeon.properties|m.golden_slime_prize_: Each spin of the wheel rewards you with a random prize, sometimes including very special items\! Requires 50 Golden Slime Coins or equivalent crowns.
mission.properties|o.time_to_crafty: Alchemize a Hot Edge and Frost Gun and turn it in for inspection.
item.properties|f.toxic_catalyzer: A Catalyzer modified to fire dangerously radioactive projectiles. Catalyzer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
guild.properties|m.invite_message: Enter an optional message to include with your invitation\:
item.properties|f.helm_side: An accessory that can be attached to the side of select helmets.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
conversation.properties|r.almire_histori: What happened to the rest of the kingdom?
item.properties|f.rocky_core: A delicious gummy treat with an impenetrable rocky shell. More than a few teeth have been lost by knights attempting to get at the gooey interior.
mission.properties|o.p_apocrea_r6: Investigate the area of the Clockworks where several knights have gone missing.
item.properties|f.hazardous_brigandine: Padded armor that seems to emphasize the high mortality rate of the elite Scarlet Scouts. Scarlet Scouts need to travel light and fast in order to stay ahead of lesser skilled squads.
mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r4: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
mission.properties|m.collector_prisoner_: Ugh, I can barely see... did Spiral HQ send you to rescue us?
guild.properties|m.invitee_denied: {0} could not accept an invitation to join {1}\: guild is full.
helptips.properties|m.party_button: The party button will activate when all living party members are standing on it.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_4: Required items will appear once your sprite is ready to level up. After your sprite has consumed enough heat, a 'required material' notice will appear above the feeding tray. This material MUST be fed to the sprite in order for it to advance further.
item.properties|f.exp_west_3f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the western side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.prize_box_disguise: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Disguise style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.brute_jelly_mail: A firm set of mucilaginous mail crafted from the remains of particularly antagonistic jellies.
item.properties|f.token_snarbolax: A long, razor-sharp tooth plucked from the mouth of a Snarbolax; a memento representing a Knight's triumph over the monstrous stalker of the Gloaming Wildwoods.
item.properties|f.divine_avenger: An upgraded Avenger forged from the purest sun steel. There are few foes remaining in this world that are worthy enough to be defeated by such a fine blade, and there are still fewer heroes worthy of wielding it.
item.properties|f.plated_pathfinder_armo: A hardened set of armor made to protect against even the most voracious monsters while exploring the unknown.
item.properties|f.obsidian_shard: A jet-black shard of unnatural stone. Holding it fills your head with imagery of a distant shore where waves crash against rocks that seem to writhe in the chill of the water.
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_4: Once you reach the elevator, the mineral you are carrying gets deposited in your arsenal for use later. Everyone in your party gets everyone else's minerals, so no need to fight over who gets the best one\!
mission.properties|b.weight_of_darkness:
It is speculated that all fiends within the Clockworks crossed over from a dimension known as the Underworld.  While how they crossed over and what their motives are on Cradle is unclear, data collected from fiendish cities seems to indicate that they are now stranded on Cradle, much like us. 

The undead on the other hand remain a mystery.  Why spirits return to the material realm is unknown, though it is clear that many of the spirits within the Clockworks have come from other worlds.  Given how hostile these creatures can be, the only way to obtain useful data is through direct interactions, like combat. 

Spiral HQ is requesting that you collect combat data for the powerful fiend and undead monsters in Tier 3 of the Clockworks in order to better understand the nature of these creatures. 

It is highly recommended that you equip yourself with shadow resistant gear with elemental and piercing damage weapons\!
item.properties|f.vial_fire_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing a molten mixture. It can be used to inflict enemies with Fire.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and turn 'em into toast\!
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_6a: I'd like to see the shops again. (Follow Tylen)
helptips.properties|m.event_locked_modul:
Warning\! An unidentified place of interest lies beyond this gate. By entering you will not be able to turn back until you complete the challenges within.

However, should you manage to come out victorious you will be rewarded for your bravery. Enter at your own risk\! 

This room offers a bonus chance at the treasures within.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_end_1:
{0}\! You did it\!  I've got my kitchen back\! 

Remember, you can exchange the Cake Slices you receive for awesome cake helms from Maskwell in the Haven Town Square. It's just like that old baker's saying, 'Wear the hide of your fallen foes to prove your might as a warrior\!' 

Ok, maybe I just say that.
exchange.properties|m.offertobuy_tooltip: Enter the price, in crowns, that you are willing to pay.
item.properties|f.prize_box_frosty: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Frosty style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
dungeon.properties|m.graveyard_desc: A graveyard is a terrible place that simultaneously exists in the world of the living and the dead. Though they contain secret treasures in their dark corners, they are home to ancient horrors that wish to consume all who enter. Once inside, finding an exit as fast as possible is advised.
mission.properties|m.darkest_depths_4a: As a Defender, you can now undertake missions in Tier 3 of the Clockworks.  These are the deepest and most dangerous depths of the Clockworks, delve any further and you will reach the Core itself. \n\nPerhaps if you make it that far, you can locate the Alpha Squad, I just don't know.
social.properties|e.maxfriends_inviter: Sorry, {0} already has the maximum number of friends.
item.properties|f.heavenly_guardian_helm: A brilliant, white helm belonging to a heavenly warrior.
mission.properties|m.true_champion_1a: {0}\! Oh, {0} you made it\! Haha\! \n\nI am so happy you came out of there alive\!  I was worried sick about you\!
mission.properties|o.p_r9_mat_345: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_3a: When our technicians finally got the Skylark's communications systems online, we could not establish a link with the Alpha Squad and they have never been heard from since. Their channel is completely dead. \n\nTheir dead line is what has us all scratching our heads.  Our comlinks are built to withstand all manners of extreme conditions, even explosions.  Heck, they survived the Skylark going down after all.  There's nothing I can think of that could kill the link completely.
item.properties|f.bechamel_room: A trendy room where Bechamel can add or remove Accessories from your favorite equipment.
item.properties|f.pulsar: A high-tech Gremlin firearm originally designed for use by elite squads of Ironclaw soldiers. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_weap_3: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
conversation.properties|r.hav_clock_1a: Tell me what you know about the Clockworks.
exchange.properties|m.opening_paypal: Opening PayPal checkout in your browser...
item.properties|f.hazardous_draped_armor: Loose-fitting armor worn by more experienced Scarlet Scouts. It's rumored that gear like this is crafted from the remains of armor from Scouts who fell in combat, acting as a reminder that unless necessary Scouts never leave a man behind.
item.properties|f.blaze_pepper: A delectable spice prized by Clockwork denizens of all sorts. In powdered form, it has a terrible habit of clinging to absolutely everything.
exchange.properties|m.steam_success: Thank you for your purchase\! Your Energy will be delivered momentarily.
mission.properties|b.rotting_metropolis: It would seem as though those slime generators have been around much longer than we thought, seeping their vile toxins into any levels that should be near them. \n\nA modern city, much like those that the devilites inhabit seems to be overrun with these toxins, and was probably left behind by both the devilites and gremlins as a result.  Now a legion of slime and undead creatures haunt the place, festering in the poisons that linger in the air.  A squad that was attempting to pass through the city has gone missing.  Given that the very air is toxic, it is urgent that an experienced team enter this city and rescue the squad.  There is little hope left for them otherwise.
mission.properties|o.operation_crimson_h: Join Lieutenant Feron in a siege of the Grand Arsenal of Warmaster Seerus.
conversation.properties|m.npc_supply_tea: Sorry I don't have much time to talk. I have to get all these supplies down to our forward outposts. People tend to forget that without knights like us running supplies down into the Clockworks, our ability to scout out areas further afield would be severely limited.  What a thankless job, huh?
guild.properties|i.buy_expansions: Purchase more space for the Guild Hall. Increases upkeep.
item.properties|f.winterfest_tree: A spectacularly spiraling tree decorated in the spirit of Winterfest. Folklore states that Impostoclaus leaves presents for those that have been nice throughout the year while those that have been naughty find their presents filled with jelly. Some believe this is the only reason that chromalisks are hostile.
item.properties|f.swimsuit_trunks: A pair of spiral issue trunks intended for coastal expeditions and fun in the sun.
item.properties|f.mug_misery: A cursed drinking utility that can only be used by a truly wicked soul. Those that possess it are said to bring grave misfortune to those around them.
chat.properties|m.usage_set-ident: Usage\: /{0}\nSet this knight as your identity for posting in the forums.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_4a: Take it easy {0}, not all gremlins are cut from the same cloth.  Some disagree with the ways of King Tinkinzar and the Crimson Order.  In fact, somewhere down in the Clockworks I'm told there's an entire town full of gremlins who left the Great Colony.
conversation.properties|r.tut_intro_1a: Roger that, I'm on my way\!
item.properties|f.toxic_vaporizer: An alchemical bomb that produces a noxious cloud of toxins.
item.properties|f.vial_fire_super: An ornate glass vial containing a molten mixture. It can be used to inflict enemies with Fire.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and turn 'em into toast\!
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r6: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
craft.properties|m.moved_treasury: Item moved to your Guild Treasury
pvp.properties|m.title: KING KROGMO'S COLISEUM
item.properties|f.divine_veil: A heavenly hood of the style once worn by celestial sages.
uplink.properties|m.bounced:
Unable to deliver mail to GM.
To make sure your mail will be read and handled quickly, please send your issue via regular mail to support@spiralknights.com
-----------------------------------------
Original mail\: {0}
item.properties|f.vial_sleep_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing a drowsy draught. It can be used to inflict enemies with Sleep.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be snoring in seconds\!
dungeon.properties|m.goahead_description: Leave your party and venture out on your own.
item.properties|f.seerus_fragment_1: A fractured fragment of the mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus, recovered from the siege of his Grand Arsenal.
mission.properties|m.shadowplay_3a: I look forward to our next...meeting.
chat.properties|m.usage_heat: Usage\: /{0} (weapon armor helmet shield sprite) [heat]\nSets the equipment to that heat.
social.properties|m.friend_request_pendi: You have already sent a friend request to {0}.
item.properties|m.prize_box_rose_regalia: Rose Regalia Returns Again Prize Box
item.properties|f.furni_pet_lazy_rooster: A festive new years snipe that will stay where it's placed.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_2a: Yikes, are those the sprites or some kind of phantom?
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_3: Thankfully the damage to the lab wasn't too extensive. The equipment for maintaining our battle sprites is intact at least.
pvp.properties|m.love_reupload: Uploading a new file for the selected level.
exchange.properties|m.coinex_offer_cance: You have been refunded {0} energy for your cancelled energy offer.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_r6: Meet with Biscotti in her kitchen and provide 'baking assistance.'
item.properties|f.black_kat_mail: An impressive mail instilled with the might of Kat Nappers, the undercover sleeper cell of the Kat Tribe.
support.properties|m.option_207_0: If you believe someone is maliciously trying to scam you, then please click here to send the complaint. You may want to inform this player they have been complained that way other players around you can hear this too and take precaution.
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight6_1a: We're not taking any chances with this artifact you found, {0}. One day the gremlins might be back for it.  Be on your guard\!
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_4: When you interact with an Alchemy Station you will open the alchemy interface where you can see your known recipe...
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_1: You... you are not one of the lost. You must be strong to make it to this court. Please, you must help me\!
item.properties|f.reaper_rib: A bone stained black by the wickedness of its former possessor.
item.properties|f.gh_theme_freeze: A frosty theme that turns Guild Halls into a popular retreat during the warm, summer months on Cradle.
item.properties|f.stone_tortoise: A large, powerful shield made to resemble a creature's shell. Its formidable weight can make attacking more difficult.
item.properties|f.prize_box_c: The complete collection of {0} costumes and accessories. One item will be randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
design.properties|e.room_already_placed: That room has already been installed at another location.
logon.properties|m.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please log in on the website again and relaunch the game.
item.properties|f.elite_orb: A rare, encapsulated element used in alchemical transmutation. Orbs like these are used by elite knights to craft items of exceptional quality and power.
item.properties|f.scale_shield: A very stylish shield made from lizard scales. While otherwise somewhat weak, the tight mesh of scales makes it highly resistant to pierce damage.
chat.properties|m.usage_goodbye: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nBids your fellow players farewell.
item.properties|f.barrier_cannon: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. The elemental offense of a tortodrone on the Long Migration should aid you on your own expeditions.
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_h:
The Clockworks have been so consistent for so long\! Just ticking along like, well... you know. But now *something is happening* and I don't know what it is\!\! 

I'm so excited\! 

Bring us samples of these Mysterious Spikes and we'll make good trades for them\!
item.properties|f.cyclops_cap: A strange helm with a single, focused eye favored by junior gunners.
conversation.properties|m.rc_greet3_1a: You've restored the power and saved us all, {0}\!  I can't thank you enough, all these recruits owe you their lives. \n\nYou should now try to contact Spiral HQ via your comlink.
conversation.properties|r.monsterboost_s: And... Anomalie is signing off on this?
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_4a: Now then, greet those that have helped you become what you are today. When you are done, take the elevator back up to receive your commendation.
item.properties|f.deadly_shard_bomb: A large chunk of Crimsonite primed with a potent explosive. No more depleted Crimsonite here\: this bomb's made with the good stuff\! Or the bad stuff, if you happen to be the target.
helptips.properties|m.final_test: You've made it this far knight - but your final exam will require quick thinking and even faster feet.
item.properties|f.frenzy_crusader_helm: A helm worn by mythical soldiers who are said to fight with such a frenzy they create whirlwinds in their wake.
conversation.properties|r.arc_leader_2: If we could somehow harness that power...
item.properties|f.royal_jelly_crown: Ruggedly royal regalia recently reproduced from regally resinous remains.
sprites.properties|d.haunted_haze: Any target that dies as a result of the damage caused by hexing haze will spawn a vengeful ghost that seeks out other targets and explodes on impact.
chat.properties|m.usage_item_pack: Usage\: /{0} pack [player name]\nGives an item pack to the player
helptips.properties|m.test_lobby: Welcome testers\! Before you head off into the Clockworks, feel free to help yourself to some wonderful stuff from the merchant to the left. \nThe embers to the far right will level up weapons once your collect enough of them and proceed to the next floor. \nGood luck, brave knights\!
helptips.properties|m.unlock_grim_gate: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use a Fiendish ID Card \n\nWARNING\: If this Grim Gate is unlocked the party will become locked and stay locked for the duration of the mission. Choose your party members wisely\!
projectx.properties|m.reboot_msg_standar: This is a regularly scheduled maintenance reboot. It will be available as soon as possible.
item.properties|f.chess_room: An empty room with an 8x8 chess board in the corner and a row for spectators.
helptips.properties|m.tut_dash: Evade damage from monster attacks by pressing [[DODGE]].
mission.properties|b.pumping_up: You are free to use the Advanced Training Hall whenever you like in order to practice with new weapons or learn about other unique features of the Clockworks.  Check it out and see what it has to offer\!
mission.properties|o.chilled_to_bone: Investigate the shadowy remains of the Candlestick Keep
item.properties|f.virulent_seedling: This small, dangerous plant has been weaponized by biotechs so that it spreads a cloud of toxic spores on detonation. Don't let the size fool you, it packs several kiloaudreys of power.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_overgrown_2: Looks like you know how to handle yourself. That's good, because the final area is just ahead.
helptips.properties|m.sl_elevator_active: Shadow Key required to open.\nShadow Keys can be acquired randomly in lockboxes or purchased from the Supply Depot.
dungeon.properties|b.i_agree: I will never talk about C.U.B.E. Club
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft3_r9: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
item.properties|f.bucket_of_bloons: This bucket seems to have an endless supply of water bloons. They look ready to pop so throw them at your friends\!
helptips.properties|m.new_sprite: You've got a battle sprite\! Press [[SPRITE_ACTION_1]] to use your sprite's battle skill\!
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_2: Indeed\! A battle sprite can synthesize matter into useable energy. This machine can take certain materials and alchemize them into extra special sprite food... that is, when it's finally calibrated.
item.properties|f.obsidian_hood_of_influ: 'Speak with the one, true voice and they will listen. Quiet as a child's whisper, roaring like the death of this world.'
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Right.  Spiral HQ has informed me you'll likely be facing hordes of gremlins and constructs on this next go around.  Keep in mind that in Tier 3, these monsters can inflict pure elemental damage.  Do be sure to gear up appropriately.
conversation.properties|m.rc_end_3b: While the path is dangerous, you will not be traveling very deep, so the monsters you encounter should be easy enough to handle. However, scouts have been reporting increased gremlin activity in the area since we set up camp, so watch out.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
design.properties|m.door_install_warning: You are paying to install this door. If for any reason it is removed you will have to pay to install it again.
item.properties|f.skolver_cap: A finely-made hide cap that's the perfect crown for any king of the wild frontier.
projectx.properties|m.start_tooltip: Confirm this knight and begin your adventure \u25BA
mission.properties|o.shadowplay: Discover the source of the disturbance in Firestorm Citadel
item.properties|f.polaris: It's said that the explosions caused by this stellar sidearm are so bright that you'll always be able to find your way in the darkness. Polaris shots become more powerful the further they travel.
item.properties|f.hatchet: A heavy blade used to chop vines and foliage in the wilderness surrounding the Rescue Camp.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_welcome: Welcome back to the Training Grounds. This one is designed to teach you about special items that are found within the Clockworks called "pickups."
mission.properties|m.pioneers_8a: Parma was the youngest of the bunch, a very talented Recon, but with little combat experience.  She and I went to academy together and I can remember the day when the simulator technicians had thought their program was busted due to Parma's performance.  She actually apologized\! \n\nBut still, I'm worried about her.  From the reports that I've read, the Clockworks are unlike anything we've ever encountered.  I only hope that as she keeps them informed of what's ahead, that they will watch her back.
helptips.properties|m.mission_trap_chamb: All drones can move in a few different ways.
sprites.properties|d.meteoric_firebol: Increases the size of the firebolt's explosion.
chat.properties|m.usage_haven: Go to your last Haven place.
item.properties|f.stranger_hat: A hat once worn by one of the enigmatic Strangers.  It seems to have small, colorful feathers hiding in every seam.
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_5: Minerals are used to create sprite food in the Laboratory. Sprite food is very important to the development of your sprite, so grab those minerals when you see them\!
chat.properties|m.usage_accessory: Usage\: /{0} (armor helmet) [clear | accessory name]\nAdds an accessory to the equipment or clears all accessories.
item.properties|f.alpha_claw_gauntlet: A protective Wolver-hide gauntlet affixed with razor sharp claws.
dungeon.properties|m.starlight_cradle_de: Beneath a moonlit sky azure islands drift in a sea of stars. These islands are home to creatures that are more than happy to creep upon those that succumb to this world's endless lullaby.
item.properties|d.remove_accessory: WARNING\! Deleting an accessory from an item will destroy the accessory.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_vials_3: Now that you have a grasp of using pickups, let's apply what you've learned in a combat environment.
item.properties|f.stun_gun: A Proto Gun modified to stun monsters. Stunned monsters move and attack slower than normal.
item.properties|f.helm_front: An accessory that can be attached to the front of select helmets.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
conversation.properties|m.final_test_kni: I see.  This will be very interesting information for Spiral HQ.  Our base camp in Haven is just up ahead.  Head on up the elevator and meet the other Knights who survived the crash like yourself. The techs in the Lab will be eager to study that artifact.  They'll see to it once you get to Haven. \n\nDon't worry about the others in the Rescue Camp.  Thanks to you, we have a functioning elevator system to reach them.  You've saved them all\!
dungeon.properties|m.jigsaw_valley_desc: Appearing to be sky islands ripped apart and put back together again as if it were a puzzle this world can sometimes be confusing to navigate. Unfortunately it seems to also be home to a host of mindless slimes and constructs who do not seem to mind its erratic layout.
item.properties|f.jack_froster: Usher in a winter wonderland with this nose-nipping, nasty surprise that is perfect for giving your foes a bad case of frostbite.
pvp.properties|m.love_review_confirm: Are you sure? Once in review, you will no longer be able to make changes. Please completely test your level before submitting. It may take up to a week to review.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_a: I always carry a variety of gear... just in case.
conversation.properties|m.atg_greeter_1a: Welcome to our advanced training hall. Here you will find useful survival tips to help you on your journey through the Clockworks. \n\nWould you like some directions?
logon.properties|m.server_error: A server error caused authentication to fail.
exchange.properties|m.billing_steam_erro: Steam Error\: User account is unable to make purchases at this time.
mission.properties|m.ending_in_fire_2a: At the rate you're going you just might, {0}\!  Though based on new intel it would seem that's not going to be easy.
dungeon.properties|i.difficulty_easy: Normal difficulty features challenges suitable for any player.
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_4a: When a battle sprite is issued to a knight, a 'bond' is written into the sprite's code to support the knight no matter the circumstances.  They will never leave your side\! \n\nUnfortunately, the cargo crates holding the Skylark's cache of battle sprites fell deep into the Clockworks after the crash.
mission.properties|b.rise_or_fall: Infiltrating the Royal Jelly Palace and taking on the hordes of slimes that serve the great Royal Jelly is not going to be an easy task.  It is highly recommended you seek one of the 'Battle Arenas' within the Clockworks and determine if your equipment is up to the challenge of facing so many savage slimes. \n\nSpiral HQ has located one of these mysterious arenas that seems to be filled with all manner of gooey gladiators seeking a challenge.  Give them a good fight\!
item.properties|f.shadow_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who gain their powers using forbidden, dark arts.
conversation.properties|r.lab_biscotti_4: Where can I acquire these items?
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_b_1a: Hi there {0}\!  Wow, you've made Soldier already?  You're really moving up fast in the ranks. \n\nAnyway, I'm Bechamel, and I'm here to give you a tour of some of the Bazaar's more advanced services. To start, do you want to learn how to even further power up that gear of yours?
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_b_2a: It is now. I was just on my way to the bazaar to drop off some supplies when I was ambushed by these gremlins. I thought they were from Emberlight, a colony of gremlin outcasts, but it looks like I was mistaken. \n\nJust to be safe, would you mind helping me get these items to the bazaar?
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Victory is ours\!

support.properties|m.option_203_0:

mission.properties|m.pumping_up_2a: Welcome to the Advanced Training Hall, {0}.  Here you will find useful survival tips to help you on your journey through the Clockworks. \n\nWould you like a tour of the facilities?
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry. These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
item.properties|f.aegis: A sublime shield entrusted to only the most worthy members of the Spiral Order. Whether its crest is a relic from the Order of old or a creation from the Knights' time on Cradle is not immediately clear.
item.properties|f.token_forge: A small wisp of the essential spirit of technology and progress. It is of extreme value to the Spiral Order. Take it to the Token Trader in the Haven Bazaar\!
item.properties|f.humbug_hazer: This cantankerous contraption is guaranteed to make anyone but the most curmudgeonly humbug sick to their stomach.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_11a: Right, down to business.  We've located an Alpha Squad recon module in an area of the Clockworks known as the 'Gloaming Wildwoods.'  However, this particular zone is home to a horrible creature known as 'the Snarbolax.' \n\nThe Snarbolax has made fast work of Squires like yourself, but I know you can handle it, {0}. But you're going to need to prepare.  I've issued you a series of missions that will allow you to assemble a loadout fit for taking on this terrible beast and reclaiming that recon module\!
item.properties|f.raging_warrior_helm: A helm worn by a fabled sword master so angry, his rage alone could fell armies that rose against him.

uplink.properties|m.rank_mig: Spiral Knights has recently undergone a change that has added new mission rewards to missions you have already completed. They are attached.\n\nEnjoy\!
helptips.properties|m.wolver_den: Wolvers are a highly adaptable pack beast whose predatory instincts are only matched by their quick reflexes.  They play with their prey by dancing about and finally striking from behind.  Keep a blade handy.
mission.properties|o.hall_of_heroes_2: Visit the Hall of Heroes wearing at least 3 Star gear and receive certification
item.properties|f.wooly_pullover: A stylish sweater for the pre-snowy season. {0}
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
item.properties|f.static_edge: A modified Proto Sword capable of generating a low-intensity electrical charge.
item.properties|f.cloak: An extraordinary cloak favored by the students of the arcane.
conversation.properties|m.deskclerk_1a: Welcome to Moorcroft Manor, where tired spirits come to rest their legs (if applicable). If you plan on staying the night, please remember we will perform a light turn to your room every ninety-nine years, a continental breakfast is served compliments of the house every full moon and you may never leave this place for ever and ever. Enjoy your stay\!
social.properties|m.friend_party_progres: You must wait for {0}'s party to reach depth {1}.
item.properties|f.volcanic_salamander_su: A Salamander Suit reinforced with sturdy plates of volcanic iron. Extremely protective, and usable as a makeshift stove during long deployments.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
dungeon.properties|m.final_test_desc: The final gate available at the Rescue Camp, this gate crosses the chasm and leads into Haven. There is no going back once completed.
conversation.properties|m.npc_campknight: Have a seat and rest a while.

item.properties|f.prize_box_cavalry: Contains various unique accessories and items to celebrate the Year of the Horse\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.ghost_bell: A small, silvery bell worn by considerate ghosts that alerts the living when they are close by.
mission.properties|r.eye_of_needle_3a: And why is it now blocking access to the Core, now that we're so close?
item.properties|f.dead_gold: A coin placed into the hands of the dead before burial, granting them fare for the long journey ahead.
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_12b: Thanks Bechamel, I'll be seeing you\!
