mission.properties|m.another_trace_1a: Hello {0}, I'm happy to report that my equipment is back up and running\! Now I have some good news and bad news for you.  The good news is\: I've been able to track down the source of that energy signature. Here is the bad news\: the energy source has been pinpointed to a highly dangerous area of the Clockworks that Recon Knights have dubbed the 'Royal Jelly Palace.'
exchange.properties|m.coins_cancelled_po: You have been refunded {0} crowns for your cancelled energy offer.
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_2: Yes, exactly\! During your travels in the Clockworks you will encounter five special minerals\: crimsonite, moonstone, valestone, luminite and dark matter.
item.properties|f.ecto_drop: A bit of ectoplasm meticulously collected from an unwilling undead volunteer. It's an unpleasant shade of green.
conversation.properties|r.energy_info_1b: No thanks, I'm content not knowing about such an amazing thing.
logon.properties|m.converted_to_steam: This account has been converted to Steam.  Select Use Steam Account to log on.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.
guild.properties|m.published: The Guild Hall has been updated\!
item.properties|f.furni_pet_wandering_go: A festive fall snipe that will explore its surroundings.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_4c: Harness upgrades are definitely worth the crowns. Superior versions of each harness reduce combat skill cooldowns\!
mission.properties|b.p_r4_weap_1: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
item.properties|f.ticket_unbind_2: Use this ticket at the Unbinding Forge to unbind a 2 star item.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_4a: We need you to discover what happened to them.  You'll start by seeking out known locations of their recon modules and collecting them for analysis.  I will be in charge of locating their general whereabouts and directing you toward them.  It's your job to go into the wild to retrieve them. \n\nAdditionally, I'll provide you with a quick background of each of the four members of the Alpha Squad\: Squad Leader Euclid, Squad Guardian Grantz, Squad Recon Parma, and Squad Technician Rulen.
mission.properties|o.crossing_chasm_b: Cross the chasm with Rhendon and reach Haven
item.properties|d.recover_accessory: Recovers an accessory from an item, returning the accessory to your arsenal.
helptips.properties|m.tg_welcome: Welcome to the Training Ground, recruit. In this derelict section of the Clockworks you'll find areas we have built in order to train you in the fine art of not dying a horrible death. So pay attention to these helpful tips, ready your weapon, and get moving\!
item.properties|f.flourish: A stylish saber well-appointed to foiling your enemies.
item.properties|f.power_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.
conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_4: That's the kind of spirit I like to see. It works like this\: you use the gates up ahead to explore the Clockworks and retrieve special minerals. Then you deposit those minerals back in to gates to change the Clockworks below, creating new, unexplored levels.\n\nWe believe the minerals are the key to opening a path to the Core, we just need to discover how to use them\!
item.properties|f.sacred_pathfinder_helm: A reinforced helm that is sure to stop the sharpest of foes.
item.properties|f.draped_armor: A stylish suit of armor that adds a touch of class to battle.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_failedpar: The candle's going out\!  They're coming\! Curse Kalem for going after that treasure...
conversation.properties|m.hav_clock_2a: I will share with you what I know, little one.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_4: I mean that the Core isn't a big battery that runs this world, but rather it and the whole of this world is a massive prison designed to keep something from ever leaving. \n\nThink about our geo-scans of Cradle just before the crash- they show it as being composed of hundreds of massive slabs of other worlds, almost like plates of armor.  Then you have the Clockworks, the most unnatural thing I've ever seen.  An entire world whose sole purpose seems to be stopping anyone from ever reaching its Core.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_welcome: Welcome back to the Training Grounds. This last level will teach you the last few important things you will need to know as an explorer of the Clockworks. Head up the ramp and let's begin\!
item.properties|f.style_kit: {0}  This item will be destroyed, but you will be able to re-apply this modifier to your knight using the style kit.
mission.properties|m.search_continues_4a: I don't know, but it is certainly a terrifying picture she has painted. Something stirs within the heart of this world, {0}, something terrible.  I've felt it since we first set foot on this world; invisible eyes watching our every move, shapes that form just out of view... something greater than gremlins calls this world home.
item.properties|f.snarbostuffing: A dense, fluffy stuffing made from a special polymer that doesn't break down when exposed to the cursed fur of the Snarbolax. It's perfect for creating trophies or adorable, cursed, stuffed toys.
mission.properties|r.laboratory_visit_3a: Sounds very useful. How do I get one?
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_2_2: Those heavy cogs are in our way, and from intel reports, the only way to open them up is from inside two adjacent gatehouses.  I will not waste needless lives battering at the gatehouse from the front.  I'll need you to find a way around.  Flank the defenses, get inside the gatehouse, and open up the gates\!
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_2a: Ah, that's right, you're a new recruit.  Most knights encounter their first sprite on the battlefield.  Chances are you've not had the opportunity to see one yet. \n\nAllow me to explain...
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
auction.properties|e.search_text_short: Your search text is too short.
mission.properties|o.p_ghost_machine_r7: Join Desna's Recon Rangers in discovering the source of the distress call within the derelict facility.
item.properties|f.scary_skelly_mask: An upgraded Skelly Mask infused with the elemental essence of fear. Wearing it makes the hair on the back of your neck stand up.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_6a: I'm curious... what do you think is behind their masks? Wait, no, I don't want to know.
item.properties|f.feral_cannon: A handgun alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. While wielding it, you can feel the penetrating energies within just waiting to be unleashed.
item.properties|f.deadly_charcoaler: This gallant grill is guaranteed to char your competition.
item.properties|f.troika: A low-tech sword that makes up for its lack of high internal power with sheer weight and size. It is capable of delivering crushing blows for those that can handle it.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_1: Hi there\! I'm Biscotti, Head Chef of the Skylark\! I'm still calibrating the battle sprite food alchemizer, so check back with me later.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: The maskeraith is a battle sprite that embodies deception and debilitation. Its skills focus on subterfuge\: caustic quills fire poisonous quills that explode when followed with an attack, shadow cloak allows a knight to become invisible to monsters, and hexing haze allows the knight to inflict monsters with a timed damage blast. \n\nThe maskeraith is best suited for knights who wish to lurk in the shadows and strike the enemy with sneak attacks.
item.properties|f.luminite_deposit_3: A large lump of minerals that will generate a great many units of luminite.
conversation.properties|m.mission_resear: We were studying that meteorite when those lichens appeared\!
item.properties|f.fearless_rigadoon: The ultimate in paralyzing piercers, it's unclear whether its elegance or its wicked bite is what leaves opponents stupefied.
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_1:
Glorp\! Glorp\! Glorp\! Merry Winterfest\!

That special time of year is finally here, when a delicate blanket of wondrous white snow covers Haven and every Stranger, every snipe and every Knight fills their hearts with holiday cheer.

But to you I must tell, all is sadly not well. Lacking motive or reason, a group of shriveled-heart grinchlins have threatened this Winterfest season\!
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_4a: Lost souls trapped by the Apocrea are bound to the realities they have created. Find the lost souls and free them from the bonds of the Apocrea.
mission.properties|o.p_halloween_r7: Seek an audience with the Punkin King.
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r9: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_4a: Uh, I think these sprites are studying these old books. I didn't even know they could read\! \n\nAnyway, I'll stay here and protect these sprites. I see more empty transport crates; not good. You go on ahead and clear the area of hostiles so that a rescue squad can arrive safely.
conversation.properties|m.rc_greet2_1a: Greetings, I'm Squad Leader Greta.  You must be {0}. Rhendon said we should be expecting you, and not a moment too soon.  This Rescue Camp is facing a crisis.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_3a: That's exactly right\! The Core of the Clockworks could very well contain the energy source we need to create a new power source for the Skylark and restore it to operational condition. There's only one problem- the Clockworks themselves seem to be built like some kind of crazy death trap. \n\nReaching the Core is not going to be easy...
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_4a: Vatel here will sell you a selection of recipes as well as personal color changers and other items.
mission.properties|r.eye_of_needle_4a: I take it the only way to the Core is through the Firestorm Citadel?
helptips.properties|m.atg_eblocks: EXPLOSIVE BLOCKS will cause damage to anything around them if hit.
conversation.properties|m.casino_yesman_: I'm sorry, you missed Happy Hour by a minute. Next time.
conversation.properties|m.ritual_4a: Well, that was unexpected. I'll get it right next time\!
mission.properties|r.apocrea_1_4a: I won't let them take me so easily.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_f: I keep a sword around for close encounters.
guild.properties|log.member_added: Accepted {0}'s invitation to join the guild. Welcome\!
item.properties|f.ironwood: A pristine log of one of the hardest substances known to the Spiral Knights.
item.properties|f.furni_spiralorder_sund: Supply canisters containing everything a Spiral Knight needs to get going in the morning.
logon.properties|m.temp_banned: This account has been temporarily suspended.
item.properties|f.teddy_bear_buckler: A high-tech energy shield disguised as a harmless teddy bear. The perfect companion to defend against minions of the night.
item.properties|f.spiral_brigandine: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_3b: Thanks for the info tall guy, see you around town.
item.properties|f.sacred_guerrilla_helm: A helm for those who want to bring down some beasts.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_1a: Well met, {0}. I'm Lieutenant Barrus, Warden of the Hall of Heroes. \n\nYou are here because Spiral HQ has marked you as having potential to become a Vanguard of the Spiral Knights.  The Hall of Heroes is now at your disposal.  As you move up in rank, you will receive new missions to visit and have access to more recipes from the veteran knights in this hall.
conversation.properties|m.npc_captainkni: Don't forget to prime your bomb\!
item.properties|f.acheron: Striking with the savage power of the Underworld, this dark weapon has been known to drive weak-minded knights to the brink of madness.
mission.properties|b.p_toxic_plant_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has uncovered a gremlin bioweapons facility deep within the Clockworks. It is believed that this facility belongs to a member of the Crimson Order known only as 'Herex.' The Recon Rangers have been tasked with infiltrating the facility and uncovering the nature of Herex's bioweapons before they are put to use.
mission.properties|m.the_flickering_flam: We were in the middle of receiving a report from Lieutenant Vaelyn's team at the Core Terminal when our signal was disrupted. It took some time, but I've managed to pinpoint the source of the disruption. It's coming from that strange device you discovered near Vanaduke's throne room in Firestorm Citadel.  It seems like someone has activated it.
projectx.properties|m.instance_shutdown: There has been a server error. You will be transferred to another instance.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_weap_5: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
item.properties|f.lite_infantry: Tread lightly or lavish in the limelight, those that follow will benefit from hindsight.
item.properties|f.woven_sentinel_armor: A suit of armor imbued with interwoven wolver hair to protect against even the harshest elements.
item.properties|f.captain_coat: A seaworthy greatcoat outstanding for spaceage swordplay.
mission.properties|o.p_apocrea_r4: Investigate the area of the Clockworks where several knights have gone missing.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
mission.properties|m.new_threat_9a: You cannot stop what you cannot see.
conversation.properties|r.fc_court_4_acc: Free 6 Lost Sprites? I can do that\!
mission.properties|b.alchemy_beginners: Alchemy is a craft mastered by the Spiral Knights that allows for the inherent powers of various materials to awaken and fuse with each other in order to form powerful, new items\!  The Spiral Order has relied on alchemy as their primary means of creating the very arsenals that Knights have relied upon for centuries. \n\nDiscover how it will become an important part of your survival on this alien world.
sprites.properties|d.shadow_cloak: Grants you partial invisibility and a defensive boost for a limited time. Shadow Cloak is cancelled if you take damage, attack, or perform any other action.
helptips.properties|m.tut_treasure: Treasure blocks are always a lucky find\! They contain coins and useful items.
item.properties|f.stellar_sentinel_helm: This helm was was once worn by Isoran starfarers of eons long passed that stood watch over extrasolar operations. With this equipped, you feel like you understand the machinations of the universe.
mission.properties|m.silent_legion_recon:
I am drawn to this place. 

In the eyes of these silent warriors I see myself\: cold, strong, unflinching... and crumbling. I have been asked to let it go, to move on, but this I cannot do. 

Their faces, their dying cries... they haunted me in my dreams, so I no longer sleep.  Now I see them when I close my eyes, so I shall not blink. 

I will remain here, among the stones... never blinking, never forgetting.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_7a: Brinks is the Token Trader, issuing certain items to Knights in exchange for tokens that can be collected within the Clockworks.  Tokens can be found in treasure blocks, issued as mission rewards or found when defeating special boss monsters.
item.properties|f.ironmight_plate_shield: A superior shield forged from sun silver. The meaning of the crest on its face has been lost to time.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro3_2a:
I've established a comlink with Knights that have formed a Rescue Camp up ahead.  If you head north, you should eventually reach it. 

I'm going to stay here for now and locate any other Knights that have crashed in the area.  I'll meet you at the Rescue Camp before sunset. 

And should you encounter anything really dangerous, press [[?DEFEND]] to use your shield\!
item.properties|f.graviton_bomb: Capable of dragging enemies toward its location before exploding, this bomb utilizes technology that the Spiral Order does not fully understand.
mission.properties|m.alone_in_dark_1a:
(You see the lost soul of Almire standing before you.  In his face you see a profound sadness.  Staring beyond you he begins to speak without introduction.) 

Lord Vanaduke brought the fire from the mountains to our kingdom.  Everything burned.  His enemies.  Even his family. 

My family was lost too.  I fled the battle as soon as I saw the wave of flames in the distance.  I was able to reach my home just in time to see it burn.  I don't even remember how it ended.  I have no memory of my passing.
item.properties|f.arc_razor: A finely-crafted mechanical sword that flings sharp bolts of energy outward when swung.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_gate_gremlin: Steal the gremlin schematics from the gremlin construction site\!
mission.properties|r.honor_duty_2a: I hope her findings produce something meaningful.
conversation.properties|m.imposto_death: Abort Mission\! I'm retreating back to Haven\! Glorp\!
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_1a: What's this? You still have your body. Perhaps you can help us.
sprites.properties|d.angelic_aura: Creates protective aura around you that also protects any party members within it.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_1_1: Well met, {0}\! Glad to see Spiral HQ sent us some reinforcements, and not a moment too soon\! Our backs are against the wall and we need your help\!
mission.properties|m.anniversary_start_1: {0}\! Am I glad to see you\!  Things are getting pretty bad down here.
mission.properties|r.explosive_plot_4a: Roger that Kora, I'm on my way\!
item.properties|f.raider_buckler: A light wooden shield that blocks basic attacks and allows a countering swift strike.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: I'm not sure, tell me again about the battle sprites.
conversation.properties|m.rc_instruct_3b: A "gate" is an entry point into the Clockworks. They take the form of the lifts you see before you. Each gate has a display monitor showing the gate's unique icon as well as a control panel that allows the user to enter the gate. This gate here will always take you to the same place, but other gates have shifting floors beneath them. In those, you never quite know what's next\!
item.properties|f.wolver_coat: A thick garment to protect your hide, made from a Wolver who failed to protect his.
mission.properties|f.p_tip: Prestige Badges are displayed next to your knight name.  They are automatically awarded when enough prestige is acquired.
chat.properties|m.unspecific_flag: Flag not specific enough, did you mean "{0}?"
uplink.properties|m.generic_change: Something changed and we had to change things. Please accept this attachment as a replacement. Sorry for the inconvenience.
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_bone_bon: Some people would call using a jumbled pile of bones as a decorative item "daring". Everyone else? "Creepy".
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_short_or: A short, elegant street lamp that emits an orange glow with a gentle hiss.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_5a: Hey, {0}\! I see you've acquired a Proto Bomb\! They're very useful for when you need to deal with groups of enemies.
item.properties|f.dark_thorn_blade: A savage sword whose strength has been fortified by an offering of souls to the beast within.
item.properties|f.monster_bone: An intact bone from a now-deceased beast.
conversation.properties|m.rc_greet2_3a:
Our scans have located an ancient generator below this camp.  It should be sending power to the surface, but something seems to be diverting it. 

We need you to go investigate the ancient generator and divert power back to the surface.  But you'll need to be ready- it's completely uncharted territory and teeming with monsters. 

Rhendon said he wanted to meet up with you before you take on this mission.  Why don't you see him first?
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_fiend: Free the captured Knights from a fiendish corporate prison\!
item.properties|f.hexoskeleton: Protects the thorax, abdomen, and legs. No molting necessary.
item.properties|f.tempered_calibur: A Calibur reforged and tempered by the most advanced techniques available to weaponsmiths of the Spiral Order.
helptips.properties|m.graveyard: Graveyards are an unnatural place, a world between worlds where dark spirits gather, hungry for the life of any live soul that must pass through.  You must hurry and find the exit as fast as possible before these phantoms awaken and stalk you\!
item.properties|f.mega_magnus: An upgraded Magnus powerful enough to take a monster's head clean off. A charged shot can even pierce through multiple enemies.
support.properties|m.option_202_0: We realize this player may be ruining some of the fun you're having, but the best way to deal with such annoying players is to ignore them so you don't have to bother with them again. Click here to ignore {0} instead.
chat.properties|m.usage_level_up: Usage\: /{0} (weapon armor helmet shield) [crystals]\nAttempts to level up the specified equipment using fire crystals.
mission.properties|o.rescues_and_recycli: Shut down the gremlin deconstruction site and rescue the captive knights
item.properties|f.feral_kat_hood: A primitive looking hood made to resemble a wild beast.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_mat_345: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
support.properties|m.option_210_1: If you're sure the other options didn't cover your complaint, and you're sure the player broke our Terms of Service, then please enter a short explanation here for what your complaint is.
mission.properties|m.true_champion_3a: You can always count on me\! \n\nNow then, I'm sure you've got lots to do.  We're going crazy over here trying to make heads or tails over that recon module you discovered outside of the Core.  How the heck could the Alpha Squad have 'entered' the Core?
mission.properties|b.reporting_duty: Lieutenant Feron is responsible for overseeing the Clockworks mining operation in the Haven Arcade.  Report to him and learn about the situation in Haven and Spiral HQ's mission to reach the Core of Cradle.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_nature_sprit: A spirit of Nature willing to wander rather than follow the guide of the Spirit Mother.
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r3: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
item.properties|f.scythe: An old farmers tool, retired for the season, this blade also excels at reaping your foes.
exchange.properties|m.offertobuy_tooltip: Enter the amount of energy you want to buy, in multiples of 100.
item.properties|m.sprite_material_and_fo: Can be fed to Battle Sprites or used to craft Battle Sprite food.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_experimen: Certain types of monsters seem to be attracted to different combinations of minerals found down here in the Clockworks.
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_5a: Handy, I'll keep it in mind.  What else you got?
item.properties|f.firotech_alchemer_mkii: An upgraded Alchemer that fires bolts of napalm at an increased rate.
item.properties|f.gel_core: A fist-sized, gelatinous lump collected from a jelly.
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_cloak: A crudely crafted cloak made to resemble a temperamental warrior of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_3a: Gremlins are a race of creatures who are incredibly adept at creating and dismantling all manners of machinery. They are at once a legion of brilliant artificers and a force of powerful destruction.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Trojan \nThese massive leviathans are invulnerable from the front. Hit the crystal on their back to bring them to their knees.
item.properties|f.grey_feather_mantle: A cloak for renowned Owlite scholars, this feathery frock is filled with the wisdom of the ages... and is super soft\!
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_housepla: A sunny saffron plant inside a cheerful pot.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_crystal: Crystal blocks are like breakable blocks except that if destroyed, they also destroy the crystal blocks of the same color connected to them.
item.properties|f.catalyzer: An advanced alchemical armament adapted from Gremlin mining and demolition devices. Catalyzer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
dungeon.properties|m.golden_slime_prize: Each spin of the wheel rewards you with a random prize, sometimes including very special items\! Requires one Golden Slime Coin or crowns if none are available.
mission.properties|b.sewer_stash: It seems that the Ironclaw Munitions Factory is not the only place gremlins are storing high-powered weaponry.  Intel suggests that once manufactured, weapons are moved out of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory and stored in secret weapon caches throughout the Clockworks. \n\nOne of these caches has been uncovered in one of the Clockwork's wasteworks systems.  It's likely not going to be pretty reaching it, but eliminating the weapons stored in these wasteworks could result in far fewer casualties in the future.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_mat_2: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
pvp.properties|m.no_guild: You are not a member of a guild.
logon.properties|m.peer_shutdown: The peer to which we connected is shutting down. Please wait a moment before trying again.
exchange.properties|m.offertobuy_tooltip: Submit your offer to the market. If a seller is found while you are online, you will receive a chat notification.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_99c5a1: Travel the entire Clockworks from depth 0 to depth 29 in a single expedition without having to revive.
exchange.properties|m.could_not_fill: Unable to fill order as submitted, please check updated price and try again.
mission.properties|r.laboratory_visit_5a: Leave it to me, Morlin. I'll secure those sprites.
item.properties|f.gh_theme_spooky: A dark and foreboding theme perfect for a Guild Hall whose members are among the recently departed.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_weap_3: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
conversation.properties|m.tortodrone_hav: Spiral HQ has us investigating reports that pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter are appearing all over the Clockworks. Kora believes the Fiends are up to something. There is evidence they played a hand in the disappearance of the tortodrones.
item.properties|f.furni_chair_spiralfiel: One standard-issue Spiral Order seating unit, capable of providing standard-issue comfort for one Spiral Knight.
item.properties|f.vial_sleep: A glass vial containing a drowsy draught. It can be used to inflict enemies with Sleep.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and your foes will be snoring in seconds\!
guild.properties|m.removing_features: Removing this expansion will lower upkeep but will also remove any installed rooms or doors in the expansion. Any furnishings in the expansion will be returned to the Guild Treasury.\n\nAdditionally you will lose the following features\: {0}
item.properties|f.red_shard: A shard of Crimsonite that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
dungeon.properties|m.no_revive: Your revive effort is no longer necessary.
mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_3a: Let's put it to good use right away. \n\nYou can accept Missions by clicking the 'Mission' button at the top of the screen and accept the mission I've given you.
projectx.properties|x.rename_desc2: On success, you will be briefly disconnected.
mission.properties|m.intro_arcade: Arcade Missions allow you to explore the ever-changing Clockworks without specific objectives. Visit the Haven Arcade to discover how you can transform the Clockworks to suit your needs\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_raiders: Contains one of various unique items and accessories for raiders. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
projectx.properties|e.name_invalid_chara: Sorry, that name contains an invalid character.
item.properties|f.supply_deluxe_compact: A package of useful supplies valued by Spiral Knight research teams working deep within the Clockworks.  This deluxe pack has enough supplies to last an entire squad of Knights one week.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: Congratulations, {0}\! You have become bonded with your battle sprite\! It will no doubt be an invaluable companion to you in your missions ahead. \n\nIf you have any further questions about raising your new battle sprite, be sure to speak to me or Biscotti here in the Lab.
social.properties|m.autofriend_single_to: Your {0} friend {1} just started playing Spiral Knights as {2}\! You already have the maximum number of friends, so you were unable to be auto-friended.
item.properties|f.gremlin_suit: A special suit tailored by a gremlin's touch to fit the frame of a knight. It protects the wearer while providing a full range of motion for thwacking, knocking, or mending.
conversation.properties|r.rc_bomb_1a: Sounds like a blast\! Maybe I'll buy some from the traveling merchant.
help.properties|m.monster_beast: Deal PIERCING - Weak to PIERCING - Strong against ELEMENTAL
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_12a: No problem, I've got the time.  Let's head back to Punch and Vise.
conversation.properties|m.seerus_defeate: I would rather it all burn than give the Arsenal up to anyone else\!
item.properties|f.fiery_diskgun: A handgun powered by an infernal engine that launches molten disks in rapid succession. Diskgun shots return once reaching their apogee.
item.properties|f.harlequin_suit: A costume for those who juggle, tumble, or have the gift of mischief.
uplink.properties|m.newsletter: Subscribe now and get a free Proto Crest accessory\!
item.properties|f.gm_helmet: An impressive indigo helmet that's the indisputable indication of one of the Spiral Order's incredible Game Masters.
projectx.properties|m.name_in_use: Sorry, that name is already in use.
support.properties|m.subheader_step2_ema: We have saved the offending email already waiting to be added to the complaint, so there is no need to hurry from here. Please carefully choose the correct option matching what the player did\:
mission.properties|r.apocrea_1_2a: What do you mean? Who are the Apocrea?
mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_4a: Sorry, yes of course.  Good luck to you, {0}.  Assemble the best squad you can and lead them well.  We're all counting on you.
conversation.properties|m.hav_entryknigh: You should get inside the town walls.  It's not safe out here.
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_remin: Once you find a sprite, carry them back to the sacred circle you see before you. They are no doubt weakened from Vanaduke's curse and will require rejuvenation. Once we are all reunited we will form a focus link with the Spirit Mother and bring water to the wells.\n\nPlease hurry\!
prologue.properties|m.ozlo_arrive: At last. Begin preparations for descent. We must harness this power...
item.properties|f.garden_snipes_room: A peaceful garden home to a number of Snipes. Perfect for both relaxing and spinning wildly in place.
mission.properties|b.p_fiend_test_t1: Please refer to the posted instructions when testing this content.
helptips.properties|m.atg_healthcap: Use HEALTH CAPSULES from your quickslot bar to heal.
mission.properties|b.shopping_again: Bechamel has already given you a tour of the Haven Bazaar that included where to acquire new weapons, armor and recipes.  Now it's time to pay him another visit and learn about some of the more advanced services the Bazaar offers. \n\nYou will pay a visit to Punch and Vise, Brinks and even visit Bechamel's own shop\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_a: I just need to rest a bit before moving on.
item.properties|f.flame_soul: A powerful essence left behind when a creature perishes during a blind, fiery rage.
item.properties|f.simple_orb: A rare, encapsulated element used in alchemical transmutation. While unrefined, this orb can be used to craft more powerful items.
item.properties|f.ice_axe: A technical climbing tool that can pick apart monsters with precision.
item.properties|f.mighty_great_cleaver: A custom made Sudaruska designed by Biscotti, head chef of the Skylark. Though she swears it's used just for cooking, one can't help but think more than a few monsters have met it at the chopping block as well.
helptips.properties|m.tut_explosive: Explosive blocks will harm anything around them when they are set off. This includes you\! Take them out from a safe distance with your handgun.
item.properties|f.spiral_cuirass: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
helptips.properties|m.lock_howto:
* There are multiple Control Points scattered around the map 
* Capturing and holding a Control Point increases your team's score over time 
* To capture a Control Point, stand on it until it changes to your team's color 
* The team with the highest score at the end of the match WINS\!
item.properties|f.volcanic_salamander_ma: A Salamander Mask reinforced with volcanic iron. In the field it can be used as a makeshift coffee pot, so long as you don't mind coffee that tastes a little like lizard.
item.properties|f.fowl_cowl: A beaked mask shrouded in a simple hood. Take on the guise of your feathered friends and celebrate the new year.
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_2c: Are there any friendly gremlins within the Clockworks?
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_4: We've doubled the amount of patrols around Haven in case there is another attack, but I have a feeling that those gremlins already got what they came for...
item.properties|f.polar_night_warden_coa: An insulated coat that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The fur-lined armor plating makes it ideal for hours of nighttime watch duty.
social.properties|m.autofriend_multiple_: You have {0} friends that play Spiral Knights\! {1}
mission.properties|b.work_idle_hands:
Devilites are a type of fiend that seem to have a very rigid corporate structure that governs their every action.  Recon Knights have discovered a series of devilite 'offices' throughout the Clockworks, typically found in the remains of an alien city. 

Analysis of the data collected from these offices indicates that devilite corporations are outsourced by gremlins in order to design and manage various projects that include weapons specifically engineered to target Spiral Knight squads. 

It's time these devilites were issued pink slips and their fiendish projects cancelled.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research: By now you have likely collected a few material samples from your early expeditions into the Clockworks.  Spiral HQ is requesting some of those materials for their ongoing research of the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.sorcerer_robe: A fine robe known to be worn by powerful sorcerers, and this one guy Bob.
mission.properties|r.heart_of_matter_1a: Hello, Lieutenant.  How can I help you?
helptips.properties|m.tg_heat_short: Collect heat to level up your gear\!
item.properties|f.virulisk_suit: A thick set of gear crafted from the carcass of a Virulisk. Wearers will inherit some of the Virulisk's poison resistance, as well as its taste for flan.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_12: I admire your courage but if initial reports of this construct monster are accurate, you'll need some additional help. I'll prepare a selection of battle sprites to be ready for bonding to you, {0}. We'll talk again once I've made the proper preparations.
item.properties|f.ironmight_plate_helm: A superior plate helmet forged from an alloy of several rare metals. It'll restrict your peripheral vision a bit, but it's virtually impregnable.
item.properties|f.thunderball: An orb of pure electricity that is typically found at the bottom of the sea of all places.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_b_1a: Whew, I'm glad you came along when you did. Those pesky gremlins were going to wreck everything\! The bazaar would have been ruined\!\n\nOh right, where are my manners? My name is Tylen, it's a pleasure to meet you, {0}.
item.properties|f.furni_chest_spiralfoot: A sealed locker filled with important Spiral Order equipment, like socks.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_7a: Punch and Vise are gremlin smiths that can change the properties of your weapons and gear.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: Thank you, Morlin. I will do my best to raise this sprite well.
conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_3: That's exactly right\! The Core of the Clockworks could very well contain the energy source we need to create a new power source for the Skylark and restore it to operational condition. There's only one problem- the Clockworks themselves seem to be built like some kind of crazy death trap.\n\nReaching the Core is not going to be easy...
mission.properties|b.p_apocrea_r9: Several capable knights have gone missing in a seemingly normal area of the Clockwork Tunnels. Spiral HQ suspects foul play and has assigned you to investigate the level.
conversation.properties|r.ritual_2c: No thanks, I'll hang on to this book for now.
mission.properties|m.intro_reward_rank: Select a mission card to receive a mission briefing, see the available rewards and enable options for starting the mission\!
exchange.properties|m.paypal_tooltip: Checkout with PayPal in your browser.
conversation.properties|m.casino_royalje: I just flew in from Moorcroft and boy are my royal cores drained.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_1a: Alright, {0}, let's get started. Looks like you and I get to go on a little sprite hunt, eh? \n\nI've aligned my tracker with the recon knight intel but something's not right. The energy signature I'm detecting is erratic, but still definitely a battle sprite. They may be in trouble, so let's hurry\!
chat.properties|m.usage_grant_reward: Usage\: /{0} <account name> <reward id> [reward param string]\nGrants a reward to the identified account.
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_8: This gremlin comes from the colony of Emberlight, deep within the Clockworks. They're a group of outcasts that have defied King Tinkinzar and the Crimson Order. We're hoping we can make a treaty with them that will allow us to use their colony as a base of operations for our missions deeper underground.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_13: Here we have Bechamel the Accessorizor, who can add accessories to your gear so long as you have a ticket.  With accessories, you can make your gear really stand out in a crowd, I highly suggest giving it a try.  You'll soon become the apple of every one's eye\!
item.properties|f.ash_agni: When this bomb has left the battlefield in ashes, then, and only then, will your enemies have permission to die.
item.properties|f.hazardous_oni_helm: A helm worn by members of the Scarlet Scouts. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of a fiend who lives in the mountains of a distant land. Said to guard the gate to heaven itself, it only allows those who are worthy to pass.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_snar: A small Snarbolax statuette, showing the savage shadow in a stunned state.
item.properties|m.forge_max_in_flight: Waiting for previous forges to finish...
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_9a: Yes I know. Anyway I also understand that some of the sprite transport crates were empty again. Something is not right... \n\nNow then, secure that last cache of sprites before whatever is stealing sprites finds it\!
mission.properties|m.new_threat_12a: Hmm, most of our sensor equipment seems to have been damaged.  It might take some time to get things working to the point where I can track down the Artifact.  While we work on that, you should get in contact with one of our Biotechs, Hahn.  He's a little rough around the edges, but he can help you prepare for the challenges you'll likely face. \n\nI'll contact you later as soon as I have my tracking equipment back online\!
conversation.properties|m.hunter_4a: That's the spirit\! Give those monsters what for\!
mission.properties|m.prestigious_opportu: Greetings {0}, and congratulations on becoming a Squire\!  Your performance has caught the attention of Spiral HQ and they have given you authorization to now take on Prestige Missions. \n\nPrestige Missions are select missions offered to you daily that offer prestige as rewards for completion.  Sometimes these missions require supplying Spiral HQ or other Knights with items and other times they will have you exploring the Clockworks.
exchange.properties|m.preview_purchasing: Purchasing is disabled on this server.  Please use the normal Spiral Knights client to purchase energy.
item.properties|f.sacred_hazard_armor: A sturdy suit of armor for those who want to shoot some slimes.
item.properties|f.exp_east_2f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
mission.properties|r.advanced_alchemy_2a: Wow, sounds like I have a lot to learn\!
projectx.properties|m.head_north_arcade: Head North to the Arcade and report to Feron.
conversation.properties|m.rc_virgil_3a: It seems to lead to some kind of elevator, but with no power, the whole thing is just dead.
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_d: This is my first expedition into the Clockworks\!
item.properties|f.angelic_helmet: A beautiful costume designed exclusively for great heads.
item.properties|f.bottomless_stocking: An interdimensional tear in this fuzzy fabric sock swallows any item placed within it.  It even swallowed the stitches.
item.properties|f.prize_box_vile: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Vile style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_7a: Indeed.  Though their cellular identity is still wholly that of a battle sprite.  My hypothesis is that somehow they rapidly evolved to survive in their new environment, but how?  Our technology could never do something like that...
item.properties|f.blackhawk: A shadow-aligned handgun of incredible power, it's said to contain the soul of a knight who was only two days from retirement.
item.properties|f.heavy_demo_suit: Reinforced armor intended for explosive experts.
mission.properties|r.the_flickering_flam: That gremlin Herex must be involved.
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_short_bl: A short, elegant street lamp that emits a blue glow with a gentle hiss.
mission.properties|m.expansion_purchase_:
By purchasing an Expansion, you will unlock the missions included in the Expansion to play as often as you like. 

Unlocking an Expansion unlocks it for all knights on the account. 

Only players who have unlocked an Expansion Mission may join an Expansion Mission. 

Expansion Mission rewards cannot be sold, dropped or traded.
mission.properties|b.ancient_generator: The Rescue Camp has no power and with it, no means of defending itself from the onslaught of monsters that attack it in the night.  With the sun setting fast, it's up to you to enter the dark depths below the camp and locate an Ancient Generator. \n\nIf you can restore power to the camp, the Spiral Knights can power their turrets and create a defensive perimeter. Once secure, it may be possible to reconnect with Spiral HQ.
exchange.properties|i.mini_buy: Instantly buy energy with crowns at the energy exchange.
conversation.properties|r.core_lead_4: But I thought there was no way inside it?
projectx.properties|m.bug_message: Please enter a brief description of the bug.  \nPlease note that bug reports are not answered by GMs.  \nIf you also need assistance from a GM, please file an in-game support request.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_fiend: Free the captured Knights from a fiendish corporate prison\!
item.properties|f.book_of_dark_rituals: An ancient grimoire filled with unspeakable eldritch rites. Just like any cursed tome, there is likely some twisted individual out there who wants it for extremely nefarious purposes. Trade with caution.
item.properties|f.gremlonium: A highly advanced compound created by gremlin engineers to power their most devious machines.  It constantly emits an unsettling hissing sound.
item.properties|f.obsidian_crusher: A peculiar bomb made from the obsidian obelisks found within the realm of the Apocrea. Despite it being a bomb, some are drawn to holding it and 'solving' it as if it were some kind of puzzle.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_shock: Check on Groat the Gremlin Chef.
dungeon.properties|m.concrete_jungle_des: This long forgotten city was reclaimed by nature and then by the legions of the undead. Now it is a vile nest of malady, home to all manners of toxic monsters, living and otherwise.
mission.properties|o.p_tortodrone_r7: Investigate the Ancient Grove and put a stop to a Fiendish plot.
item.properties|f.winter_grave: A tremendously powerful hand cannon whose moniker should come as no surprise to anyone who happens to be viewing it from the wrong end. A charged shot can even plow through multiple enemies.
auction.properties|m.search_ready: Press 'Search' to execute your current search query.
chat.properties|m.usage_helpme: Usage\: /{0}\nTell your comrades that you need help\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_3a: Once again the sprites have changed and this time they're really creeping me out\!
projectx.properties|e.need_higher_rank: Must be Rank {0} to level up\!
mission.properties|b.target_acquired: After analyzing the schematics you recovered from the gremlin test lab, Spiral HQ now knows the nature of Project R as well as its location within a gremlin munitions facility.  Spiral HQ is requesting that you enter this facility and destroy Project R before it can be used on Haven.  Speak with Intel Agent Kora for full details.
item.properties|f.caladbolg: A formidable greatsword of lore, its blows cleave the battlefield like a rainbow crosses the sky.
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_2a: I'll be sure to say hello when I see a Stranger.
mission.properties|b.honor_duty: Lieutenant Feron would like a brief word with you regarding your achievement in breaking through the Firestorm Citadel.
item.properties|f.wolver_mask: A simple mask made from wolver pelt.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_g: Preparation is your best tool for survival in the Clockworks.
mission.properties|b.advanced_alchemy: Now that you have achieved the rank of Soldier, Bosco in the Haven Bazaar has some new information for you regarding advanced forms of alchemy.  Pay him a visit and learn about the hidden potential in some weapons and gear\!
mission.properties|r.elemental_my_dear_3: I think I've got it thanks for-
mission.properties|m.advanced_alchemy_2a: Basically it comes down to 'branching.'  You see, most of the alchemy you have likely seen up to this point follows a linear evolution path.  It simply improves over time and each upgrade is better than the last. \n\nBut not all items are like that.  Many of them can become multiple, completely different types of items than their original\!
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_short_pu: A short, elegant street lamp that emits a purple glow with a gentle hiss.
mission.properties|r.shadow_knows_2a: Yes, I see that we're already back to-
item.properties|f.supernova: The destruction left in the wake of this peerless pistol is anything but nebulous. Supernova shots become more powerful the further they travel.
item.properties|f.kat_claw_raiment: A reclaimed raiment said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Scraith, first to scale the walls of the Owlite High Academy of Magicks.
mission.properties|m.darkest_forces_3a: Exactly, and they're worse now.  And the same goes for the undead.  You'll find that howlitzers become particularly bothersome with their enhanced firing and homing capabilities. \n\nLastly, prepare for fiend and undead monsters to potentially deal pure shadow damage.  As always, choose the right gear for the job should you want to live long enough to hear from me again.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_stri: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
item.properties|f.storm_dragon_helm: An enchanted helm crafted into the visage of a beast who some believe created the world in its passing\: its fire the sun, its bones the mountains.
projectx.properties|m.mission_rjp: Recover the recon module in the Royal Jelly Palace.
mission.properties|o.alchemy_beginners: Learn about the wonders of alchemy\!
mission.properties|r.rc_buddyknight_2a: Thanks Rhendon, this will come in handy\!
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Euclid volunteered to help The Sleeper. I'm sure he's in here somewhere battling The Swarm even as we speak. As for Rulen...Vaelyn I'm sorry. He disappeared shortly after Euclid made his decision. I haven't been able to find him ever since.
item.properties|f.sacred_shade_helm: A helm built to outlast whatever might slink from the shadows.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_construct: Destroy the operational war machines within the ruined factory\!
helptips.properties|m.tut_hearts: Break these blocks to receive hearts. Hearts restore your health. You cannot pick them up unless you need them.
mission.properties|r.new_chapter_3a: Thanks Kora, I'll do my best\!
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest2_r6: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.spiral_scale_helm: A light mail helm that slightly shields oneself from piercing strikes.
conversation.properties|m.core_lead_1: Hail.  I am Lieutenant Vaelyn, commanding officer of on-site Core research.  You are clearly amongst the strongest of the Spiral Knights to reach these infernal depths, but strength alone will get you no further.
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight5_1a: {0}, have you seen these minerals in your travels yet?  They're fascinating\! You should ask Chief Geo Knight Wegner about them.  I hear he's the expert on minerals\!
chat.properties|m.usage_hoh: Go to the Hall of Heroes
item.properties|f.meteor_mote: A small piece of a rare material that is said to have fallen from the sky. Gremlins typically use it in the construction of power sources.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_1: No problem, from the top then...
board.properties|i.playsolo: Create a party in which other players can only join if you invite them.
helptips.properties|m.loading2: Armor and helms not only offer physical defense, but can also protect you from status conditions. The right combination will greatly increase your chance of survival.
item.properties|f.virulisk_mask: A mask crafted from the hide of a Virulisk.
item.properties|f.critter_carapace: A chitinous chunk carefully shucked from a Clockworks creature. It's in surprisingly good shape.
item.properties|f.crimsonite_deposit_2: A good-sized mineral deposit that will generate several units of crimsonite.
mission.properties|r.heart_of_matter_2a: I've prepared for facing the Firestorm Citadel, you can count on me.
chat.properties|m.usage_action: Usage\: /{0} command argument\nPosts an action to the scene controller.
item.properties|f.chroma_suit: A suit crafted from the hide of a chromalisk. Surprisingly, chromalisks seem to find the existence of these armors flattering.
item.properties|f.static_diskgun: A shockingly powerful handgun that creates a storm of electrified disks. Diskgun shots return once reaching their apogee.
item.properties|f.maidens_tear: A sacred jewel cherished by Almirian knights.  Given to them by their beloved, it is said to keep them safe in battle.
item.properties|f.furious_fork: A good chef knows when to flip burgers. A great chef cooks burgers while they flip them.
chat.properties|m.emote_self: You can't do that to yourself.
item.properties|f.volcanic_plated_shade_: A helm of fire retardant fabric interlaced with dark matter to conceal its wearer while they hide in heated hallways.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_4a:
Re\: Re\: Re\: Resource allocation request, Amu-Sol 

I've contacted Internal Affairs regarding the recent theft of an everfrost pillar and the 'disappearance' of nearly 1,000 devilite data entry associates, as I believe it to be directly related to your recently denied resource allocation request. 

Disciplinary action will be required.  Additionally, please fill out the attached Personal Improvement Plan and return it as soon as possible.
item.properties|f.master_blast_bomb: An incredibly powerful explosive typically used in mining, now issued somewhat recklessly for use in combat.
item.properties|f.spine_cone: A ferocious device that is positively bursting with briars.
guild.properties|log.crowns_added: Added {0} crowns to the guild treasury.
dungeon.properties|p.join_leave_party: Leave your current party to join {0}?
sprites.properties|d.flame_barrier: Surround yourself with a barrier of flames that enhances your defenses while burning nearby targets.
support.properties|m.delete_mail: Deleted mail from knightId\:{0} with subject "{1}".
item.properties|f.shadow_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who gain their powers using forbidden, dark arts.
chat.properties|m.usage_revoke_gift: Usage\: /{0} <account name> name attr value attr value...\nRevokes a gift from the identified account.
item.properties|f.token_page: A crumbling page torn from a long-forgotten grimoire of the Moorcroft Manor archives. The indecipherable language written upon it glows faintly in the dark as if containing power in its very words.
item.properties|f.love_puppy_mask_foreve: A special mask that proves that a love puppy's love lasts forever and ever. Some would argue they're just programmed that way, others would say 'to heck with you, Science.'
item.properties|f.prize_box_almire_furni: Contains various unique Almire-themed furnishings. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_4_2: With the Biotechs' help, I should be on the mend and fit for duty again in no time.  {0}, I can't stress enough how important this victory is for all Spiral Knights.  You've helped us deal a mighty blow to the Crimson Order by destroying their Grand Arsenal. \n\nThanks to you, gremlin forces will not have any more of these massive war machines for some time. And with our Technicians studying what is available in Seerus's personal quarters we may end up gaining valuable insights into gremlin technology or even the location of the rest of the Crimson Order\!
prologue.properties|m.preface3: What we discovered was beyond imagination. We discovered Cradle.
item.properties|f.blazebreak_shield: A reliable shield that'll keep you from getting too fired up in battle.
guild.properties|m.environment_change_wa: You are paying to install this environment. If for any reason it is removed you will have to pay to install it again.
projectx.properties|m.suggestion_submit_: Suggestion submitted. Thanks for your feedback.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_4a: Hey, it looks like one of the sprites has taken a liking to you\! Well, let's not let that extra power go to waste, I'll stay here and protect these sprites. You use your new friend to help clear the rest of the area of hostiles.
item.properties|f.voltedge: Combining Spiral capacitor technology with samples recovered from the Ironclaw Munitions Factory produced this blade, which can output a particularly hazardous 1.21 gigawatt discharge.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_4: Sprites have a set appetite that limits the amount of materials they can eat at any one given time. When you feed a material to your sprite, its appetite will deplete. Once fully depleted, you will be unable to feed it.
item.properties|f.mechaknight_helm: A hardy helm handcrafted by Gremlin smiths to protect a Mecha Knight's control unit. With the control unit removed it fits a knight remarkably well.
item.properties|f.guild_members_200: Allows your guild to recruit up to 200 members\!
item.properties|f.magnus: A large handgun with hard hitting rounds that can leave even the strongest of monsters dazed. A charged shot can even pierce through multiple enemies.
helptips.properties|m.atg_torto: Tortodrones can be found patrolling the Clockworks.  They will not attack unless attacked first - but be warned, once they are enraged, they are fearsome and deadly opponents.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_pier: Hi there {0}, I'm Walkon, a knight who utilizes gear that offers high piercing damage defense.  The recipes I have for you produce armor and shields that protect you from the piercing attacks of slimes and beasts. \n\nOne of the best parts about choosing piercing defense is that the armor is often made of soft, squishy jelly materials.  You could just about fall asleep in it\!
mission.properties|o.rotting_metropolis: Discover the fate of the lost squad in the toxic city
item.properties|d.energy_well: USE\: An energy bank for use by guild members.
guild.properties|m.confirm_leave: Are you sure you no longer want to be a member of {0}?
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_4: Then you are brave as well traveler. You can find my kinsfolk throughout the whole of this court. Be very careful though, for Vanaduke's terrible minions are guarding them. Many patrol the main drag, so watch your back as you move about.\n\nOnce you find a sprite, carry them back to the sacred circle you see before you. They are no doubt weakened from Vanaduke's curse and will require rejuvenation. When six others are reunited we will form a focus link with the Spirit Mother and bring water to the wells.
item.properties|f.super_blaster: A supercharged Blaster well-suited to longer expeditions down into the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.arctic_rogue_mask: A mask said to be crafted by an arctic rogue. The shattered ice will conceal your identity during clandestine arctic expeditions.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_4: Welcome back to the Hall of Heroes, {0}.  Please speak to the heroic knights you see before you to gain access to their weapons and gear.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_min: Gather minerals for Chief Geo Knight Wegner's research.
item.properties|f.sacred_hazard_helm: A hardy helm to help those hunting for slimes.
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch: Oh {0}, it's horrible, just horrible\! \n\nA terrifying swarm of black kats came out of some dark portal deep within the Clockworks and have raided the Moorcroft Archives\!
mission.properties|b.vicious_viscous: Spiral HQ would like you to investigate levels of the Clockworks where the most powerful slime and beast monsters reside.  By exploring these levels and transferring your combat data back to Spiral HQ, all knights would ultimately benefit from your dangerous experience. \n\nIt is highly recommended that you equip yourself with piercing resistant gear with piercing and shadow damage weapons\!
item.properties|f.hot_edge: A modified Proto Sword capable of generating temperatures high enough to burn organic material.
item.properties|f.hazardous_grim_mask: A helm worn by members of the Scarlet Scouts. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of Death itself. Those that wear it have a saying, 'Death is at your heels, so keep facing forward.'
conversation.properties|r.biscotti_2: Again, this is really weird Biscotti, but I'll do my best.
conversation.properties|r.ritual_2b: I've got a really bad feeling about this, but ok...
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_3b: Each battle sprite will learn three skills that you can use in combat. Skills are learned automatically at certain levels as the sprite levels up. \n\nCombat skills become stronger with skill points.
helptips.properties|m.activate_grim_gate: The Grim Gate will activate when all living party members are standing on it.
conversation.properties|m.hav_guardian_1: Welcome to Haven, {0}, we've been expecting you.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft1_r9: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_4_3a: Congratulations {0}, you meet the necessary requirements and have received your 5 Star Certification.  Take the elevator behind me in order to complete your mission.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: By now you have likely collected some interesting materials in the first stratum of the Clockworks that would be useful to Spiral HQ.  Help advance their continued research of the mysteries of Cradle by donating materials.
mission.properties|m.shocking_sentient_s: Gaaah\! I need to get out of here\! \n\nEmergency Sneakfield...activate\!
mission.properties|b.crossing_chasm: In order to reach Spiral HQ's base of operations in Haven you will need to descend into the Clockworks and cross a massive chasm.  The journey will be a dangerous one and it is recommended that you have everything you need before departing. \n\nCompleting this mission will leave the Rescue Camp behind you.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_2a: I'm just another soul hiding from the gaze of the Apocrea. But I refuse to give up. Until they find me I will do anything I can to save another soul from my fate.
item.properties|f.deadly_crystal_bomb: A large chunk of Moonstone and Valestone alloy primed with a potent explosive. Studies have shown that this bomb can be used to reduce a zombie's craving for brains by up to 100% by blowing them to pieces.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_4b: Skill points are gained regularly as a sprite levels up. They can be applied to skills within the battle sprite interface. \n\nWhen applying a skill point, you must choose an augment to increase, such as the cooldown rate or overall damage.
conversation.properties|m.mission_lab_by: Our guards were overwhelmed.  We never stood a chance.
helptips.properties|m.atg_retraps: Some switches can reverse the direction of a trap wave. Now you can cross traps in both directions\!
item.properties|f.sulfur: A smelly, stygian, sulfuric shard commonly found in the Underworld.
mission.properties|b.p_apocrea_r6: Several capable knights have gone missing in a seemingly normal area of the Clockwork Tunnels. Spiral HQ suspects foul play and has assigned you to investigate the level.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_773357: Defeat the Roarmulus Twins in the dangerous depths of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.
item.properties|m.use_harness: Use this item to add the {0} as an available harness for your battle sprites? \n\nOnce installed, all sprites capable of using this harness can select it via your sprite manager. This action cannot be undone.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_end: Great job\! With another successful run through the Training Grounds you should be getting the hang of things by now. It won't be long before you are exploring the depths of the Clockworks on your own.
support.properties|m.option_208_1:

item.properties|l.needs_sprite: Requires completion of Rank 2-3 Mission, 'An Eternal Bond' to use this item.
mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_3: These shelters will offer you two choices\: exit the mountain and claim some Grinchlin treasure, or press on further up the mountain. \n\nShould you press on, you pass on the loot in that shelter, but will find even more treasures at the next shelter.
item.properties|f.gold_dragon_armor: Armor once worn by a member of the 'Gold Dragons,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft3_r7: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
item.properties|f.flak_jacket: A lightweight armored jacket that keeps you looking and feeling cool.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Firepower will only get you so far, {0}.  Case in point, the gremlins are no doubt strong on their own, what with just sheer numbers and all, but these little, furry geniuses sought to also bolster their strength by creating an army of constructs.
mission.properties|o.darkest_depths: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
item.properties|f.dangerous_hound_coat: A battle-ravaged coat worn by the squad leaders of the Recon Rangers, nicknamed 'hounds.' The name was likely coined due to their incredible tracking abilities or perhaps the fact that they fight like wild dogs in battle.
item.properties|f.radiant_sun_shards: A solid chunk of solar-charged Luminite with an explosive surprise inside. Devilites hate surprises.
mission.properties|m.the_flickering_flam: Oh, {0}\! As if all these strange occurrences weren't bad enough, I have some shocking news for you.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_c2f28b: Complete a Tier 1 expedition without having to revive.
mission.properties|o.crossing_chasm: Cross the perilous chasm and connect with Spiral HQ in Haven
item.properties|f.the_bitter_end: A shield carried by all members of the Recon Rangers. Its name is a reminder to all Rangers as to precisely when they are permitted to drop it in battle.
item.properties|f.energy_well: After energy is added to the energy well, guild members may withdraw 100 units of energy daily.
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_tall_ora: A tall, elegant street lamp that emits an orange glow with a gentle hiss.
item.properties|f.personal_eye: Once used, this item will permanently change your Knight's eyes to the specified eye shape.
item.properties|f.bolted_blade: An upgraded Proto Sword reinforced with bronze bolts scavenged from the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.wild_buster: A handgun alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. While wielding it, you can feel the fierce energies within just waiting to be unleashed.
item.properties|f.dangerous_grim_mask: A helm worn by members of the Recon Rangers. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of Death itself. Those that wear it have a saying, 'Death always watching, so you might as well put on a good show.'
item.properties|f.token_vanaduke: A seal from the lost kingdom of Almire, proof that the keeper braved the ever-burning abyss known as the Firestorm Citadel.
item.properties|f.misplaced_promissory_n: An old document promising to pay a sum at a date long gone. Grants Normal Defense and increased Defense with decreased health.
item.properties|f.scalding_hot_cocoa: A singeing splash of sweet destruction awaits any foe that goes for this mug before it's had a chance to cool.
mission.properties|m.ending_in_fire_4a: We need you to explore the surrounding levels and collect any intel you can.  You can start with an Owlite castle of some sort that recently surfaced near this anomaly.
dungeon.properties|m.vanaduke_desc: Within the throne room of the citadel Lord Vanaduke stands waiting to mount a final defense against any who manage to breach his citadel's defenses.
social.properties|m.invite_persona: Select the player you wish to invite\:
mission.properties|b.p_r7_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
help.properties|m.support_5: For additional help options, please head to our official Support Page.
item.properties|f.budding_coat: A ripped clean suit can mean death, but fortunately this one was colonized by an unusual symbiotic plant. Wear this and you'll be guaranteed to have a green thumb\!
mission.properties|m.honor_duty_3a:
Aye, as do we all. 

Now then, {0}, you need to prepare for what's to come.  Reaching the Core is only the beginning for us.  I suspect that Spiral HQ will be issuing you many more missions in the future that could only be taken on by someone of your ability. 

And finally, it is my pleasure to inform you that you will soon be awarded one of the greatest honors of the Spiral Knights, the rank of Vanguard.  I will see you in the Hall of Heroes.
item.properties|f.gh_theme_divine: A bright, heavenly theme that will make it really hard to lose your keys.
item.properties|f.power_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.
conversation.properties|m.af_chat_11: Never pay more than 20 bucks for a computer game.
mission.properties|r.explosive_plot_3a: It's because the Strangers took us in that they're now targeted...
item.properties|f.hunters_lodge_room: A monster hunting lodge curated by the great hunter, Armero. Contains a guild alchemy machine containing monster trophy recipes. Guild alchemy machines use resources from the Guild Treasury and deposit results into the Guild Treasury.
item.properties|f.frostbreaker_armor: Armor with a hacked elemental core aimed at resisting freeze. However, this non-standard modification creates other elemental weaknesses.
item.properties|f.rocket_hammer_3: Designed by Warmaster Seerus himself, this nefarious gremlin weapon is equipped with a rocket engine that can launch the wielder forward with a powerful hammer smash.  This final, perfected design is truly befitting the Grand Arsenal of the great Warmaster Seerus.
item.properties|f.corrosive_acid: A caustic substance characteristic of corrosive creatures.

mission.properties|r.advanced_alchemy_3a: Thanks Bosco\!  I'll gather some recipes and get crafting\!
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_keyboard_m: Keyboard used for targeting, attacking, movement, advanced commands,
item.properties|f.prize_box_slumber: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Slumber style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|m.hav_clock_1a: Hello there little one. You look as though you require knowledge of some kind.
