helptips.properties|m.p_dz_schematic_hei: Unauthorized access of our schematics library detected. Security team dispatched. Lockdown commenced.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_mat_3: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|m.elemental_my_dear_3: Magic?  What?  No, I'm talking about a psychic energy manipulation here, try and stay with me.  In any case,  elemental damage is produced by construct and gremlin family monsters.  Additionally, construct monsters tend to be weak to elemental damage themselves and gremlins to shadow damage. Keep this in mind. \n\nNow then, is there anything else you require?
help.properties|m.support_1: You can access your account info, change your password and update your e-mail address on our official website.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_9b: Great, then I will go ahead and give you credit for this mission. \n\nRemember, if you would like to come back for more training, The Advanced Training Hall is located in Haven Town Square.  Take care out there, {0}.
dungeon.properties|m.revive_desc: Use a Spark of Life to regain full health and perform an ENERGY BLAST\!
item.properties|d.furni_lay: USE\: Have a quick lie down.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_mat_4: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.ultra_freeze_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly icy orbs that can freeze hostiles in their tracks
item.properties|f.fiery_pepperbox: When you've been attacked by a swarm of Ice Cubes, all Knights agree\: happiness is a Fiery Pepperbox.
mission.properties|b.in_cold_blood: Something has really riled up the chromalisks in the levels below the town of Emberlight.  Spiral HQ sent a squad in to investigate and they quickly fell off the radar. Now they've sent out a distress signal stating that they're cornered at depth 21 by chromalisks of all varieties. \n\nBiotechs speculate these chromalisks are agitated due to their proximity to the Core. Others believe it may be mating season.  Regardless of the reason, the squad needs saving before they meet their end to the likes of these lizards\!
item.properties|f.honor_shield_4: A ceremonial shield issued to Vanguards of the Spiral Order. Though intended for formal occasions, its solid construction makes it suitable for combat use.
item.properties|f.cold_iron_carver: An enchanted sword crafted from cold iron whose blade wards off the creatures of the dark.
item.properties|f.crimsonite_shard: A shard of Crimsonite that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
mission.properties|m.target_acquired_3a: We have pinpointed its location to be in the deepest level of a gremlin facility known as the 'Ironclaw Munitions Factory.'  The factory is used for the production of all manners of gremlin weaponry and is highly dangerous, even to the gremlins working there. \n\nYou must prepare yourself for heavy resistance from shock-powered constructs and gremlins.
item.properties|f.scary_skelly_shield: A small, spooky shield to safeguard you from shadow.
mission.properties|b.mission_sprite_2: Rhendon is waiting for you in an area of the Clockworks known as the Restless Railroad where reconnaissance has located a cache of missing battle sprites. Secure the sprites and clear the area of hostiles. You are authorized to utilize any sprites you secure in order to complete the mission.
mission.properties|o.eye_of_needle: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
mission.properties|o.welcome_to_haven_b: Contact Intel Agent Kora via Comlink
item.properties|f.wolver_cap: A lively hat made from significantly less lively Wolver hide.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_mat_1: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_3a: Feeding your sprite materials is the fastest way to level it up. Talk to Biscotti here in the Lab for more information on sprite feeding.
item.properties|m.equip_locked: Equipping {0} will bind it to you. You will not be able to trade this item once bound. Are you sure?
item.properties|f.exp_center_4f: An expansion that adds a small central room to the Guild Hall.
design.properties|e.location_already_pla: A room has already been installed at this location.
mission.properties|m.ancient_generator_1: What do we have here, more little creatures that came from the sky?  Here to take my power and disturb my research? \n\nNo one disrupts the work of the great Schemer Razwog\!  I'll see to it you never leave this room alive\!
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_5a: A recon squad has managed to track down where many of these battle sprites have landed.  Rhendon has been sent ahead to scout out three of these sites and will meet up with you in the Clockworks. \n\nYou must secure our battle sprites before they fall into enemy hands\!
social.properties|m.already_played: You have already completed this mission today.
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_3c: Most of them will attack you on sight, but there are some; outcasts from the colony, that have taken refuge in the towns below the surface. Theirs is a hard life, hated by their own kind and no longer in a world they call home.
conversation.properties|m.rc_vet_1a: Thanks for your help earlier. Stay safe\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_2a: First dragons and now... little winged feline creatures? I can't believe we're seeing this phenomenon again\!
support.properties|m.option_200_0: We have chat filters in place to remove offensive words. If you have disabled the chat filter then you should not be filing complaints against players for using those offensive words. To enable chat filters instead click here.
conversation.properties|m.fc_bridge_2: Lord Vanaduke is the master of this broken realm. Once the king of Almire, Vanaduke now commands a terrible legion in the ashes of his former kingdom. You would do well to never cross his path.
conversation.properties|r.fc_court_compl: This will greatly aid me, thank you.
item.properties|f.prisma_driver: A high-tech alchemical sidearm that fires powerful prisma bullets that split multiple times on impact.
item.properties|f.plated_shade_helm: A helm of fiendish fabric interlaced with dark matter to conceal its wearer while they creep in camoflauged corners.
mission.properties|r.elemental_my_dear_1: Yes, but this time you need to let me-
mission.properties|b.p_moorcroft3:
Someone or something has summoned a horde of cursed black kats into the Clockworks. These shadowy beasts hunger for arcane power and raided the Moorcroft Manor Archives' precious collection of magical grimoires. 

In the wrong hands these ancient tomes could be catastrophic, but it turns out that black kats can't read, so they instead decided to just eat them.

The residents of Moorcroft Manor would like you to retrieve the Ancient Pages of the magical grimoires that quite likely reside in the stomachs of black kats. We'll leave you to figure out just how to recover them... 

For this mission, intel has located a black kat nest beyond an area with electrifying resistance. Recover those Ancient Pages and return them to Moorcroft Manor\!
mission.properties|m.built_to_destroy_2b:
Transmission\: 

'They continue to advance and thwart our schemes\!  How could they have discovered Project R?  Why was there no advance warning of the attack?' 

'Herex and his minions were supposed to be spying on them but they have all vanished like cowards.' 

'To defy the Iron Law is to defy the Order\!  Track the traitor down.  Herex will answer for this setback.'
mission.properties|m.new_threat_2a: And speaking of gremlins, we're starting to get an alarming number of reports of gremlins mobilizing in the Clockworks below Haven.  We don't have too many details yet, but given the relations we've had with them so far, our guess is they're preparing for an attack.
item.properties|f.primal_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. The plates used in its construction provide some protection against the elements of fire and freeze.
support.properties|m.option_208_0: If a player is trying to get your account name or password from you right now, or already did and is admitting to this in chat, you should click here to file a complaint.
item.properties|f.quicksilver_helm: A fine helmet made out of what was once a Quicksilver.
social.properties|m.party_invite: {0} has invited you to join their party.
item.properties|f.frostbreaker_helm: A Spiral Helm modified to provide additional protection against freeze, at the expense of fire and shock resistance.
helptips.properties|m.tut_jelly_cubes: Look out\! Up ahead is a pack of wild jellycubes. When you are close enough, you will automatically target the nearest monster. They will be illuminated with a light column.
item.properties|f.blazing_pulsar: A highly advanced pulsar capable of launching compact infernos from afar. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
guild.properties|m.invite_pending: {0} has already been invited to join your guild.

mission.properties|m.alchemy_mastery_4a: Before you go, here's a few materials to get you started.  Good luck.
item.properties|f.wild_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_2a: Once I make it to Haven I really can't come back?
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2d: Battle sprites gain perks at certain levels that you can equip within the battle sprite interface. Perks provide bonuses to your stats.
conversation.properties|m.hav_mecha_1a: I got a great deal on this broken mecha knight. If I can just figure out how to get it working properly I'll have myself a personal bodyguard for my expeditions into the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.salamander_suit: A suit crafted from the hide of a salamander. It grants the wearer the beast's natural resistance to fire.
item.properties|f.waste_module: A small receptacle that once collected refuse from a device built to wreak havoc. Now, it just plain reeks.
item.properties|f.ascended_calibur: Made of a rare alloy of sun silver, knights talented enough to possess Caliburs as fine as this one typically bond with and name their blades.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_weap_2: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
item.properties|f.gh_env_snowing: A beautiful environment that fills your Guild Hall with perfect snow\: the kind that gently falls from the sky and never collects on the ground, melting into gray muck.
item.properties|f.charming_cap: The sort of hat one would wear for charming charming.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: So far, we haven't recovered Seerus's body, but there's no way anyone could have survived that explosion.
item.properties|f.chaos_cloak: A forbidden mantle said to grant the wearer protection within the nameless realm where all elements are said to converge into one and divide into all.
uplink.properties|m.bid_cancelled: Your bid money has been refunded and is included in this mail.
conversation.properties|m.ritual_2b: Where did you find that?\! Hand it over\! I can finally complete my work\! But just a friendly warning\: I have no idea what might happen. It could be very bad. You probably want to be prepared in case things go... awry.
item.properties|f.sacred_keeper_armor: A cerulean suit of armor for those who want to wreck some robos.
item.properties|f.dark_matter_deposit_4: A mother lode of metalliferous minerals that will generate a jackpot of dark matter.
item.properties|f.divine_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r4: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Parma\! Your Scout\! You're alive\! Where are you\!? We need to get you back to Haven.
help.properties|m.support_2: If you're lost or having trouble, our Game Masters can help\! They can be contacted by filing a support request.
item.properties|f.woven_pathfinder_helm: A flexible helm built for mobility and interlaced with slime fibers to protect against prickly and thorny foes.
item.properties|f.heavy_deconstructor: An upgraded Deconstructor that will wreck robots and crush constructs in a wider area.
item.properties|f.guild_bond: Deposit in your guild's treasury to redeem the crowns.
mission.properties|b.explosive_plot: Recon Knights have discovered what they believe to be a gremlin-hatched plot to destroy Haven\!  As a Knight Elite, you have been selected by Spiral HQ to investigate this matter.  Contact Intel Agent Kora for details.
mission.properties|m.silent_legion_2a: I could swear I heard them just now, their voices carrying in the wind.  No longer screams, no longer cries- whispers.  Indecipherable even in the stillness of this place.  Are they leaving me here?  Why must I be left behind? \n\nYou... I warned you not to proceed, to stay away from me.  Now you'll learn what they did... that those who are close to me die\!
item.properties|f.dangerous_brigandine: Padded armor that seems to emphasize the high mortality rate of the elite Recon Rangers. Recon Rangers need to travel light and fast, often headlong into situations that would terrify other knights.
monster.properties|m.promotion_2: We could use a guy like you in management.
guild.properties|e.design_full: Sorry, design mode is already occupied by the maximum number of editors.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_3a: Over here we have a collection of valuable items and objects you will likely find in the Clockworks.
dungeon.properties|m.core_desc: The ultimate objective of the Spiral Knights, the Core is like a titanic heart, ever beating life through the world surrounding it.
sprites.properties|d.golden_harness: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal piercing damage. \nCan be used by\: Seraphynx, Maskeraith
item.properties|f.philoso_feather: A large, grey feather plucked from the greatest of the Owlite magicians.
helptips.properties|m.atg_switch: Switch out of reach?  Throw a pot or shoot it with a gun\!
item.properties|f.shock_raider_tunic: Anti-static fur lines this raiders coat.
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_raiment: A reclaimed raiment said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Torair, who clung to the gates of the Owlite High Academy of Magicks as both it and his explosives burned.
item.properties|f.gram: An extraordinarily heavy sword whose weight will slow down even the swiftest of knights. That said, just imagine what it'll do to anything you hit with it...
chat.properties|m.usage_ready: Usage\: /{0}\nTell your comrades that you're ready.
guildhelp.properties|m.treasury_info: The Guild Treasury contains all the items and crowns collectively owned by the guild. In order to be placed within a Guild Hall, furniture must first be added to the Treasury. The costs of new rooms, items from the Birdsong Emporium and weekly upkeep are also paid from the Treasury, so guild members will have to be certain to keep the Guild Treasury full of crowns\!\n WARNING\: Anything added to the Guild Treasury can never be removed by any member of the guild, including the guild master. By adding items or crowns to the Guild Treasury, they forever become property of the guild. There are no exceptions.
mission.properties|b.built_to_destroy:
Once known to Spiral HQ as 'Project R,' the Roarmulus Twins have been identified as a gremlin-engineered weapon of tremendous power built with the sole purpose of destroying Haven.  Stored deep within the heart of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory, this weapon is not only protected by hordes of shock-powered constructs and gremlins, but the factory is a highly dangerous, explosive hazard itself\! 

In addition to shutting down the Roarmulus Twins, Spiral HQ would like you to recover the Alpha Squad recon module that is believed to be located somewhere within the factory. 

It is highly recommended that you form a full squad before deploying.
item.properties|f.fowl_cloak: A simple feathered cloak. Adorn yourself in down and get down for the new year.
item.properties|f.skolver_coat: The ultimate in Wolver-hide clothing, this coat has been expertly crafted to give your melee attacks extra power.
mission.properties|r.new_threat_10a: There was an attack.  The Artifact's been stolen\!
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_gremlin: Steal the gremlin schematics from the gremlin construction site\!
item.properties|f.proto_sword: A small sword issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
projectx.properties|m.love_opt_in_footer: By proceeding, you acknowledge and accept the terms and conditions linked below.
helptips.properties|m.loading9: If you become stunned you will move and attack slower than usual. This can leave you as a prime target for larger monsters that you can normally outrun, so watch out\!
mission.properties|m.intro_expansion: Expansion Missions are special missions that must be unlocked in order to access. Completing Expansion Missions earns you exclusive rewards\!
auction.properties|e.auction_bid: The auction may not be cancelled, it already has a bid.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Be careful in there\!
projectx.properties|m.cs_instructions: Please select the control layout you would like to use.
conversation.properties|m.core_lead_2: We're attempting to find a means to activate the Core through the power of the minerals found within the Clockworks.  Those minerals are capable of transforming the Clockworks- we have seen this in the Haven Arcade.  It is our belief that we can use that power to activate the Core and... open it somehow.
conversation.properties|m.barracks_boost: Want to earn even more Krogmo Coins with every match?
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_1a:
Listen up, Rangers\! Spiral HQ has received a very cryptic distress signal from some completely unknown facility deep within the Clockworks. 

The way I figure, we're about to dive head first into either a perilous rescue mission or a death trap. Either way, your means of resolving the situation resides in your arsenal right now. So get geared up, and get ready for combat. 

Let's ride, Rangers\!
item.properties|f.swift_flourish: An upgraded Flourish for knights who make a point of dispatching opponents with a bit of flair.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_5a: We all sensed the moment you defeated Vanaduke. The entire citadel shook as he fell and for a moment we thought that this realm would be destroyed along with its ruler. You must be careful wandering these halls with the place coming apart like this\!
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_6a: Something has happened\!  That door just popped up behind you like a trap\! \n\nDefend yourself, {0}\!
sprites.properties|d.deadly_shadow_cloak: Gain an attack power and attack speed bonus when shadow cloak activates. Bonus lasts for a short duration after shadow cloak expires.
item.properties|f.emberbreak_shield: A Proto Shield modified to provide some protection against fire.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_1_8a: Perhaps gremlins are trying to steal our technology?
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: There are three distinct battle sprites available. Each has responded to the power emanating from this world differently and each offers a unique combat experience. \n\nThese sprites include the fiery drakon, the radiant seraphynx, and the shadowy maskeraith.
conversation.properties|m.tier_done: Well met, {0}.  Having achieved the required rank, you are authorized to explore deeper depths of the Clockworks.  Good luck to you.

projectx.properties|e.name_invalid_space: Sorry, names may not contain more than two spaces.

item.properties|f.guild_members_300: Allows your guild to recruit up to 300 members\!
item.properties|f.pollinator: A rare, advanced handgun produced by biotechs with captured Gremlin technology. It fires pollen particles that cling to the enemy, causing explosive damage and also the sniffles.
item.properties|f.luminite_deposit_2: A good-sized mineral deposit that will generate several units of luminite.
item.properties|f.moonstone_deposit_4: A mother lode of metalliferous minerals that will generate a jackpot of moonstone.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_h: Stick with your squad - remember it's dangerous to go alone\!
guild.properties|m.exp_removed: Success\! Expansion removed. Upkeep will be recalculated after your next publish.
mission.properties|m.built_to_destroy_1a: "The Nine see all, hear all. Obey the Iron Law."
item.properties|f.metal_sonic_mask: A sinister looking mask crafted by a mechanical genius whose ability is said to rival that of even the greatest gremlin Gear Sages.

mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_1: Hail\! You must be the brave knight Spiral HQ has sent to deal with these Grinchlins. Mount Krampus is not like other levels so allow me to explain to you how it works.
auction.properties|m.featured: Featured auctions are held by the Haven Treasury. \n\nThey often contain rare, unique or limited time items.
item.properties|f.slime_lockbox: A slippery, slimy lockbox won at the Golden Slime Casino.  It contains one of many special items.  It can be opened with a Slime Key or a Silver Key.
item.properties|f.bombastic_demo_suit: A fine set of armor specially forged for those select few individuals who can handle explosives with panache and flair... while managing to avoid blowing themselves up.
mission.properties|b.eye_of_needle: After compiling the data you collected from the Owlite keep and additional intel from Recon Knights, Intel Agent Kora has prepared a debriefing for you with regard to the mass of negative energy blocking access to the Core.
mission.properties|o.king_of_ashes: Defeat Lord Vanaduke in the Firestorm Citadel and reach the Core
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_w: Glorp\! Glorp\! Winterfest is saved and one thing is clear\: all hearts now sing with holiday cheer\!
item.properties|f.emberbreak_helm: A Spiral Helm modified to provide additional protection against fire, at the expense of freeze and shock resistance.
mission.properties|b.delved_too_deep: The truth has been revealed. It's time to update Intel Agent Kora and Spiral HQ about what you and Lieutenant Vaelyn have learned.
sprites.properties|d.dazzling_light_ray: The ray of light deals extra damage to undead and fiend family monsters.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_baa4bd: Become a premiere elite select platinum plus priority member in the Golden Slime Casino C.U.B.E. Club.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_battlesta: A fine display commemorating a knight's full acceptance into the Spiral Order.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_vana: A magnificently preserved royal seal of the lost kingdom of Almire. It probably belongs in a museum.
exchange.properties|m.crowns_tooltip: Go to the exchange where you can trade Crowns for Energy or Energy for Crowns.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Biotech Hahn is attempting to further his research of slime and beast family monsters and is requesting samples from your recent missions.  He has specifically requested that you be reminded of his 'very informative lecture' that was given to you 'free of charge' when making your decision as to whether or not to comply.
item.properties|f.furious_flamberge: Great fencers can carve their name into their opponents. Legendary ones brand it there.
shop.properties|m.name: Name
item.properties|f.scrap_metal: A discarded piece of metal that could be easily repurposed.
item.properties|f.woven_shade_armor: A loose fitting suit of armor that enables its wearer to slink through the shadows and assault unaware enemies.
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: I just put in another bulk order for office supplies. We keep running out.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_battlesta: A simple display commemorating a knight's recruitment into the Spiral Order.
mission.properties|b.oilers_in_boilers:
A boiler room beneath Moorcroft Manor has been overrun by a legion of oily slimes known as 'oilers' that seem to enjoy fiery conditions.  This could prove disastrous for any levels in close proximity should the slimes enter the boilers and cause an explosion. 

Moorcroft Manor serves as an invaluable connection point into Tier 2 and its departed residents have been the most gracious of hosts.  It is in Spiral HQ's best interest to send a squad in to deal with the smoldering slimes before they create a firestorm that seals off our access to Tier 2. 

It is up to you to locate the oilers and remove them from the boilers\!
item.properties|f.culet: An elegantly designed suit of armor capable of flattering any form.
mission.properties|r.collector_prisoner_: Can you make it back to Haven?
mission.properties|r.pierce_of_cake_4b: I think I've got it thanks for-
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_5: It will take a little time to get all of our equipment fully working again.
auction.properties|m.cancel_support:
Are you sure?


Use your GM powers to cancel this auction and refund everyone involved?
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_6: Our geological research is ongoing, so there may yet be other fascinating uses for these strange and powerful minerals.
conversation.properties|m.mon_pocket_1:
Greetings\! I'm Nonna with the Emberlight Adoption Agency\! 

We at the Emberlight Adoption Agency collect baby monsters that have managed to become lost in the darkest depths of the Clockworks.  No longer having a home or any means of caring for themselves, we try to find these needy monsters a good home\! 

By purchasing one of these adorable 'monster pockets' you can carry around a baby monster of your very own\! 

The Emberlight Adoption Agency will visit Haven from time to time, and you never know what we will have to offer\!
item.properties|f.sun_silver: An extraordinary metal imbued with the radiant light of the sky.
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: Luck changes, sometimes from bad to worse...
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: Productivity is up two percent since I started mandatory overtime.
item.properties|f.frenzy_champion_helm: The helm of one who defied the gods and stormed the gates of a heavenly kingdom. Some say that whistling winds are the eternal warcries of her siege.
pvp.properties|m.blast_network-info: A bombastic game of explosive action where players attempt to blow away their competition\!  Blast Network provides all participants with the gear to play, so no preparation is required to get in on the action.
mission.properties|o.mission_sprite_1: Secure a cache of battle sprites and return them to the Lab
pvp.properties|m.coins_awarded_message: You were awarded Krogmo Coins for participation in {0}\!
helptips.properties|m.atg_statustraps: Beware\!  Some traps can cause damage AND inflict harmful status effects.
item.properties|f.gsc_vip: A non-transferrable membership in the Golden Slime Casino C.U.B.E. Club. Membership benefits are subject to change.
guild.properties|e.guild_in_default: Sorry, that guild is in-default. Try again later.
item.properties|f.pile_o_pillows: A freshly laundered basket of pillows, ready for throwing at your friends\!
uplink.properties|e.unvalidated: Your email address has not been validated. An email has been sent. Please follow the link in the email and once validated, return here and try again.
helptips.properties|m.atg_healpad: Stand on a HEART GENERATOR to restore your health\!
item.properties|f.confetti_winter: When thrown, this winter confetti gives you quite a chill.
mission.properties|o.time_enough_at_last: Discover the fate of the lost knight within the Scarlet Fortress
conversation.properties|m.core_tech_1: Welcome to the Core on-site research camp.  Got any news from the surface?
conversation.properties|r.rc_warning_1a: I understand, I'll be sure to hear what Virgil has to say.
helptips.properties|m.atg_vials: Inflict a variety of status effects on enemies by throwing VIALS at them\!
item.properties|f.winterfest_table: A stylish antique table with a plate of cookies set out for Impostclaus.
help.properties|m.monster_construct: Deal ELEMENTAL - Weak to ELEMENTAL - Strong against PIERCING
item.properties|f.vial_stun_super: An ornate glass vial containing shimmering flash pellets. It can be used to inflict enemies with Stun.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be too stupefied to give chase\!
item.properties|f.fiend_portal_key: Using this will allow you to open and pass through the Grim Gate in the Ancient Grove.
logon.properties|m.version_mismatch_auto: Your client needs to be updated. It will automatically update in just a moment.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_cj_wasd_mo: Mouse used for targeting, attacking and menu navigation
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_construct: Destroy the operational war machines within the ruined factory\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_surviv: The watcher of the Wildwoods...the horrible Snarbolax\!
helptips.properties|m.plan_o_attack: The monitor shows readouts coming from a prototype of a massive war machine labeled "Project R".
projectx.properties|d.achievement_3d4b16: Amass an Arsenal that includes a 5 star helmet, armor, shield, gun and bomb.
mission.properties|m.prestigious_opportu: I have faith in you, {0}.  I just know that you will be among the select Knights skillful enough to reach the Core and with any luck, get us off this planet.
item.properties|f.confetti_fall_equinox: When thrown, this fall confetti bursts with autumn embers.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_kit: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
mission.properties|d.supply_depot_explan: The Supply Depot is full of items for sale. As you complete missions, more items will become available.
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_e: I can feel the electricity in the air\!  Looks like we won't be making our final stand tonight after all\!
item.properties|f.winter_onesie: The perfect pajamas for passing out presents or patiently waiting for Impostoclaus' presence.
mission.properties|r.apocrea_1_1a: What is this place and what are you talking about?
pvp.properties|m.no_reward: You have dishonored my great Coliseum with your lack of fighting spirit\!  You shall receive no Krogmo Coins and no rank points\!
item.properties|f.nova_driver: It'll take more than a wish to save you if you're the unfortunate target of this all-powerful pistol with the strength of the stars themselves.
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_2a: That mass of negative energy we've been investigating is a portion of an ancient kingdom called Almire, the very same realm described in that Owlite tome you discovered\!
helptips.properties|m.lock_guard: Protect and heal yourself and teammates from damage with the Guardian Shield\! \n\nKeep enemies at bay with increased resistances to damage and attack with faster swords and bombs\!
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_2: Such bravery, such pluck\! Yes, perhaps with some luck you stand a chance against the terrible fiends that mean to destroy Winterfest dreams. \n\nSo note the addition of a Winterfest mission, take up your sword and I will grant you rewards\!
chat.properties|m.usage_move: Usage\: /{0} x y\nMove to the (x, y) coordinates.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
item.properties|f.rocket_sprocket: A sturdy sprocket used by machines that fire projectiles.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_pier: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
chat.properties|m.usage_force_bug_report: Usage\: /{0} <knight name> [description]\nForces a bug report to be submitted from the player's client.
item.properties|f.light_shard: A shard of Luminite that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_elem: Greetings {0}, I'm Archilus, a knight who utilizes gear that offers high elemental damage defense.  The recipes I have for you produce armor and shields that protect you from the elemental attacks of constructs and gremlins. \n\nElemental resistant armor and shields are adapted from Owlite technology.  Though the Owlites themselves no longer exist, their amazing elemental mastery lives on in this gear.
conversation.properties|m.npc_minerknigh: You can only carry one mineral at a time so choose the biggest one.
item.properties|m.gsc_vip: Golden Slime Casino C.U.B.E. Club Membership
item.properties|f.pig_helm: A ferocious battle helmet that smells a bit like smokey applewood on the inside.
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_5b: Get energy and do amazing things- got it\!
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_3a: Soon you will find yourself in one of the traps set by the Apocrea. If you are powerful enough to escape then you may be able to save some of the other lost souls along the way.
item.properties|f.deep_sea_cuirass: A suit of armor with iridescent scales that seem to move like shimmering waves. The armor is rather uncomfortable to wear as it is naturally cold and wet at all times.
sprites.properties|d.bristle: Increases the number of quills fired and their sticking duration.
item.properties|f.tailed_helm: An expressive helm proving that two plumes are always better than one.
projectx.properties|e.cant_loadout: That loadout can't be used here.
item.properties|f.prize_box_cozy: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Cozy style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_steam_cont: Menu key toggles between mouse mode
item.properties|f.silversix: A mysterious antique with a brilliant silver finish, these handguns are said to have been wielded by "gunslinger priests" during a now forgotten time.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.
item.properties|f.box_elite_trinket: Contains various elite, five-star trinkets and a Trinket Slot Upgrade. Items are randomly chosen. No key is required to open.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
item.properties|f.thwack_hammer: A spirited spanner specially suited to scrapping mechanical enemies.
item.properties|f.fur_cap: A toasty fur cap forming the visage of a wild beast.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_1a: Well, looks like we're in quite a bind here, {0}. There's plenty of work to be done to get this camp up and running, so you've now been authorized to receive missions\! You can find any available missions in the Activities bar.
guild.properties|m.no_open_halls: There are no open Guild Halls
mission.properties|m.pioneers_5a: Euclid wasn't your typical knight.  By the time most in his division were getting their Squire crest, he had already achieved Vanguard.  As a Squad Leader, he lead a series of successful assaults against the Morai during the liberation of Isora.  A brilliant tactician, he was known for getting the job done with half the knights of other squads.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_7a: No problem, I've got the time.  Let's start from the top.
projectx.properties|m.confirm_logoff: Are you sure you want to logoff?
item.properties|f.super_fire_barrier: Surrounds you with potent fiery orbs that can set hostiles ablaze
item.properties|f.sunset_stetson: A sturdy hat for gunslingers that shouldn't cost you much more than a fistful of crowns.
conversation.properties|m.hav_greeter_1a: Welcome to Haven, little one. Please join your friends in procuring shinies from the Clockworks. Shinies are always appreciated by the Strangers.
helptips.properties|m.loading6: If you become poisoned you will not be able to heal yourself. Avoid taking too much damage until it wears off.
helptips.properties|m.atg_pots: Some objects like pots can be thrown at switches AND enemies\!
social.properties|m.invite_name: Enter the name of the knight you wish to invite\:
item.properties|f.umbral_blaster: An enhanced shadow blaster designed to neutralize alien bioforms.
item.properties|f.red_saber: A saber the color of the burning sun that is given to knights who have shown exemplary bravery in past actions.
item.properties|f.maskeraith_pod: A sprite pod containing a level 1 Maskeraith Battle Sprite. \n\nThe Maskeraith is a battle sprite that embodies the shadows. Its skills focus on subterfuge and deadly toxins.
mission.properties|b.pioneers: After the crash of the Skylark, Captain Ozlo selected an elite squad of Spiral Knights to be the first to enter the Clockworks.  They were never seen again.  Contact Intel Agent Kora and learn how you will play a role in solving this mystery.
conversation.properties|m.energy_info_2a: Awesome\! I'll break it down for you in three easy lessons\: what it is, how it's used, and how you can get more.
mission.properties|m.best_of_beast_1a: Hello {0}, good to see you still standing.  While normally not the concern of a Chief Biotech, I specifically requested the opportunity to inform you about the dangers that lie ahead for you in Tier 3 of the Clockworks.  Can't have you winding up dead as a result of some junior Biotech's misinformation.
item.properties|f.fuel_canister: A small receptacle once used to hold fuel for a complex machine.
guild.properties|log.env_changed: Changed the environment to {0} for {1} crowns, replacing {2}.
item.properties|f.great_defender_c: A well-crafted costume version of a classic shield.
item.properties|f.prize_box_ancient: Contains various unique items fashioned in the ancient, veiled homeland of the tortodrones. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|m.add_more_bonuses: Add more fire crystals to unlock chances for bonuses\!
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
conversation.properties|m.af_hungry: I could sure go for a snack\!
item.properties|f.scale_helm: A helm crafted from the scales of a slithering beast.
helptips.properties|m.battle_arena: Each stage of a battle arena is more challenging than the last, but a victory always earns you a chance to cut your losses and move on.  The only rule is, everyone must fight at least once\!
social.properties|m.unfriended: You are no longer friends with {0}.
conversation.properties|m.npc_campknight: I can already feel the frost fading.
item.properties|f.trojan_helm: A helm of the stalwart Spiral Wardens that is said to give great comfort to other knights.  Nothing says 'here comes the cavalry' like the sight of these iron giants taking to the battlefield.
helptips.properties|m.elevator: The elevator will activate when all living party members are standing on it.
chat.properties|m.not_in_party: You are not in a party.
item.properties|f.jelly_mail: A squishy set of armor made from slippery slimes that simply oozes with style.
conversation.properties|m.af_chat_07: Uh-oh\! The truck have started to move\!
item.properties|f.shocking_salt_bomb: A large chunk of rock salt primed with a potent explosive. For nutritional purposes, this particular chunk of salt has been enriched with dangerous amounts of electricity. Wait, what?
conversation.properties|r.energy_info_2d: Your lessons have energized me\! I'm off to adventure, bye\!
uplink.properties|m.gift_received: Please accept this token of friendship.
mission.properties|r.explosive_plot_1a: Thanks Kora.  I owe a lot to your intel.
item.properties|f.iron_buckler: A beaten little buckler made of iron that can withstand a bit more abuse than a Proto Shield.
uplink.properties|e.already_received: That knight cannot receive another gift of this type.
mission.properties|b.ending_in_fire: A strange energy anomaly has been been detected in the levels just above the Core.  Contact Intel Agent Kora for details.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Snarbolax \nThe mythical Snarbolax is immune to knight attacks. Ringing the Beast Bell when it is nearby will stun the beast into submission.
auction.properties|e.no_preview: Sorry, this item cannot be previewed with your current equipment.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_mat_234: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|o.sewer_stash: Destroy the gremlin war machines hidden in the wasteworks
mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r7: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
mission.properties|o.p_tortodrone_r9: Investigate the Ancient Grove and put a stop to a Fiendish plot.
item.properties|f.storm_crusader_helm: A helm worn by mythical soldiers who are said to ride the lightning into battle.
item.properties|f.barbarous_thorn_shield: A mythical shield imbued with the fury of the Snarbolax itself. It's said that the beast can use the glowing orbs on the shield's face to see and stalk weak-hearted wielders.
item.properties|f.alchemy_room: A utilitarian room equipped with two Alchemy Machines and a General Goods Merchant.
item.properties|f.airbraker_shield: A lightweight, compact, and pneumatically-activated shield that expands its surface area against enemy attacks.
mission.properties|o.alone_in_dark: Make contact with a lost soul of Almire in the soldier's graveyard
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
item.properties|f.furni_library_lectern_: A podium perfect for pondering over many a quaint and curious volume of forgotten lore.
item.properties|f.brandish: A reliable blade whose lack of ornamentation belies its strength.
conversation.properties|m.mission_lab_by: We formed a barricade around the Artifact but it was overrun. I'm sorry...
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Don't worry about Feron, he'll be healed up in no time.
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_1a: Yes, I'd like to ask you a few things.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_11: Brinks is the Token Trader, issuing certain items to Knights in exchange for tokens that can be collected within the Clockworks.  Tokens can be found in treasure blocks, issued as mission rewards or found when defeating special boss monsters.
mission.properties|r.time_enough_at_last: Safe?  This place is swarming with monsters\!
helptips.properties|m.scenario_roarmulus: 'Project R' is nearly complete. We must gather more scrap\!
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_r6: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We wouldn't have made it past that artillery without your help\!
item.properties|f.token_cake: A slice of cake that serves as a trophy from victory over a horde of Creep Cakes.  Head Chef Biscotti affirms that both these trophies and the incident that created them never officially occurred.
item.properties|f.surge_breaker_shield: A reliable shield that'll help keep you grounded in battle.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_1a: Well met, {0}. It is good to see you once more and under such auspicious terms.
design.properties|i.place_door: Install a door at this location.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_cj_wasd_mo: Keyboard used for movement, advanced commands, quickslots and chat
item.properties|f.dark_matter: A fabled mineral dark and ominous in color said to contain the essences of both chaos and nothingness.
mission.properties|b.alchemy_mastery: Bosco in the Haven Bazaar has more information for you regarding the highest level of alchemy available to you.  Mastery level alchemy will be instrumental in your survival as you attempt to reach the Core of the Clockworks.
